name: funMap_injective
statement:
theorem funMap_injective {α β : Type _} [LinearOrder β] [IsWellOrder β (· < ·)] :
    Function.Injective (funMap α β)
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  simp only [funMap, Prod.mk.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at h
  suffices : ∀ y : β, ∀ x : α, f x = y → g x = y
  · ext x : 1
    rw [this]
    rfl
  intro y
  refine IsWellFounded.induction (· < ·) (C := fun y => ∀ x : α, f x = y → g x = y) y ?_
  clear y
  rintro y ih x rfl
  have : f x ∈ Set.range g
  · rw [← h.1]
    exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨y, h₁⟩ := this
  rw [← h₁]
  obtain (h₂ | h₂ | h₂) := lt_trichotomy (g x) (g y)
  · have : g x ∈ Set.range f
    · rw [h.1]
      exact ⟨x, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨z, h₃⟩ := this
    rw [h₁, ← h₃] at h₂
    have h₄ := ih (f z) h₂ z rfl
    have := congr_fun₂ h.2 z x
    simp only [InvImage, h₂, eq_iff_iff, true_iff] at this
    rw [h₄, h₃] at this
    cases lt_irrefl _ this
  · exact h₂
  · have := congr_fun₂ h.2 y x
    simp only [InvImage, eq_iff_iff] at this
    rw [← this] at h₂
    have := ih (f y) h₂ y rfl
    have := h₂.trans_eq (h₁.symm.trans this)
    cases lt_irrefl _ this

name: mk_fun_le
statement:
theorem mk_fun_le {α β : Type u} :
    #(α → β) ≤ #({ E : Set β // #E ≤ #α } × (α → α → Prop))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := IsWellOrder.subtype_nonempty (σ := β)
  let _ := linearOrderOfSTO r
  exact ⟨⟨funMap α β, funMap_injective⟩⟩

name: pow_le_of_isStrongLimit'
statement:
theorem pow_le_of_isStrongLimit' {α β : Type u} [Infinite α] [Infinite β]
    (h₁ : IsStrongLimit #β) (h₂ : #α < (#β).ord.cof) : #β ^ #α ≤ #β
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans mk_fun_le ?_
  simp only [mk_prod, Cardinal.lift_id, mk_pi, mk_fintype, Fintype.card_prop, Nat.cast_ofNat,
    prod_const, Cardinal.lift_id', lift_two]
  have h₃ : #{ E : Set β // #E ≤ #α } ≤ #β
  · rw [← mk_subset_mk_lt_cof h₁.2]
    refine ⟨⟨fun E => ⟨E, E.prop.trans_lt h₂⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    intro E F h
    simp only [Subtype.mk.injEq] at h
    exact Subtype.coe_injective h
  have h₄ : (2 ^ #α) ^ #α ≤ #β
  · rw [← power_mul, mul_eq_self (Cardinal.infinite_iff.mp inferInstance)]
    refine (h₁.2 _ ?_).le
    exact h₂.trans_le (cof_ord_le #β)
  refine le_trans (mul_le_max _ _) ?_
  simp only [ge_iff_le, le_max_iff, max_le_iff, le_aleph0_iff_subtype_countable, h₃, h₄, and_self,
    aleph0_le_mk]

name: pow_lt_of_isStrongLimit'
statement:
theorem pow_lt_of_isStrongLimit' {α β γ : Type u} [Infinite β]
    (hα : #α < #γ) (hβ : #β < #γ) (hγ : IsStrongLimit #γ) : #α ^ #β < #γ
proof:
:= by
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt mk_fun_le ?_
  simp only [mk_prod, Cardinal.lift_id, mk_pi, mk_fintype, Fintype.card_prop, Nat.cast_ofNat,
    prod_const, Cardinal.lift_ofNat, Cardinal.lift_id']
  refine mul_lt_of_lt ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact hγ.isLimit.aleph0_le
  · refine (Cardinal.mk_subtype_le _).trans_lt ?_
    rw [mk_set]
    exact hγ.2 _ hα
  · rw [← power_mul, mul_eq_self (Cardinal.infinite_iff.mp inferInstance)]
    exact hγ.2 _ hβ

name: pow_le_of_isStrongLimit
statement:
theorem pow_le_of_isStrongLimit {κ μ : Cardinal.{u}} (h₁ : IsStrongLimit μ) (h₂ : κ < μ.ord.cof) :
    μ ^ κ ≤ μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : κ < ℵ₀
  · exact pow_le h₁.isLimit.aleph0_le h
  · revert h₁ h₂ h
    refine inductionOn₂ κ μ ?_
    intro α β h₁ h₂ h
    have := Cardinal.infinite_iff.mpr (le_of_not_lt h)
    have := Cardinal.infinite_iff.mpr h₁.isLimit.aleph0_le
    exact pow_le_of_isStrongLimit' h₁ h₂

name: pow_lt_of_isStrongLimit
statement:
theorem pow_lt_of_isStrongLimit {ξ κ μ : Cardinal.{u}}
    (hξ : ξ < μ) (hκ : κ < μ) (hμ : IsStrongLimit μ) : ξ ^ κ < μ
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : κ < ℵ₀
  · rw [lt_aleph0] at h
    obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ := h
    by_cases h : ξ < ℵ₀
    · rw [lt_aleph0] at h
      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := h
      rw [pow_cast_right, ← Nat.cast_pow]
      exact (nat_lt_aleph0 _).trans_le hμ.isLimit.aleph0_le
    · exact (power_nat_le (le_of_not_lt h)).trans_lt hξ
  · revert hξ hκ hμ h
    refine inductionOn₃ ξ κ μ ?_
    intro α β γ hα hβ hγ h
    have := infinite_iff.mpr (le_of_not_lt h)
    exact pow_lt_of_isStrongLimit' hα hβ hγ

name: mk_enumeration
statement: theorem mk_enumeration (mk_α : #α = #μ) : #(Enumeration α) = #μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · rw [Cardinal.mk_congr enumerationEquiv]
    simp only [mk_sigma, mk_pi, mk_α, prod_const, Cardinal.lift_id]
    refine le_trans (sum_le_sum _ (fun _ => #μ) ?_) ?_
    · intro i
      refine pow_le_of_isStrongLimit Params.μ_isStrongLimit ?_
      refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ Params.κ_le_μ_ord_cof
      exact card_typein_lt (· < ·) i Params.κ_ord.symm
    · simp only [sum_const, Cardinal.lift_id, mul_mk_eq_max, ge_iff_le, max_le_iff, le_refl,
        and_true]
      exact Params.κ_lt_μ.le
  · rw [← mk_α]
    refine ⟨Enumeration.singleton, ?_⟩
    intro a₁ a₂ h
    have := (Enumeration.mem_singleton_iff a₁ a₁).mpr rfl
    rw [h, Enumeration.mem_singleton_iff] at this
    exact this

name: _root_.Cardinal.pow_mono_left
statement:
theorem _root_.Cardinal.pow_mono_left (a : Cardinal) (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    Monotone (fun (b : Cardinal) => a ^ b)
proof:
:= by
  intro b c
  revert ha
  refine Cardinal.inductionOn₃ a b c ?_
  intro α β γ hα h
  suffices : #(β → α) ≤ #(γ → α)
  · simp only [mk_pi, prod_const, Cardinal.lift_id] at this
    exact this
  obtain (hβ | hβ) := isEmpty_or_nonempty β
  · rw [mk_ne_zero_iff] at hα
    obtain ⟨a⟩ := hα
    refine ⟨fun _ _ => a, ?_⟩
    intro f g _
    ext x
    cases IsEmpty.false x
  · rw [Cardinal.le_def] at h
    obtain ⟨f, hf⟩ := h
    refine mk_le_of_surjective (f := (· ∘ f)) ?_
    intro g
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hf.hasLeftInverse
    rw [Function.leftInverse_iff_comp] at hk
    refine ⟨g ∘ k, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    rw [Function.comp.assoc, hk, Function.comp_id]

name: max_eq_zero
statement: theorem max_eq_zero [IsEmpty α] (E : Enumeration α) : E.max = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← κ_le_zero_iff]
  by_contra! h
  have := E.f 0 h
  exact isEmptyElim this

name: _root_.Cardinal.mul_le_of_le
statement:
theorem _root_.Cardinal.mul_le_of_le {a b c : Cardinal} (ha : a ≤ c) (hb : b ≤ c) (hc : ℵ₀ ≤ c) :
    a * b ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha' : ℵ₀ ≤ a
  · refine le_trans (mul_le_max_of_aleph0_le_left ha') ?_
    simp only [ge_iff_le, max_le_iff]
    exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
  by_cases hb' : ℵ₀ ≤ b
  · refine le_trans (mul_le_max_of_aleph0_le_right hb') ?_
    simp only [ge_iff_le, max_le_iff]
    exact ⟨ha, hb⟩
  · simp only [not_le] at ha' hb'
    exact (mul_lt_aleph0 ha' hb').le.trans hc

name: _root_.Cardinal.lt_pow
statement: theorem _root_.Cardinal.lt_pow {a b : Cardinal} (h : 1 < a) : b < a ^ b
proof:
:= by
  refine Cardinal.inductionOn b ?_
  intro β
  have := sum_lt_prod (fun (_ : β) => 1) (fun _i_ => a) (fun _ => h)
  simp only [sum_const, Cardinal.lift_id, mul_one, prod_const] at this
  exact this

name: mk_enumeration_ne_zero
statement: theorem mk_enumeration_ne_zero {α : Type u} : #(Enumeration α) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cardinal.mk_ne_zero_iff]
  exact ⟨⟨0, fun _ hi => (κ_not_lt_zero _ hi).elim⟩⟩

name: mk_enumeration_le
statement: theorem mk_enumeration_le {α : Type u} [Nontrivial α] : #(Enumeration α) ≤ #α ^ #κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_congr enumerationEquiv]
  simp only [mk_sigma, mk_pi, prod_const, Cardinal.lift_id]
  have : ∀ i : κ, #α ^ #(Set.Iio i) ≤ #α ^ #κ
  · intro i
    refine pow_mono_left _ ?_ ?_
    · rw [mk_ne_zero_iff]
      infer_instance
    · exact (card_typein_lt (· < ·) i Params.κ_ord.symm).le
  refine (sum_le_sum _ _ this).trans ?_
  simp only [sum_const, Cardinal.lift_id]
  have : #κ ≤ #α ^ #κ := (lt_pow ?_).le
  · exact mul_le_of_le this le_rfl (Params.κ_isRegular.aleph0_le.trans this)
  · rw [one_lt_iff_nontrivial]
    infer_instance

name: mk_enumeration_le_of_subsingleton
statement:
theorem mk_enumeration_le_of_subsingleton {α : Type u} [Subsingleton α] :
    #(Enumeration α) ≤ #κ
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨Enumeration.max, ?_⟩
  intro E F h
  refine Enumeration.ext' h ?_
  intro i hE hF
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _

name: mk_enumeration_lt
statement: theorem mk_enumeration_lt (h : #α < #μ) : #(Enumeration α) < #μ
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hα | hα) := subsingleton_or_nontrivial α
  · exact mk_enumeration_le_of_subsingleton.trans_lt Params.κ_lt_μ
  · refine mk_enumeration_le.trans_lt ?_
    exact pow_lt_of_isStrongLimit h Params.κ_lt_μ Params.μ_isStrongLimit

name: image_max
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_max (E : Enumeration α) (f : α → β) :
    (E.image f).max = E.max
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: image_f
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_f (E : Enumeration α) (f : α → β) (i : κ) (hi : i < E.max) :
    (E.image f).f i hi = f (E.f i hi)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: image_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_carrier (E : Enumeration α) (f : α → β) :
    (E.image f).carrier = f '' E.carrier
proof:
:= by
  ext x : 1
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, h⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, h.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩, h⟩
    exact ⟨i, hi, h.symm⟩

name: image_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_coe (E : Enumeration α) (f : α → β) :
    (E.image f : Enumeration β) = f '' (E : Set α)
proof:
:=
  image_carrier E f

name: apply_mem_image
statement: theorem apply_mem_image {E : Enumeration α} {x : α} (h : x ∈ E) (f : α → β) : f x ∈ E.image f
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := h
  exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

name: apply_eq_of_image_eq
statement:
theorem apply_eq_of_image_eq {E : Enumeration α} (f : α → α)
    (hE : E.image f = E) {x : α} (hx : x ∈ E) : f x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ := hx
  have := image_f E f i hi
  conv at this => lhs; simp only [hE]
  exact this.symm

name: smul_max
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_max {G : Type _} [SMul G α] (g : G) (E : Enumeration α) :
    (g • E).max = E.max
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_f
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_f {G : Type _} [SMul G α]
    (g : G) (E : Enumeration α) (i : κ) (hi : i < E.max) :
    (g • E).f i hi = g • E.f i hi
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_carrier
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_carrier {G : Type _} [SMul G α] (g : G) (E : Enumeration α) :
    (g • E).carrier = g • E.carrier
proof:
:=
  image_carrier _ _

name: smul_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_coe {G : Type _} [SMul G α] (g : G) (E : Enumeration α) :
    (g • E : Enumeration α) = g • (E : Set α)
proof:
:=
  image_coe _ _

name: smul_mem_smul
statement:
theorem smul_mem_smul {G : Type _} [SMul G α]
    {E : Enumeration α} {x : α} (h : x ∈ E) (g : G) : g • x ∈ g • E
proof:
:=
  apply_mem_image h _

name: smul_eq_of_smul_eq
statement:
theorem smul_eq_of_smul_eq {G : Type _} [SMul G α] {g : G} {E : Enumeration α}
    (hE : g • E = E) {x : α} (hx : x ∈ E) : g • x = x
proof:
:=
  apply_eq_of_image_eq _ hE hx

name: smul_mem_smul_iff
statement:
theorem smul_mem_smul_iff {G : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G α]
    {E : Enumeration α} {x : α} (g : G) : g • x ∈ g • E ↔ x ∈ E
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := smul_mem_smul h g⁻¹
    rwa [inv_smul_smul, inv_smul_smul] at this
  · exact (smul_mem_smul · g)

name: add_f_eq
statement:
theorem add_f_eq {E F : Enumeration α} {i : κ} (hi : i < (E + F).max) :
    (E + F).f i hi =
      if hi' : i < E.max then
        E.f i hi'
      else
        F.f (i - E.max) (κ_sub_lt hi (not_lt.mp hi'))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: add_max
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_max {E F : Enumeration α} : (E + F).max = E.max + F.max
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: add_f_left
statement:
theorem add_f_left {E F : Enumeration α} {i : κ} (h : i < E.max) :
    (E + F).f i (h.trans_le (κ_le_self_add _ _)) = E.f i h
proof:
:=
  by rw [add_f_eq, dif_pos h]

name: add_f_right
statement:
theorem add_f_right {E F : Enumeration α} {i : κ} (h₁ : i < (E + F).max) (h₂ : E.max ≤ i) :
    (E + F).f i h₁ = F.f (i - E.max) (κ_sub_lt h₁ h₂)
proof:
:=
  by rw [add_f_eq, dif_neg (not_lt.mpr h₂)]

name: add_f_right_add
statement:
theorem add_f_right_add {E F : Enumeration α} {i : κ} (h : i < F.max) :
    (E + F).f (E.max + i) (add_lt_add_left h E.max) = F.f i h
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_f_right]
  simp only [κ_add_sub_cancel]
  exact κ_le_self_add _ _

name: add_coe
statement:
theorem add_coe (E F : Enumeration α) :
    (E + F : Set α) = (E : Set _) ∪ F
proof:
:= by
  ext c
  simp only [mem_carrier_iff, Set.mem_union]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    by_cases hi' : i < E.max
    · refine Or.inl ⟨i, hi', ?_⟩
      rw [add_f_left]
    · refine Or.inr ⟨i - E.max, κ_sub_lt hi (not_lt.mp hi'), ?_⟩
      rw [add_f_right]
      exact not_lt.mp hi'
  · rintro (⟨i, hi, rfl⟩ | ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩)
    · refine ⟨i, hi.trans_le (κ_le_self_add _ _), ?_⟩
      rw [add_f_left]
    · refine ⟨E.max + i, add_lt_add_left hi E.max, ?_⟩
      rw [add_f_right_add]

name: mem_add_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_add_iff (E F : Enumeration α) (x : α) :
    x ∈ E + F ↔ x ∈ E ∨ x ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ (E + F : Set α) ↔ _
  rw [add_coe]
  rfl

name: add_congr
statement:
theorem add_congr {E F G H : Enumeration α} (hEF : E.max = F.max) (h : E + G = F + H) :
    E = F ∧ G = H
proof:
:= by
  have : E = F
  · refine ext' hEF ?_
    intro i hE hF
    have h₁ := add_f_left hE (F := G)
    have h₂ := add_f_left hF (F := H)
    simp_rw [h, h₂] at h₁
    exact h₁.symm
  subst this
  refine ⟨rfl, ?_⟩
  refine ext' ?_ ?_
  · have := congr_arg Enumeration.max h
    simp only [add_max, add_right_inj] at this
    exact this
  · intro i hG hH
    have h₁ := add_f_right_add hG (E := E)
    have h₂ := add_f_right_add hH (E := E)
    simp_rw [h, h₂] at h₁
    exact h₁.symm

name: smul_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_add {G : Type _} [SMul G α] {g : G} (E F : Enumeration α) :
    g • (E + F) = g • E + g • F
proof:
:= by
  ext
  · rfl
  rw [heq_iff_eq]
  ext i hi : 2
  by_cases hi' : i < E.max
  · rw [smul_f, add_f_left (show i < (g • E).max from hi'), add_f_left hi', smul_f]
  · rw [smul_f, add_f_right hi (show (g • E).max ≤ i from le_of_not_lt hi'),
      add_f_right (show i < (g • E + g • F).max from hi)
        (show (g • E).max ≤ i from le_of_not_lt hi'), smul_f]
    rfl

name: le_iff
statement:
theorem le_iff (E F : Enumeration α) :
    E ≤ F ↔ E.max ≤ F.max ∧ ∀ (i : κ) (hE : i < E.max) (hF : i < F.max), E.f i hE = F.f i hF
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: lt_iff
statement:
theorem lt_iff (E F : Enumeration α) :
    E < F ↔ E.max < F.max ∧ ∀ (i : κ) (hE : i < E.max) (hF : i < F.max), E.f i hE = F.f i hF
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: image_le_image
statement: theorem image_le_image {E F : Enumeration α} (h : E ≤ F) (f : α → β) : E.image f ≤ F.image f
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact h.1
  · intro i hE hF
    rw [image_f, image_f, h.2]

name: smul_le_smul
statement:
theorem smul_le_smul {G : Type _} [SMul G α] {E F : Enumeration α} (h : E ≤ F) (g : G) :
    g • E ≤ g • F
proof:
:=
  image_le_image h (g • ·)

name: le_inv_iff_smul_le
statement:
theorem le_inv_iff_smul_le {G : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G α] {E F : Enumeration α} (g : G) :
    E ≤ g⁻¹ • F ↔ g • E ≤ F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := smul_le_smul h g
    rwa [smul_inv_smul] at this
  · intro h
    have := smul_le_smul h g⁻¹
    rwa [inv_smul_smul] at this

name: eq_of_le
statement:
theorem eq_of_le {G : Type _} [SMul G α] {E F : Enumeration α} {g : G}
    (h₁ : g • E ≤ F) (h₂ : E ≤ F) : g • E = E
proof:
:= by
  refine ext' rfl ?_
  intro i _ hE
  rw [h₁.2 i hE (hE.trans_le h₁.1), h₂.2 i hE (hE.trans_le h₁.1)]

name: le_add
statement: theorem le_add (E F : Enumeration α) : E ≤ E + F
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [add_max, le_add_iff_nonneg_right]
    exact κ_pos _
  · intro i hE hF
    rw [add_f_left]

name: ord_lt_of_small
statement:
theorem ord_lt_of_small {s : Set α} (hs : Small s) [LinearOrder s] [IsWellOrder s (· < ·)] :
    type ((· < ·) : s → s → Prop) < type ((· < ·) : κ → κ → Prop)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra! h
  have := card_le_card h
  simp only [card_type] at this
  exact hs.not_le this

name: typein_lt_type_of_small
statement:
theorem typein_lt_type_of_small {s : Set α} (hs : Small s) [LinearOrder s] [IsWellOrder s (· < ·)]
    {i : κ} (hi : i < enum (· < ·) (type ((· < ·) : s → s → Prop)) (ord_lt_of_small hs)) :
    typein ((· < ·) : κ → κ → Prop) i < type ((· < ·) : s → s → Prop)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← typein_lt_typein (· < ·), typein_enum] at hi
  exact hi

name: ofSet'_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofSet'_coe (s : Set α) (hs : Small s) [LinearOrder s] [IsWellOrder s (· < ·)] :
    (ofSet' s hs : Set α) = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [ofSet', mem_carrier_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    exact Subtype.coe_prop _
  · rintro hx
    refine ⟨enum ((· < ·) : κ → κ → Prop) (typein ((· < ·) : s → s → Prop) ⟨x, hx⟩) ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (typein_lt_type _ _).trans (ord_lt_of_small hs)
    · rw [enum_lt_enum (r := ((· < ·) : κ → κ → Prop))]
      exact typein_lt_type _ _
    · simp only [typein_enum, enum_typein]

name: ofSet_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofSet_coe (s : Set α) (hs : Small s) :
    (ofSet s hs : Set α) = s
proof:
:=
  letI := (IsWellOrder.subtype_nonempty (σ := s)).some.prop
  letI := linearOrderOfSTO (IsWellOrder.subtype_nonempty (σ := s)).some.val
  ofSet'_coe s hs

name: mem_ofSet_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_ofSet_iff (s : Set α) (hs : Small s) (x : α) :
    x ∈ ofSet s hs ↔ x ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  change x ∈ (ofSet s hs : Set α) ↔ x ∈ s
  rw [ofSet_coe]

name: equiv_apply_mem
statement:
theorem equiv_apply_mem {S T : Sublitter} {a} {L : Litter}
    (h : (S.equiv T a : Atom) ∈ litterSet L) : T.litter = L
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Litter.litter_toSublitter L, ← Sublitter.inter_nonempty_iff]
  exact ⟨_, (S.equiv T a).prop, h⟩

name: equiv_apply_eq
statement:
theorem equiv_apply_eq {S T U V : Sublitter} {a b}
    (h : (S.equiv T a : Atom) = U.equiv V b) : T.litter = V.litter
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.coe_eq_iff] at h
  exact (equiv_apply_mem (T.subset h.choose)).symm

name: completeAtomMap_eq
statement: theorem completeAtomMap_eq : π.completeAtomMap A a = π.atomCompletion A a π.foaHypothesis
proof:
:=
  HypAction.fixAtom_eq _ _ _ _

name: completeNearLitterMap_eq
statement:
theorem completeNearLitterMap_eq :
    π.completeNearLitterMap A N = π.nearLitterCompletion A N π.foaHypothesis
proof:
:=
  HypAction.fixNearLitter_eq _ _ _ _

name: completeLitterMap_eq
statement:
theorem completeLitterMap_eq :
    π.completeLitterMap A L = π.litterCompletion A L π.foaHypothesis
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeLitterMap, completeNearLitterMap_eq]
  rfl

name: completeNearLitterMap_fst_eq
statement:
theorem completeNearLitterMap_fst_eq :
    (π.completeNearLitterMap A L.toNearLitter).1 = π.completeLitterMap A L
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: completeNearLitterMap_fst_eq'
statement:
@[simp]
theorem completeNearLitterMap_fst_eq' :
    (π.completeNearLitterMap A N).1 = π.completeLitterMap A N.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeNearLitterMap_eq, nearLitterCompletion, completeLitterMap_eq]

name: foaHypothesis_atomImage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foaHypothesis_atomImage {c : Address β} (h : ⟨A, inl a⟩ < c) :
    (π.foaHypothesis : HypAction c).atomImage A a h = π.completeAtomMap A a
proof:
:=

name: foaHypothesis_nearLitterImage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem foaHypothesis_nearLitterImage {c : Address β} (h : ⟨A, inr N⟩ < c) :
    (π.foaHypothesis : HypAction c).nearLitterImage A N h = π.completeNearLitterMap A N

:=

name: completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain
statement:
theorem completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain {A} {a} (h : a ∈ (π A).atomPerm.domain) :
    π.completeAtomMap A a = π A • a
proof: := by rw [completeAtomMap_eq, atomCompletion, dif_pos h]

name: completeAtomMap_eq_of_not_mem_domain
statement:
theorem completeAtomMap_eq_of_not_mem_domain {A} {a} (h : a ∉ (π A).atomPerm.domain) :
    π.completeAtomMap A a =
      ((π A).largestSublitter a.1).equiv ((π A).largestSublitter (π.completeLitterMap A a.1))
        ⟨a, (π A).mem_largestSublitter_of_not_mem_domain a h⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeAtomMap_eq, atomCompletion, dif_neg h]
  rfl

name: completeLitterMap_eq_of_inflexibleCoe
statement:
theorem completeLitterMap_eq_of_inflexibleCoe {A : ExtendedIndex β} {L : Litter}
    (h : InflexibleCoe A L) (h₁ h₂) :
    π.completeLitterMap A L =
      fuzz h.path.hδε
        ((ihAction (π.foaHypothesis : HypAction ⟨A, inr L.toNearLitter⟩)).hypothesisedAllowable
            h.path h₁ h₂ •
          h.t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeLitterMap_eq, litterCompletion_of_inflexibleCoe]

name: completeLitterMap_eq_of_inflexible_coe'
statement:
theorem completeLitterMap_eq_of_inflexible_coe' {A : ExtendedIndex β} {L : Litter}
    (h : InflexibleCoe A L) :
    π.completeLitterMap A L =
      if h' : _ ∧ _ then
        fuzz h.path.hδε
          ((ihAction (π.foaHypothesis : HypAction ⟨A, inr L.toNearLitter⟩)).hypothesisedAllowable
              h.path h'.1 h'.2 •
            h.t)
      else L
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeLitterMap_eq, litterCompletion_of_inflexibleCoe']

name: completeLitterMap_eq_of_inflexibleBot
statement:
theorem completeLitterMap_eq_of_inflexibleBot {A : ExtendedIndex β} {L : Litter}
    (h : InflexibleBot A L) :
    π.completeLitterMap A L =
      fuzz (show (⊥ : TypeIndex) ≠ (h.path.ε : Λ) from WithBot.bot_ne_coe)
        (π.completeAtomMap (h.path.B.cons (WithBot.bot_lt_coe _)) h.a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeLitterMap_eq, litterCompletion_of_inflexibleBot] <;> rfl

name: completeLitterMap_eq_of_flexible
statement:
theorem completeLitterMap_eq_of_flexible {A : ExtendedIndex β} {L : Litter} (h : Flexible A L) :
    π.completeLitterMap A L = BaseApprox.flexibleCompletion (π A) A • L
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeLitterMap_eq, litterCompletion_of_flexible _ _ _ _ h]

name: toStructPerm_bot
statement:
theorem toStructPerm_bot :
    (Allowable.toStructPerm : Allowable ⊥ → StructPerm ⊥) = Tree.toBotIso.toMonoidHom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: completeNearLitterMap_eq'
statement:
theorem completeNearLitterMap_eq' (A : ExtendedIndex β) (N : NearLitter) :
    (π.completeNearLitterMap A N : Set Atom) =
      (π.completeNearLitterMap A N.fst.toNearLitter : Set Atom) ∆
        (π.completeAtomMap A '' litterSet N.fst ∆ ↑N)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [completeNearLitterMap_eq, nearLitterCompletion, nearLitterCompletionMap,
    nearLitterHypothesis_eq, BaseApprox.coe_largestSublitter, mem_diff,
    foaHypothesis_atomImage, NearLitter.coe_mk, Subtype.coe_mk, Litter.coe_toNearLitter,
    Litter.toNearLitter_fst, symmDiff_self, bot_eq_empty, mem_empty_iff_false, false_and_iff,
    iUnion_neg', not_false_iff, iUnion_empty, symmDiff_empty]
  ext a : 1
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨ha₁ | ⟨a, ha₁, rfl⟩, ha₂⟩ | ⟨⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, _, ⟨⟨hb₁, hb₂⟩, rfl⟩, ha⟩, ha₂⟩)
    · refine' Or.inl ⟨Or.inl ha₁, _⟩
      simp only [mem_image, not_exists, not_and]
      intro b hb
      by_cases h : b ∈ (π A).atomPerm.domain
      · rw [completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain h]
        rintro rfl
        exact ha₁.2 ((π A).atomPerm.map_domain h)
      · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists, and_imp] at ha₂
        exact Ne.symm (ha₂ b hb h)
    · by_cases h : a ∈ litterSet N.fst
      · refine' Or.inl ⟨Or.inr ⟨a, ⟨h, ha₁.2⟩, rfl⟩, _⟩
        simp only [mem_image, not_exists, not_and]
        intro b hb
        by_cases hb' : b ∈ (π A).atomPerm.domain
        · rw [completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain hb']
          intro hab
          cases (π A).atomPerm.injOn hb' ha₁.2 hab
          obtain hb | hb := hb
          exact hb.2 ha₁.1
          exact hb.2 h
        · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists, and_imp] at ha₂
          exact Ne.symm (ha₂ b hb hb')
      · refine' Or.inr ⟨⟨a, Or.inr ⟨ha₁.1, h⟩, _⟩, _⟩
        · simp only [completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain ha₁.2]
        rintro (ha | ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩)
        · exact ha.2 ((π A).atomPerm.map_domain ha₁.2)
        · cases (π A).atomPerm.injOn hb₁.2 ha₁.2 hb₂
          exact h hb₁.1
    · simp only [mem_singleton_iff] at ha
      subst ha
      refine' Or.inr ⟨⟨b, hb₁, rfl⟩, _⟩
      contrapose! ha₂
      obtain ha₂ | ha₂ := ha₂
      · exact Or.inl ha₂
      obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := ha₂
      by_cases h : a ∈ N
      · rw [← ha₂]
        exact Or.inr ⟨a, ⟨h, ha₁.2⟩, rfl⟩
      rw [completeAtomMap_eq_of_not_mem_domain hb₂]
      simp only [mem_union, mem_diff, mem_litterSet, Sublitter.equiv_apply_fst_eq,
        BaseApprox.largestSublitter_litter]
      refine' Or.inl ⟨_, _⟩
      · suffices b ∈ litterSet N.fst by
          rw [mem_litterSet] at this
          rw [this, completeLitterMap_eq]
        obtain hb₁ | hb₁ := hb₁
        · exact hb₁.1
        · exfalso
          rw [completeAtomMap_eq_of_not_mem_domain hb₂] at ha₂
          have : π A • a ∈ _ := (π A).atomPerm.map_domain ha₁.2
          dsimp only at ha₂
          rw [ha₂] at this
          exact BaseApprox.not_mem_domain_of_mem_largestSublitter _
            (Sublitter.equiv_apply_mem _) this
      · exact BaseApprox.not_mem_domain_of_mem_largestSublitter _
          (Sublitter.equiv_apply_mem _)
  · rintro (⟨ha₁ | ⟨a, ha₁, rfl⟩, ha₂⟩ | ⟨⟨a, ha₁, rfl⟩, ha₂⟩)
    · refine' Or.inl ⟨Or.inl ha₁, _⟩
      simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists, and_imp]
      rintro b hb _ rfl
      exact ha₂ ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
    · refine' Or.inl ⟨_, _⟩
      · by_cases h : a ∈ N
        · exact Or.inr ⟨a, ⟨h, ha₁.2⟩, rfl⟩
        · simp only [mem_image, not_exists, not_and] at ha₂
          have := ha₂ a (Or.inl ⟨ha₁.1, h⟩)
          rw [completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain ha₁.2] at this
          cases this rfl
      · contrapose! ha₂
        obtain ⟨_, ⟨b, rfl⟩, _, ⟨hb, rfl⟩, ha₂⟩ := ha₂
        simp only [mem_singleton_iff] at ha₂
        rw [ha₂]
        exact ⟨b, hb.1, rfl⟩
    · rw [mem_union, not_or] at ha₂
      by_cases ha : a ∈ litterSet N.fst
      · have : a ∉ (π A).atomPerm.domain := by
          intro h
          refine' ha₂.2 ⟨a, ⟨ha, h⟩, _⟩
          simp only [completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain h]
        refine' Or.inr ⟨_, _⟩
        · exact ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, _, ⟨⟨ha₁, this⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
        · rintro (h | ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩)
          · exact ha₂.1 h
          simp only [completeAtomMap_eq_of_not_mem_domain this] at hb₂
          have : π A • b ∈ _ := (π A).atomPerm.map_domain hb₁.2
          rw [hb₂] at this
          exact
            BaseApprox.not_mem_domain_of_mem_largestSublitter _
              (Sublitter.equiv_apply_mem _) this
      · by_cases h : a ∈ (π A).atomPerm.domain
        · refine' Or.inl ⟨_, _⟩
          · simp only [completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain h]
            refine' Or.inr ⟨a, ⟨_, h⟩, rfl⟩
            obtain ha₁ | ha₁ := ha₁
            · cases ha ha₁.1
            · exact ha₁.1
          · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists, and_imp]
            intro b _ hb hab
            rw [completeAtomMap_eq_of_mem_domain h, completeAtomMap_eq_of_not_mem_domain hb] at hab
            have : π A • a ∈ _ := (π A).atomPerm.map_domain h
            rw [hab] at this
            exact
              BaseApprox.not_mem_domain_of_mem_largestSublitter _
                (Sublitter.equiv_apply_mem _) this
        · refine' Or.inr ⟨_, _⟩
          · exact ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, _, ⟨⟨ha₁, h⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
          rintro (h' | ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩)
          · exact ha₂.1 h'
          simp only [completeAtomMap_eq_of_not_mem_domain h] at hb₂
          have : π A • b ∈ _ := (π A).atomPerm.map_domain hb₁.2
          rw [hb₂] at this
          exact BaseApprox.not_mem_domain_of_mem_largestSublitter _
            (Sublitter.equiv_apply_mem _) this

name: completeNearLitterMap_toNearLitter_eq
statement:
theorem completeNearLitterMap_toNearLitter_eq (A : ExtendedIndex β) (L : Litter) :
    (completeNearLitterMap π A L.toNearLitter : Set Atom) =
      litterSet (completeLitterMap π A L) \ (π A).atomPerm.domain ∪
        π A • (litterSet L ∩ (π A).atomPerm.domain)
proof:
:= by
  rw [completeNearLitterMap_eq, nearLitterCompletion, NearLitter.coe_mk, Subtype.coe_mk,
    nearLitterCompletionMap]
  simp only [nearLitterHypothesis_eq, BaseApprox.coe_largestSublitter,
    Litter.coe_toNearLitter, mem_diff, Litter.toNearLitter_fst, symmDiff_self, bot_eq_empty,
    mem_empty_iff_false, false_and_iff, iUnion_neg', not_false_iff, iUnion_empty, symmDiff_empty]
  rw [completeLitterMap_eq]

name: eq_of_mem_completeNearLitterMap
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_completeNearLitterMap {L₁ L₂ : Litter} {A : ExtendedIndex β} (a : Atom)
    (ha₁ : a ∈ π.completeNearLitterMap A L₁.toNearLitter)
    (ha₂ : a ∈ π.completeNearLitterMap A L₂.toNearLitter) :
    π.completeLitterMap A L₁ = π.completeLitterMap A L₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [← SetLike.mem_coe, completeNearLitterMap_toNearLitter_eq] at ha₁ ha₂
  obtain ⟨ha₁, ha₁'⟩ | ha₁ := ha₁ <;> obtain ⟨ha₂, ha₂'⟩ | ha₂ := ha₂
  · exact eq_of_mem_litterSet_of_mem_litterSet ha₁ ha₂
  · obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := ha₂
    cases ha₁' ((π A).atomPerm.map_domain hb.2)
  · obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := ha₁
    cases ha₂' ((π A).atomPerm.map_domain hb.2)
  · obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := ha₁
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc'⟩ := ha₂
    cases (π A).atomPerm.injOn hc.2 hb.2 hc'
    rw [eq_of_mem_litterSet_of_mem_litterSet hb.1 hc.1]

name: eq_of_completeLitterMap_inter_nonempty
statement:

          π.completeNearLitterMap A L₂.toNearLitter).Nonempty) :
    π.completeLitterMap A L₁ = π.completeLitterMap A L₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := h
  exact eq_of_mem_completeNearLitterMap a ha₁ ha₂

name: litterCompletion_of_flexible
statement:
theorem litterCompletion_of_flexible (π : StructApprox β) (A : ExtendedIndex β) (L : Litter)
    (H : HypAction ⟨A, inr L.toNearLitter⟩) (hflex : Flexible A L) :
    litterCompletion π A L H = BaseApprox.flexibleCompletion (π A) A • L
proof:
:= by
  rw [litterCompletion, dif_neg, dif_neg]
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨γ, ε, hε, C, rfl⟩, a, rfl⟩⟩
    exact hflex (Inflexible.mk_bot hε _ _)
  · rintro ⟨⟨⟨γ, δ, ε, hδ, hε, hδε, C, rfl⟩, t, rfl⟩⟩
    exact hflex (Inflexible.mk_coe hδ hε hδε _ _)

name: litterCompletion_of_inflexibleCoe'
statement:
theorem litterCompletion_of_inflexibleCoe' (π : StructApprox β) (A : ExtendedIndex β) (L : Litter)
    (H : HypAction ⟨A, inr L.toNearLitter⟩) (h : InflexibleCoe A L) :
    litterCompletion π A L H =
      if h' : _ ∧ _ then
        fuzz h.path.hδε ((ihAction H).hypothesisedAllowable h.path h'.1 h'.2 • h.t)
      else L
proof:
:= by
  
  
  rw [litterCompletion, dif_pos ⟨h⟩]
  have h' : Nonempty (InflexibleCoe A L) := ⟨h⟩
  have : h = Nonempty.some h' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  subst this
  rfl

name: litterCompletion_of_inflexibleCoe
statement:
theorem litterCompletion_of_inflexibleCoe (π : StructApprox β) (A : ExtendedIndex β) (L : Litter)
    (H : HypAction ⟨A, inr L.toNearLitter⟩) (h : InflexibleCoe A L)
    (h₁ : StructLAction.Lawful ((ihAction H).comp (h.path.B.cons h.path.hδ)))
    (h₂ : StructLAction.MapFlexible ((ihAction H).comp (h.path.B.cons h.path.hδ))) :
    litterCompletion π A L H =
      fuzz h.path.hδε ((ihAction H).hypothesisedAllowable h.path h₁ h₂ • h.t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [litterCompletion_of_inflexibleCoe', dif_pos]
  · refine' ⟨_, _⟩
    · rw [Subsingleton.elim h] at h₁
      exact h₁
    · rw [Subsingleton.elim h] at h₂
      exact h₂

name: litterCompletion_of_inflexibleBot
statement:
theorem litterCompletion_of_inflexibleBot (π : StructApprox β) (A : ExtendedIndex β) (L : Litter)
    (H : HypAction ⟨A, inr L.toNearLitter⟩) (h : InflexibleBot A L) :
    litterCompletion π A L H =
      fuzz (show (⊥ : TypeIndex) ≠ (h.path.ε : Λ) from bot_ne_coe)
        (H.atomImage (h.path.B.cons (bot_lt_coe _)) h.a h.constrains)
proof:
:= by
  rw [litterCompletion, dif_neg, dif_pos, Subsingleton.elim h]
  · exact ⟨h⟩
  · rintro ⟨h'⟩
    exact inflexibleBot_inflexibleCoe h h'

name: nearLitterCompletionMap_isNearLitter
statement:
theorem nearLitterCompletionMap_isNearLitter (π : StructApprox β) (A : ExtendedIndex β)
    (N : NearLitter) (H : HypAction ⟨A, inr N⟩) :
    IsNearLitter (π.litterCompletion A N.fst (nearLitterHypothesis A N H))
      (π.nearLitterCompletionMap A N H)
proof:
:= by
  rw [nearLitterCompletionMap, IsNearLitter, IsNear, BaseApprox.coe_largestSublitter,
    ← symmDiff_assoc, symmDiff_comm, ← Small.symmDiff_iff _]
  · rw [Set.symmDiff_def, ← diff_diff, sdiff_sdiff_right_self, union_diff_distrib,
      sdiff_sdiff_self, bot_eq_empty, empty_union]
    exact Small.union (Small.mono diff_subset ((π A).domain_small _))
      (Small.mono diff_subset (BaseApprox.nearLitter_domain_small _ _).image)
  · exact Small.bUnion (Small.mono diff_subset N.2.prop) fun _ _ => small_singleton _

    hπ.symm_map_atom a (hπ.exception_mem a h)]
  exact h

name: ExactlyApproximates.mem_litterSet
proof: := by contrapose! ha; exact hπ.exception_mem _ (Or.inl ha)

name: ExactlyApproximates.mem_litterSet_inv
proof: := by contrapose! ha; exact hπ.exception_mem _ (Or.inr ha)

name: exists_sandbox_subset
statement:
theorem exists_sandbox_subset (hs : #(s ∆ (f '' s) : Set α) ≤ #t) (ht : ℵ₀ ≤ #t) :
    #((ℕ × (s \ f '' s : Set α)) ⊕ (ℕ × (f '' s \ s : Set α))) ≤ #t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.symmDiff_def, mk_union_of_disjoint] at hs
  · simp only [mk_sum, mk_prod, mk_denumerable, lift_aleph0, lift_uzero, lift_id, ← mul_add] at hs ⊢
    exact le_trans (mul_le_max_of_aleph0_le_left le_rfl) (max_le ht hs)
  · rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
    exact fun x hx => hx.1.2 hx.2.1

name: sandboxSubset_subset
statement: theorem sandboxSubset_subset : sandboxSubset hs ht ⊆ t
proof:
:=
  (le_mk_iff_exists_subset.mp <| exists_sandbox_subset hs ht).choose_spec.1

name: completeToFun_domain
statement:
theorem completeToFun_domain (x : α) (h : x ∈ completeDomain hs ht) :
    completeToFun hs ht x ∈ completeDomain hs ht
proof:
:= by
  unfold completeToFun completeDomain
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂
  case pos =>
    cases sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h₁⟩ with
    | inl val =>
      obtain ⟨_ | n, x⟩ := val
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inl x.prop.1)
      · exact Or.inr ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop
    | inr val =>
      obtain ⟨n, x⟩ := val
      exact Or.inr ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop
  case pos =>
    exact Or.inr ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop
  case neg =>
    rw [mem_diff, not_and_or, Classical.not_not] at h₂
    refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨x, ?_, rfl⟩)
    obtain (h₂ | h₂) := h₂
    · obtain (h | h) | h := h
      exact h
      cases h₂ h
      cases h₁ h
    · exact h₂

name: completeInvFun_domain
statement:
theorem completeInvFun_domain [Nonempty α] (x : α) (h : x ∈ completeDomain hs ht) :
    completeInvFun hs ht x ∈ completeDomain hs ht
proof:
:= by
  unfold completeInvFun completeDomain
  split_ifs with h₁ h₂
  case pos =>
    cases sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h₁⟩ with
    | inl val =>
      obtain ⟨n, x⟩ := val
      exact Or.inr ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop
    | inr val =>
      obtain ⟨_ | n, x⟩ := val
      · exact Or.inl (Or.inr x.prop.1)
      · exact Or.inr ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop
  case pos =>
    exact Or.inr ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop
  case neg =>
    rw [mem_diff, not_and_or, Classical.not_not] at h₂
    obtain (h₂ | h₂) := h₂
    · rw [completeDomain] at h
      obtain (h | h) | h := h
      cases h₂ h
      · refine Or.inl (Or.inl ?_)
        simp only [mem_image] at h
        exact invFunOn_mem h
      cases h₁ h
    simp only [mem_image] at h₂
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl (invFunOn_mem h₂))

name: complete_left_inv
statement:
theorem complete_left_inv [Nonempty α] (hst : Disjoint (s ∪ f '' s) t) (hf : InjOn f s) (x : α)
    (h : x ∈ completeDomain hs ht) : completeInvFun hs ht (completeToFun hs ht x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hst
  by_cases h₁ : x ∈ s
  · rw [completeToFun, dif_neg, dif_neg, completeInvFun, dif_neg, dif_neg]
    · exact hf (invFunOn_apply_mem h₁) h₁
          (show f (invFunOn f s (f x)) = f x from invFunOn_apply_eq h₁)
    · exact fun h' => h'.2 ⟨x, h₁, rfl⟩
    · exact fun hx => hst (f x) ⟨Or.inr ⟨x, h₁, rfl⟩, sandboxSubset_subset hs ht hx⟩
    · exact fun h' => h'.2 h₁
    · exact fun hx => hst x ⟨Or.inl h₁, sandboxSubset_subset hs ht hx⟩
  by_cases h₂ : x ∈ f '' s
  · rw [completeToFun, dif_neg, dif_pos, completeInvFun, dif_pos]
    simp only [Subtype.coe_prop, Subtype.coe_eta, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
    · exact ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop
    · exact ⟨h₂, h₁⟩
    · exact fun h => hst x ⟨Or.inr h₂, sandboxSubset_subset hs ht h⟩
  obtain (h | h) | h := h
  · cases h₁ h
  · cases h₂ h
  rw [completeToFun, dif_pos h, completeInvFun]
  by_cases h₃ : ∃ a, sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h⟩ = Sum.inl ⟨0, a⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₃
    rw [dif_neg, dif_pos, Subtype.coe_eq_iff]
    refine' ⟨h, _⟩
    simp only [ha]
    · rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
      · simp only [ha, Sum.inl.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
        rfl
    · rw [ha]
      exact a.prop
    · rw [ha]
      exact fun h => hst _ ⟨Or.inl a.prop.1, sandboxSubset_subset hs ht h⟩
  have h₄ :
    (∃ n a, sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h⟩ = Sum.inl ⟨n + 1, a⟩) ∨
      ∃ n a, sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h⟩ = Sum.inr ⟨n, a⟩
  · set val := sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h⟩
    clear_value val
    obtain ⟨_ | n, b⟩ | ⟨n, b⟩ := val
    cases h₃ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact Or.inl ⟨n, b, rfl⟩
    exact Or.inr ⟨n, b, rfl⟩
  obtain (h₄ | h₄) := h₄ <;>
    · obtain ⟨n, a, ha⟩ := h₄
      rw [dif_pos]
      simp only [ha]
      unfold shiftRight
      simp only [Subtype.coe_eta, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact Subtype.coe_inj.mpr ((Equiv.symm_apply_eq _).mpr ha.symm)
      rw [ha]
      exact ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop

name: complete_right_inv
statement:
theorem complete_right_inv [Nonempty α] (hst : Disjoint (s ∪ f '' s) t) (hf : InjOn f s) (x : α)
    (h : x ∈ completeDomain hs ht) : completeToFun hs ht (completeInvFun hs ht x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hst
  by_cases h₁ : x ∈ f '' s
  · rw [completeInvFun, dif_neg, dif_neg, completeToFun, dif_neg, dif_neg]
    · exact invFunOn_eq h₁
    · exact fun h' => h'.2 (invFunOn_mem h₁)
    · exact fun hx => hst _ ⟨Or.inl (invFunOn_mem h₁), sandboxSubset_subset hs ht hx⟩
    · exact fun h' => h'.2 h₁
    · exact fun hx => hst x ⟨Or.inr h₁, sandboxSubset_subset hs ht hx⟩
  by_cases h₂ : x ∈ s
  · rw [completeInvFun, dif_neg, dif_pos, completeToFun, dif_pos]
    simp only [Subtype.coe_prop, Subtype.coe_eta, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl
    · exact ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop
    · exact ⟨h₂, h₁⟩
    · exact fun h => hst x ⟨Or.inl h₂, sandboxSubset_subset hs ht h⟩
  obtain (h | h) | h := h
  · cases h₂ h
  · cases h₁ h
  rw [completeInvFun, dif_pos h, completeToFun]
  by_cases h₃ : ∃ a, sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h⟩ = Sum.inr ⟨0, a⟩
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := h₃
    rw [dif_neg, dif_pos, Subtype.coe_eq_iff]
    refine' ⟨h, _⟩
    simp only [ha]
    · rw [Equiv.symm_apply_eq]
      · simp only [ha, Sum.inr.injEq, Prod.mk.injEq, true_and]
        rfl
    · rw [ha]
      exact a.prop
    · rw [ha]
      exact fun h => hst _ ⟨Or.inr a.prop.1, sandboxSubset_subset hs ht h⟩
  have h₄ :
    (∃ n a, sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h⟩ = Sum.inr ⟨n + 1, a⟩) ∨
      ∃ n a, sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h⟩ = Sum.inl ⟨n, a⟩
  · set val := sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht ⟨x, h⟩
    clear_value val
    obtain ⟨n, b⟩ | ⟨_ | n, b⟩ := val
    exact Or.inr ⟨n, b, rfl⟩
    cases h₃ ⟨b, rfl⟩
    exact Or.inl ⟨n, b, rfl⟩
  obtain (h₄ | h₄) := h₄ <;>
    · obtain ⟨n, a, ha⟩ := h₄
      rw [dif_pos]
      simp only [ha]
      unfold shiftLeft
      simp only [Subtype.coe_eta, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      exact Subtype.coe_inj.mpr ((Equiv.symm_apply_eq _).mpr ha.symm)
      rw [ha]
      exact ((sandboxSubsetEquiv hs ht).symm _).prop

name: completeDomain_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem completeDomain_eq : (complete f s t hs ht hst hf).domain = completeDomain hs ht
proof:

name: mem_completeDomain_of_mem
statement: theorem mem_completeDomain_of_mem (x : α) (hx : x ∈ s) : x ∈ completeDomain hs ht

name: mem_completeDomain_of_mem_image
statement: theorem mem_completeDomain_of_mem_image (x : α) (hx : x ∈ f '' s) : x ∈ completeDomain hs ht

name: not_mem_sandbox_of_mem
statement:
theorem not_mem_sandbox_of_mem (hst : Disjoint (s ∪ f '' s) t) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ s) :
    x ∉ sandboxSubset hs ht
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hst
  exact hst x ⟨Or.inl hx, sandboxSubset_subset hs ht h⟩

name: not_mem_sandbox_of_mem_image
statement:
theorem not_mem_sandbox_of_mem_image (hst : Disjoint (s ∪ f '' s) t) (x : α) (hx : x ∈ f '' s) :
    x ∉ sandboxSubset hs ht
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem] at hst

name: complete_apply_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem complete_apply_eq (x : α) (hx : x ∈ s) : complete f s t hs ht hst hf x = f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [complete, coe_mk, completeToFun, dif_neg, dif_neg]

name: not_constrains_flexible
statement:
theorem not_constrains_flexible {β : Λ} (c : Address β)
    {A : ExtendedIndex β} {L : Litter} (hL : Flexible A L) :
    ¬c ≺ ⟨A, inr L.toNearLitter⟩
proof:
:= by
  rintro (⟨A, a⟩ | ⟨A, N, hN⟩ | ⟨A, N, a, ha⟩ | ⟨A, L, h, c, hc⟩ | ⟨A, L, h⟩)
  · exact hN (NearLitter.IsLitter.mk _)
  · obtain (ha | ha) := ha
    · cases ha.2 ha.1
    · cases ha.2 ha.1
  · exact hL (inflexible_of_inflexibleCoe h)
  · exact hL (inflexible_of_inflexibleBot h)

name: Address.pos_atom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Address.pos_atom (A : ExtendedIndex β) (a : Atom) :
    Address.pos ⟨A, inl a⟩ = Position.pos a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Address.pos_nearLitter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Address.pos_nearLitter (A : ExtendedIndex β) (N : NearLitter) :
    Address.pos ⟨A, inr N⟩ = Position.pos N
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Constrains.hasPosition_lt
statement:
theorem Constrains.hasPosition_lt {c d : Address β} (h : c ≺ d) :
    c.pos < d.pos
proof:
:= by
  cases h
  case atom A a => exact BasePositions.lt_pos_atom a
  case nearLitter A N hN => exact BasePositions.lt_pos_litter N hN
  case symmDiff A N a ha => exact BasePositions.lt_pos_symmDiff a N ha
  case fuzz A L h c hc' =>
    have := pos_lt_pos_fuzz_nearLitter h.path.hδε h.t (ConNF.fuzz h.path.hδε h.t).toNearLitter rfl
    obtain ⟨B, a | N⟩ := c
    · simp only [Address.pos_atom, Address.pos_nearLitter, h.hL]
      exact (pos_lt_pos_atom _ hc').trans this
    · simp only [Address.pos_nearLitter, h.hL]
      by_cases h' : h.t.set = typedNearLitter N
      · exact (pos_typedNearLitter N h.t h').trans_lt this
      · exact (pos_lt_pos_nearLitter _ hc' h').trans this
  case fuzzBot A L h =>
    simp only [Address.pos_atom, Address.pos_nearLitter, h.hL]
    exact pos_lt_pos_fuzz_nearLitter (bot_ne_coe (a := h.path.ε)) h.a
      (ConNF.fuzz (bot_ne_coe (a := h.path.ε)) h.a).toNearLitter rfl

name: constrains_subrelation
statement:
theorem constrains_subrelation (β : Λ) :
    Subrelation ((· ≺ ·) : Address β → _ → Prop) (InvImage (· < ·) Address.pos)
proof:
:=
  Constrains.hasPosition_lt

name: constrains_wf
statement: theorem constrains_wf (β : Λ) : WellFounded ((· ≺ ·) : Address β → _ → Prop)
proof:
:=
  Subrelation.wf (constrains_subrelation β) (InvImage.wf _ Params.μ_isWellOrder.wf)

name: constrains_atom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem constrains_atom {c : Address β} {A : ExtendedIndex β} {a : Atom} :
    c ≺ ⟨A, inl a⟩ ↔ c = ⟨A, inr a.1.toNearLitter⟩
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟩
    rfl
  · rintro rfl
    exact Constrains.atom A a

name: constrains_nearLitter
statement:
theorem constrains_nearLitter {c : Address β} {A : ExtendedIndex β}
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : ¬N.IsLitter) :
    c ≺ ⟨A, inr N⟩ ↔ c = ⟨A, inr N.1.toNearLitter⟩ ∨
      ∃ a ∈ litterSet N.fst ∆ N.snd, c = ⟨A, inl a⟩
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [constrains_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨A, a, rfl, hc⟩ | ⟨A, N, hN, rfl, hc⟩ | ⟨A, N, a, ha, rfl, hc⟩ |
        ⟨A, L, h, c, hc, rfl, h'⟩ | ⟨A, L, h, rfl, h'⟩ := h
    · cases hc
    · cases hc
      exact Or.inl rfl
    · cases hc
      exact Or.inr ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    · cases hc
      cases h'
      cases hN (NearLitter.IsLitter.mk _)
    · cases h'
      cases hN (NearLitter.IsLitter.mk _)
  · rintro (rfl | ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩)
    · exact Constrains.nearLitter A N hN
    · exact Constrains.symmDiff A N a ha

name: constrains_comp
statement:
theorem constrains_comp {β γ : Λ} {c d : Address γ} (h : c ≺ d)
    (B : Path (β : TypeIndex) γ) : ⟨B.comp c.path, c.value⟩ ≺ ⟨B.comp d.path, d.value⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, a⟩ | ⟨A, N, hN⟩ | ⟨A, N, a, ha⟩ | ⟨A, L, h, c, hc⟩ | ⟨A, L, h⟩ := h
  · exact Constrains.atom _ _
  · exact Constrains.nearLitter _ _ hN
  · exact Constrains.symmDiff _ _ _ ha
  · convert Constrains.fuzz (B.comp A) L (h.comp B) c hc using 2
    simp only [InflexibleCoe.comp_path, InflexibleCoePath.comp_B, ← Path.comp_cons, Path.comp_assoc]
  · exact Constrains.fuzzBot (B.comp A) L (h.comp B)

name: Address.le_iff
statement:
theorem Address.le_iff {c d : Address β} :
    c ≤ d ↔ Relation.ReflTransGen (· ≺ ·) c d
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Address.lt_iff
statement:
theorem Address.lt_iff {c d : Address β} :
    c < d ↔ Relation.TransGen (· ≺ ·) c d
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: not_transConstrains_flexible
statement:
theorem not_transConstrains_flexible {β : Λ} (c : Address β)
    {A : ExtendedIndex β} {L : Litter} (hL : Flexible A L) :
    ¬c < ⟨A, inr L.toNearLitter⟩
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨d, _, hd⟩ := Relation.TransGen.tail'_iff.mp h
  exact not_constrains_flexible d hL hd

name: InflexibleBot.constrains
proof:
:=
  Relation.TransGen.single (Constrains.fuzzBot A L h)

name: le_comp
statement:
theorem le_comp {β γ : Λ} {c d : Address γ} (h : c ≤ d)
    (B : Path (β : TypeIndex) γ) :
    (⟨B.comp c.path, c.value⟩ : Address β) ≤ ⟨B.comp d.path, d.value⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | tail _ h ih => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.tail ih (constrains_comp h B)

name: lt_comp
statement:
theorem lt_comp {β γ : Λ} {c d : Address γ} (h : c < d)
    (B : Path (β : TypeIndex) γ) :
    (⟨B.comp c.path, c.value⟩ : Address β) < ⟨B.comp d.path, d.value⟩
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | single h => exact Relation.TransGen.single (constrains_comp h B)
  | tail _ h ih => exact Relation.TransGen.tail ih (constrains_comp h B)

name: le_nearLitter
statement:
theorem le_nearLitter {β : Λ} {N : NearLitter} {B : ExtendedIndex β}
    {c : Address β} (h : ⟨B, inr N⟩ ≤ c) : ⟨B, inr N.1.toNearLitter⟩ ≤ c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : N.IsLitter
  · obtain ⟨L, rfl⟩ := h'.exists_litter_eq
    exact h
  · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head (Constrains.nearLitter B N h') h

name: lt_nearLitter
statement:
theorem lt_nearLitter {β : Λ} {N : NearLitter} {B : ExtendedIndex β}
    {c : Address β} (h : c < ⟨B, inr N.1.toNearLitter⟩) : c < ⟨B, inr N⟩
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : N.IsLitter
  · obtain ⟨L, rfl⟩ := h'.exists_litter_eq
    exact h
  · exact Relation.TransGen.tail h (Constrains.nearLitter B N h')

name: lt_nearLitter'
statement:
theorem lt_nearLitter' {β : Λ} {N : NearLitter} {B : ExtendedIndex β}
    {c : Address β} (h : ⟨B, inr N⟩ < c) : ⟨B, inr N.1.toNearLitter⟩ < c
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h' : N.IsLitter
  · obtain ⟨L, rfl⟩ := h'.exists_litter_eq
    exact h
  · exact Relation.TransGen.head (Constrains.nearLitter B N h') h

name: small_constrains
statement: theorem small_constrains {β : Λ} (c : Address β) : Small {d | d ≺ c}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, a | N⟩ := c
  · simp only [constrains_atom, setOf_eq_eq_singleton, small_singleton]
  simp_rw [constrains_iff]
  refine Small.union ?_ (Small.union ?_ (Small.union ?_ (Small.union ?_ ?_))) <;>
    rw [small_setOf]
  · change Small {c | ∃ b B, _ ∧ _ = _}
    simp only [Address.mk.injEq, false_and, and_false, exists_false,
      setOf_false, small_empty]
  · change Small {c | ∃ B N', _}
    refine Set.Subsingleton.small ?_
    rintro c ⟨_, _, _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h₁⟩ d ⟨_, _, _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h₂⟩
    cases h₁
    cases h₂
    rfl
  · change Small {c | ∃ B N' a, _}
    convert (show Small (litterSet N.fst ∆ N) from N.2.prop).image
      (f := fun a : Atom => (⟨A, inl a⟩ : Address β)) using 1
    ext c : 1
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, mem_image]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨B, N', a, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
      cases h₃
      exact ⟨a, h₁, h₂.symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, h₁, h₂⟩
      exact ⟨A, N, a, h₁, h₂.symm, rfl⟩
  · obtain (h' | h') := isEmpty_or_nonempty (InflexibleCoe A N.1)
    · refine small_of_forall_not_mem ?_
      rintro x ⟨A, L, h, c, hc', rfl, h''⟩
      cases h''
      exact h'.elim h
    · obtain ⟨h⟩ := h'
      refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ h.t.support.small
      suffices
        #{a : Address β | ∃ c : (h.t.support : Set (Address h.path.δ)),
            a = ⟨(h.path.B.cons h.path.hδ).comp c.val.path, c.val.value⟩} ≤
          #(h.t.support : Set (Address h.path.δ)) by
        refine le_trans (Cardinal.mk_subtype_le_of_subset ?_) this
        rintro x ⟨_, _, h', c, hc, rfl, h''⟩
        cases h''
        cases Subsingleton.elim h h'
        exact ⟨⟨c, hc⟩, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨⟨fun a => a.prop.choose, ?_⟩⟩
      intro a b h
      refine Subtype.coe_inj.mp ?_
      rw [a.prop.choose_spec, b.prop.choose_spec]
      simp only [h]
  · refine Set.Subsingleton.small ?_
    rintro ⟨c, C⟩ ⟨_, _, h₁, c₁, hc₁⟩ ⟨d, D⟩ ⟨_, _, h₂, c₂, hc₂⟩
    cases hc₁
    cases hc₂
    cases Subsingleton.elim h₁ h₂
    cases c₂
    exact c₁

name: small_nthClosure
statement:
theorem small_nthClosure {S : Set (Address β)} {n : ℕ} (h : Small S) :
    Small (nthClosure S n)
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n hn
  exact h
  rw [nthClosure]
  simp_rw [← exists_prop, Subtype.exists', setOf_exists]
  refine' small_iUnion hn _
  rintro ⟨c, _⟩
  exact small_constrains c

name: mem_nthClosure_iff
statement:
theorem mem_nthClosure_iff {S : Set (Address β)} {n : ℕ} {c : Address β} :
    c ∈ nthClosure S n ↔
      ∃ l, List.Chain (· ≺ ·) c l ∧
        l.length = n ∧ (c::l).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _) ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n hn generalizing c
  · rw [nthClosure]
    constructor
    · intro h
      exact ⟨[], List.Chain.nil, rfl, h⟩
    · rintro ⟨l, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
      rw [List.length_eq_zero] at h₂
      cases h₂
      exact h₃
  · simp only [nthClosure, mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂⟩
      obtain ⟨l, hl₁, hl₂, hl₃⟩ := hn.mp hd₁
      refine' ⟨d::l, List.Chain.cons hd₂ hl₁, _, _⟩
      · rw [List.length_cons, hl₂]
      · rw [List.getLast_cons]
        exact hl₃
    · rintro ⟨_ | ⟨d, l⟩, hl₁, hl₂, hl₃⟩
      · cases hl₂
      obtain _ | ⟨hcd, hl₁⟩ := hl₁
      rw [List.getLast_cons] at hl₃
      have := hn.mpr ⟨l, hl₁, Nat.succ.inj hl₂, hl₃⟩
      exact ⟨d, this, hcd⟩

name: reflTransClosure_eq_iUnion_nthClosure
statement:
theorem reflTransClosure_eq_iUnion_nthClosure {S : Set (Address β)} :
    reflTransClosure S = ⋃ n, nthClosure S n
proof:
:= by
  refine' subset_antisymm _ _
  · rintro c ⟨d, hdS, hd⟩
    obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := List.exists_chain_of_relationReflTransGen hd
    rw [mem_iUnion]
    refine' ⟨l.length, _⟩
    rw [mem_nthClosure_iff]
    refine' ⟨l, hl, rfl, hdS⟩
  · intro c hc
    rw [mem_iUnion] at hc
    obtain ⟨i, hc⟩ := hc
    rw [mem_nthClosure_iff] at hc
    obtain ⟨l, hl₁, _hl₂, hl₃⟩ := hc
    exact
      ⟨(c::l).getLast (List.cons_ne_nil _ _), hl₃,
        List.relationReflTransGen_of_exists_chain l hl₁ rfl⟩

name: reflTransClosure_small
statement:
theorem reflTransClosure_small {S : Set (Address β)} (h : Small S) :
    Small (reflTransClosure S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflTransClosure_eq_iUnion_nthClosure]
  have : Small (⋃ n : ULift ℕ, nthClosure S n.down)
  · refine' small_iUnion _ fun _ => small_nthClosure h
    rw [Cardinal.mk_denumerable]
    exact Params.aleph0_lt_mk_κ
  convert this using 1
  ext x : 1
  simp only [mem_iUnion, ULift.exists]

  rintro c ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂⟩
  exact ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂.to_reflTransGen⟩

name: mk_S_eq_
statement: theorem mk_S_eq_κ (S : Sublitter) : #S.carrier = #κ

  obtain (h | h) := lt_or_eq_of_le this
  · have := mk_diff_add_mk S.subset
    rw [mk_litterSet] at this
    cases (add_lt_of_lt Params.κ_isRegular.aleph0_le S.diff_small h).ne this
  · exact h

  refine le_antisymm ((Cardinal.mk_subtype_le _).trans mk_litter.le) ?_
  refine ⟨⟨fun ν => ⟨⟨ν, ⊥, α, bot_ne_coe⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro h
    rw [inflexible_iff] at h
    obtain ⟨γ, _, δ, _, ε, _, _, hε, hδε, A, t, rfl, h⟩ | ⟨γ, _, ε, _, hε, A, t, rfl, h⟩ := h
    all_goals
      apply_fun Litter.γ at h
      rw [fuzz_γ _ _] at h
      exact ne_of_lt (coe_lt_coe.mp LtLevel.elim) h.symm
  · intro ν₁ ν₂ h
    simp only [coe_setOf, mem_setOf_eq, Subtype.mk.injEq, Litter.mk.injEq, and_self, and_true] at h
    exact h

  obtain ⟨hδ, hε, hδε, B, t⟩ | ⟨hε, B, a⟩ := h

theorem flexible_iff_not_inflexibleBot_inflexibleCoe {β : Λ} {A : ExtendedIndex β}
    {L : Litter} :
    Flexible A L ↔ IsEmpty (InflexibleBot A L) ∧ IsEmpty (InflexibleCoe A L)

  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨⟨fun h' => h (inflexible_of_inflexibleBot h')⟩,
      ⟨fun h' => h (inflexible_of_inflexibleCoe h')⟩⟩
  · intro h₁ h₂
    obtain h | h := inflexibleBot_or_inflexibleCoe_of_inflexible h₂
    · exact h₁.1.false h.some
    · exact h₁.2.false h.some

  exact flexible_cases A L
