    exact lt_trans ξ.bannedLitter_small Params.κ_lt_μ

name: not_bannedLitter_nonempty
statement: theorem not_bannedLitter_nonempty (ξ : BaseNLAction) : Nonempty {L | ¬ξ.BannedLitter L}
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← mk_ne_zero_iff, mk_not_bannedLitter, ne_eq, mk_ne_zero, not_false_iff]

name: sandboxLitter_not_banned
statement: theorem sandboxLitter_not_banned (ξ : BaseNLAction) : ¬ξ.BannedLitter ξ.sandboxLitter
proof:
:=
  ξ.not_bannedLitter_nonempty.some.prop

name: mem_innerAtoms_iff
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hL
  rw [innerAtoms]
  aesop

name: mem_outerAtoms_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_outerAtoms_iff {ξ : BaseNLAction} (L : Litter) (a : Atom) :
    a ∈ ξ.outerAtoms L ↔ a.1 = L ∧ ∀ N, (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom → a ∉ N
proof:
:=
  by simp only [outerAtoms, mem_diff, mem_litterSet, mem_iUnion, SetLike.mem_coe,
    exists_prop, not_exists, not_and]

name: mem_allOuterAtoms_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_allOuterAtoms_iff {ξ : BaseNLAction} (a : Atom) :
    a ∈ ξ.allOuterAtoms ↔ ξ.LitterPresent a.1 ∧ ∀ N, (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom → a ∉ N
proof:
:=
  by simp only [allOuterAtoms, mem_iUnion, mem_outerAtoms_iff, exists_and_left,
    exists_prop, exists_eq_left']

name: litterPresent_small
statement: theorem litterPresent_small (ξ : BaseNLAction) : Small {L | ξ.LitterPresent L}
proof:
:= by
  have : Small (⋃ (N : NearLitter) (_ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom), {N.1})
  · refine Small.bUnion ξ.nearLitterMap_dom_small ?_
    simp only [PFun.mem_dom, small_singleton, forall_exists_index, implies_true, forall_const]
  refine Small.mono ?_ this
  simp only [LitterPresent]
  rintro _ ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨_, ⟨N, rfl⟩, _, ⟨hN, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: litterPresent_small'
statement:
theorem litterPresent_small' (ξ : BaseNLAction) :
    Small {N : NearLitter | N.IsLitter ∧ ∃ N', (nearLitterMap ξ N').Dom ∧ N'.fst = N.fst}
proof:
:= by
  have : Small {L | ∃ N, (nearLitterMap ξ N).Dom ∧ N.fst = L}
  · refine (ξ.nearLitterMap_dom_small.image (f := fun N => N.1)).mono ?_
    rintro _ ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩
  refine (this.image (f := Litter.toNearLitter)).mono ?_
  rintro _ ⟨⟨L⟩, N, hN, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨N.1, ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: innerAtoms_small
statement:
theorem innerAtoms_small {ξ : BaseNLAction} (L : Litter) (hL : ξ.LitterPresent L) :
    Small (ξ.innerAtoms L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hL
  refine Small.mono (biInter_subset_of_mem ⟨hN, rfl⟩) ?_
  exact Small.mono (fun _ => Or.inr) N.2.prop

name: outerAtoms_small
statement:
theorem outerAtoms_small {ξ : BaseNLAction} (L : Litter) (hL : ξ.LitterPresent L) :
    Small (ξ.outerAtoms L)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hL
  rw [outerAtoms]
  refine Small.mono ?_ (Small.mono (fun _ => Or.inl) N.2.prop)
  refine Set.diff_subset_diff_right ?_
  intro a ha
  exact ⟨_, ⟨N, rfl⟩, _, ⟨hN, rfl⟩, ha⟩

name: allOuterAtoms_small
statement: theorem allOuterAtoms_small {ξ : BaseNLAction} : Small ξ.allOuterAtoms
proof:
:=
  Small.bUnion ξ.litterPresent_small ξ.outerAtoms_small

name: mem_innerAtomsCod_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_innerAtomsCod_iff {ξ : BaseNLAction} (L : Litter) (a : Atom) :
    a ∈ ξ.innerAtomsCod L ↔ (∀ N (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom ∧ N.1 = L),
      a ∈ (ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN.1) ∧ a ∉ ξ.atomMap.ran
proof:
:=
  by simp only [innerAtomsCod, mem_diff, mem_iInter, SetLike.mem_coe]

name: innerAtomsCod_subset
statement:
theorem innerAtomsCod_subset (ξ : BaseNLAction)
    (N : NearLitter) (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    ξ.innerAtomsCod N.1 ⊆ (ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  refine ha.1 _ ⟨N, subset_antisymm ?_ ?_⟩
  · intro a' ha'
    exact ha' _ ⟨⟨hN, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro a' ha' _ ⟨_, rfl⟩
    exact ha'

name: innerAtomsCod_eq
statement:
theorem innerAtomsCod_eq {ξ : BaseNLAction}
    (N : NearLitter) (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    ξ.innerAtomsCod N.1 = ((ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN : Set Atom) \
      ((⋃ (N' : NearLitter) (hN' : (ξ.nearLitterMap N').Dom ∧ N'.1 = N.1),
        (ξ.nearLitterMap N').get hN'.1 ∆ (ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN) ∪ ξ.atomMap.ran)
proof:
:= by
  refine subset_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · intro a ha
    rw [mem_innerAtomsCod_iff] at ha
    refine ⟨ha.1 _ ⟨hN, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨_, ⟨N', rfl⟩, _, ⟨hN', rfl⟩, ha' | ha'⟩ <;> aesop
  · intro a ha
    rw [mem_innerAtomsCod_iff]
    obtain ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩ := ha
    constructor
    · intro N' hN'
      contrapose! ha₂
      exact Or.inl ⟨_, ⟨N', rfl⟩, _, ⟨hN', rfl⟩, Or.inr ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩⟩
    · contrapose! ha₂
      exact Or.inr ha₂

name: innerAtomsCod_eq_aux
statement:
theorem innerAtomsCod_eq_aux {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    (N : NearLitter) (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    Small ((⋃ (N' : NearLitter) (hN' : (ξ.nearLitterMap N').Dom ∧ N'.1 = N.1),
      (ξ.nearLitterMap N').get hN'.1 ∆ (ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN) ∪ ξ.atomMap.ran)
proof:
:= by
  refine Small.union (Small.bUnion ?_ ?_) ?_
  · exact Small.mono (fun _ h => h.1) ξ.nearLitterMap_dom_small
  · intro N' hN'
    refine Small.mono ?_ (Small.pFun_image ξ.atomMap_dom_small (f := ξ.atomMap))
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := hξ.ran_of_mem_symmDiff a hN'.2 hN'.1 hN ha
    exact ⟨b, hb₁, hb₁, hb₂⟩
  · refine Small.mono ?_ (Small.pFun_image ξ.atomMap_dom_small (f := ξ.atomMap))
    rintro _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, ha, ha, rfl⟩

name: mk_innerAtomsCod
statement:
theorem mk_innerAtomsCod {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    (L : Litter) (hL : ξ.LitterPresent L) : #(ξ.innerAtomsCod L) = #κ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hL
  refine le_antisymm ?_ ?_
  · refine (mk_le_mk_of_subset (ξ.innerAtomsCod_subset N hN)).trans ?_
    simp only [SetLike.coe_sort_coe, mk_nearLitter'', le_refl]
  · rw [innerAtomsCod_eq N hN]
    by_contra! h
    have := Small.union h (ξ.innerAtomsCod_eq_aux hξ N hN)
    rw [diff_union_self] at this
    refine (Small.mono (fun _ => Or.inl) this).not_le ?_
    simp only [SetLike.coe_sort_coe, mk_nearLitter'', le_refl]

name: mk_innerAtoms_lt
statement:
theorem mk_innerAtoms_lt {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    (L : Litter) (hL : ξ.LitterPresent L) :
    #(ξ.innerAtoms L) < #(ξ.innerAtomsCod L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mk_innerAtomsCod hξ L hL]
  exact ξ.innerAtoms_small L hL

name: eq_of_mem_innerAtoms
statement:
theorem eq_of_mem_innerAtoms {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful) (a : Atom)
    (ha : ¬(ξ.atomMap a).Dom) {L₁ L₂ : Litter}
    (hL₁ : ξ.LitterPresent L₁) (hL₂ : ξ.LitterPresent L₂)
    (ha₁ : a ∈ ξ.innerAtoms L₁) (ha₂ : a ∈ ξ.innerAtoms L₂) : L₁ = L₂
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_innerAtoms_iff L₁ hL₁] at ha₁
  rw [mem_innerAtoms_iff L₂ hL₂] at ha₂
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, rfl⟩ := hL₁
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, rfl⟩ := hL₂
  have h₁ := ha₁.2 N₁ ⟨hN₁, rfl⟩
  have h₂ := ha₂.2 N₂ ⟨hN₂, rfl⟩
  by_contra h
  exact ha (hξ.dom_of_mem_inter a h hN₁ hN₂ ⟨h₁, h₂⟩)

name: innerAtoms_allOuterAtoms
statement:
theorem innerAtoms_allOuterAtoms {ξ : BaseNLAction} (a : Atom)
    {L : Litter} (hL : ξ.LitterPresent L)
    (ha₁ : a ∈ ξ.innerAtoms L) (ha₂ : a ∈ ξ.allOuterAtoms) : False
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_innerAtoms_iff L hL] at ha₁
  rw [mem_allOuterAtoms_iff] at ha₂
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hL
  refine ha₂.2 N hN (ha₁.2 N ⟨hN, rfl⟩)

name: extraAtomMap_dom_small
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_dom_small (ξ : BaseNLAction) (hξ : ξ.Lawful) :
    Small (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ).Dom
proof:
:= by
  refine Small.union ξ.atomMap_dom_small (Small.union ?_ ξ.allOuterAtoms_small)
  suffices : Small (⋃ (L : Litter) (_ :  ξ.LitterPresent L), ξ.innerAtoms L)
  · refine Small.mono ?_ this
    rintro a ⟨L, hL, ha⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨L, rfl⟩, _, ⟨hL, rfl⟩, ha⟩
  refine Small.bUnion ξ.litterPresent_small ?_
  intro L hL
  exact ξ.innerAtoms_small L hL

name: extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom
proof:
:= by
  unfold extraAtomMap
  dsimp only
  rw [Or.elim'_left]

name: extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : ξ.Lawful}
    (a : Atom) (ha : ¬(ξ.atomMap a).Dom)
    (L : Litter) (hL : ξ.LitterPresent L) (ha' : a ∈ ξ.innerAtoms L) :
    (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).get (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨L, hL, ha'⟩)) =
      ξ.innerAtomsEmbedding hξ L hL ⟨a, ha'⟩
proof:
:= by
  unfold extraAtomMap
  dsimp only
  have : ∃ L, ξ.LitterPresent L ∧ a ∈ ξ.innerAtoms L := ⟨L, hL, ha'⟩
  rw [Or.elim'_right _ _ _ ha, Or.elim'_left _ _ _ this]
  have := eq_of_mem_innerAtoms hξ a ha hL this.choose_spec.1 ha' this.choose_spec.2
  subst this
  rfl

name: extraAtomMap_eq_of_allOuterAtoms
proof:
:= by
  unfold extraAtomMap
  dsimp only
  rw [Or.elim'_right _ _ _ ha, Or.elim'_right]
  rintro ⟨L, hL₁, haL⟩
  exact innerAtoms_allOuterAtoms a hL₁ haL ha'

name: innerAtomsEmbedding_ne_atomMap
statement:
theorem innerAtomsEmbedding_ne_atomMap {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : ξ.Lawful}
    {a : Atom} (ha : (ξ.atomMap a).Dom)
    {L : Litter} {hL : ξ.LitterPresent L} (b : ξ.innerAtoms L) :
    (ξ.atomMap a).get ha ≠ ξ.innerAtomsEmbedding hξ L hL b
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (ξ.innerAtomsEmbedding hξ L hL b).prop
  rw [← h] at this
  exact this.2 ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩

name: outerAtomsEmbedding_ne_atomMap
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (ξ.outerAtomsEmbedding b).prop
  rw [← h] at this
  refine sandboxLitter_not_banned ξ ?_
  rw [← this]
  exact BannedLitter.atomMap a ha

name: innerAtomsEmbedding_ne_outerAtomsEmbedding
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := (ξ.outerAtomsEmbedding b).prop
  rw [← h] at this
  refine sandboxLitter_not_banned ξ ?_
  rw [← this]
  have := (ξ.innerAtomsEmbedding hξ L hL a).prop
  obtain ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩ := hL
  exact bannedLitter_of_mem _ _ _ (this.1 _ ⟨N, rfl⟩ _ ⟨⟨hN, rfl⟩, rfl⟩)

name: innerAtomsEmbedding_disjoint
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := (ξ.innerAtomsEmbedding hξ L₁ hL₁ a₁).prop
  have h₂ := (ξ.innerAtomsEmbedding hξ L₂ hL₂ a₂).prop
  obtain ⟨N₁, hN₁, rfl⟩ := hL₁
  obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂, rfl⟩ := hL₂
  rw [h] at h₁
  have h₁' := h₁.1 _ ⟨N₁, rfl⟩ _ ⟨⟨hN₁, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  have h₂' := h₂.1 _ ⟨N₂, rfl⟩ _ ⟨⟨hN₂, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  simp only [SetLike.mem_coe] at h₁' h₂'
  by_contra! h'
  exact h₁.2 (hξ.ran_of_mem_inter _ h' hN₁ hN₂ ⟨h₁', h₂'⟩)

name: extraAtomMap_injective
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_injective {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : ξ.Lawful} ⦃a b : Atom⦄
    (ha : (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).Dom) (hb : (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ b).Dom)
    (h : (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).get ha = (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ b).get hb) : a = b
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha' : (ξ.atomMap a).Dom <;> by_cases hb' : (ξ.atomMap b).Dom
  · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom a ha', extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom b hb'] at h
    exact hξ.atomMap_injective ha' hb' h
  · obtain (hb | ⟨Lb, hLb₁, hLb₂⟩ | hb) := hb
    · cases hb' hb
    · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom a ha', extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms b hb' Lb hLb₁ hLb₂] at h
      cases innerAtomsEmbedding_ne_atomMap _ _ h
    · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom a ha', extraAtomMap_eq_of_allOuterAtoms b hb' hb] at h
      cases outerAtomsEmbedding_ne_atomMap _ _ h
  · obtain (ha | ⟨La, hLa₁, hLa₂⟩ | ha) := ha
    · cases ha' ha
    · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms a ha' La hLa₁ hLa₂, extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom b hb'] at h
      cases innerAtomsEmbedding_ne_atomMap _ _ h.symm
    · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_allOuterAtoms a ha' ha, extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom b hb'] at h
      cases outerAtomsEmbedding_ne_atomMap _ _ h.symm
  · obtain (ha | ⟨La, hLa₁, hLa₂⟩ | ha) := ha
    · cases ha' ha
    · obtain (hb | ⟨Lb, hLb₁, hLb₂⟩ | hb) := hb
      · cases hb' hb
      · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms a ha' La hLa₁ hLa₂,
          extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms b hb' Lb hLb₁ hLb₂] at h
        cases innerAtomsEmbedding_disjoint _ _ h
        cases (EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq _).mp (Subtype.coe_injective h)
        rfl
      · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms a ha' La hLa₁ hLa₂,
          extraAtomMap_eq_of_allOuterAtoms b hb' hb] at h
        cases innerAtomsEmbedding_ne_outerAtomsEmbedding _ _ h
    · obtain (hb | ⟨Lb, hLb₁, hLb₂⟩ | hb) := hb
      · cases hb' hb
      · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_allOuterAtoms a ha' ha,
          extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms b hb' Lb hLb₁ hLb₂] at h
        cases innerAtomsEmbedding_ne_outerAtomsEmbedding _ _ h.symm
      · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_allOuterAtoms a ha' ha,
          extraAtomMap_eq_of_allOuterAtoms b hb' hb] at h
        cases (EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq _).mp (Subtype.coe_injective h)
        rfl

name: mem_iff_of_mem_innerAtoms
statement:
theorem mem_iff_of_mem_innerAtoms {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    {a : Atom} {L : Litter} (hL : ξ.LitterPresent L)
    (ha' : ¬(ξ.atomMap a).Dom) (ha : a ∈ ξ.innerAtoms L)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    a ∈ N ↔ N.1 = L
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨N', hN', rfl⟩ := hL
    have := ha _ ⟨N', rfl⟩ _ ⟨⟨hN', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    by_contra! hNN'
    exact ha' (hξ.dom_of_mem_inter _ hNN' hN hN' ⟨h, this.1⟩)
  · rintro rfl
    exact (ha _ ⟨N, rfl⟩ _ ⟨⟨hN, rfl⟩, rfl⟩).1

name: extraAtomMap_mem_iff
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_mem_iff {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : ξ.Lawful}
    ⦃a : Atom⦄ (ha : (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).Dom)
    ⦃N : NearLitter⦄ (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).get ha ∈ (ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN ↔ a ∈ N
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha' : (ξ.atomMap a).Dom
  · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom a ha']
    exact hξ.atom_mem_iff ha' hN
  obtain (ha | ⟨L, hL₁, hL₂⟩ | ha) := ha
  · cases ha' ha
  · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_innerAtoms a ha' L hL₁ hL₂,
      mem_iff_of_mem_innerAtoms hξ hL₁ ha' hL₂ hN]
    obtain ⟨N', hN', rfl⟩ := hL₁
    constructor
    · intro h
      by_contra hNN'
      have ha := (innerAtomsEmbedding hξ N'.1 ⟨N', hN', rfl⟩ ⟨a, hL₂⟩).prop.1
        _ ⟨N', rfl⟩ _ ⟨⟨hN', rfl⟩, rfl⟩
      exact (innerAtomsEmbedding hξ N'.1 ⟨N', hN', rfl⟩ ⟨a, hL₂⟩).prop.2
        (hξ.ran_of_mem_inter _ hNN' hN hN' ⟨h, ha⟩)
    · intro h
      exact (innerAtomsEmbedding hξ N'.1 ⟨N', hN', rfl⟩ ⟨a, hL₂⟩).prop.1
        _ ⟨N, rfl⟩ _ ⟨⟨hN, h⟩, rfl⟩
  · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_allOuterAtoms a ha' ha]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have := bannedLitter_of_mem _ _ _ h
      rw [(ξ.outerAtomsEmbedding ⟨a, ha⟩).prop] at this
      cases ξ.sandboxLitter_not_banned this
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨_, ⟨L, rfl⟩, _, ⟨hL, rfl⟩, ha⟩ := ha
      cases ha.2 ⟨_, ⟨N, rfl⟩, _, ⟨hN, rfl⟩, h⟩

name: extraAtomMap_dom_of_mem_symmDiff
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_dom_of_mem_symmDiff {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) {a : Atom} (ha : a ∈ litterSet N.1 ∆ N) :
    (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).Dom
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha' : (ξ.atomMap a).Dom
  · exact Or.inl ha'
  by_cases ha'' : ∃ N', (ξ.nearLitterMap N').Dom ∧ a ∈ N'
  · obtain ⟨N', hN', haN'⟩ := ha''
    refine Or.inr (Or.inl ?_)
    refine ⟨N'.1, ⟨N', hN', rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_innerAtoms_iff _ ⟨N', hN', rfl⟩]
    have : ∀ N'', (ξ.nearLitterMap N'').Dom ∧ N''.fst = N'.fst → a ∈ N''
    · intro N'' hN''
      by_contra haN''
      exact ha' (hξ.dom_of_mem_symmDiff a hN''.2 hN''.1 hN' (Or.inr ⟨haN', haN''⟩))
    refine ⟨?_, this⟩
    intro h
    obtain (ha | ha) := ha
    · refine ha.2 (this N ⟨hN, ?_⟩)
      rw [← ha.1, h]
    · refine ha' (hξ.dom_of_mem_inter a ?_ hN hN' ⟨ha.1, haN'⟩)
      rw [← h]
      exact Ne.symm ha.2
  · push_neg at ha''
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)
    simp only [mem_allOuterAtoms_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, ha''⟩
    obtain (ha | ha) := ha
    · rw [ha.1]
      exact ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩
    · cases ha'' N hN ha.1

name: extraAtomMap_dom_of_mem_inter
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_dom_of_mem_inter {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) {L : Litter}
    (h : N.1 ≠ L) {a : Atom} (ha₁ : a ∈ N) (ha₂ : a.1 = L) :
    (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).Dom
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha' : (ξ.atomMap a).Dom
  · exact Or.inl ha'
  refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨_, ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩, ?_⟩)
  rw [mem_innerAtoms_iff _ ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩]
  constructor
  · rw [ha₂]
    exact h.symm
  · intro N' hN'
    by_contra ha''
    exact ha' (hξ.dom_of_mem_symmDiff a hN'.2 hN'.1 hN (Or.inr ⟨ha₁, ha''⟩))

name: extraLitterMap'_subset
statement:
theorem extraLitterMap'_subset {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : ξ.Lawful}
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (h : N₁.1 = N₂.1)
    (hN₁ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₁).Dom) (hN₂ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₂).Dom) :
    ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N₁ hN₁ ⊆ ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N₂ hN₂
proof:
:= by
  rintro a (⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩ | ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩)
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists] at ha₂
    by_cases ha₃ : a ∈ (ξ.nearLitterMap N₂).get hN₂
    · refine Or.inl ⟨ha₃, ?_⟩
      simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists]
      rintro a ha rfl
      simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff] at ha₁ ha₃
      obtain (ha | ha) := ha
      · cases ha.2 ha₃
      · refine ha₂ a (Or.inr ⟨ha₁, ?_⟩) rfl
        rw [h]
        exact ha.2
    · obtain ⟨a, ha', rfl⟩ := hξ.ran_of_mem_symmDiff a h hN₁ hN₂ (Or.inl ⟨ha₁, ha₃⟩)
      refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ha₃⟩
      simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff]
      simp only [SetLike.mem_coe, hξ.atom_mem_iff] at ha₁ ha₃
      have ha₄ : a.1 = N₁.1
      · by_contra ha₄
        refine ha₂ a (Or.inr ⟨ha₁, ha₄⟩) ?_
        rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom]
      refine ⟨a, Or.inl ⟨ha₄.trans h, ha₃⟩, ?_⟩
      rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom _ ha']
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff] at ha₁
    obtain ⟨a, ha₁, rfl⟩ := ha₁
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff] at ha₂
    obtain (⟨ha₁, -⟩ | ⟨ha₁, -⟩) := ha₁
    · by_cases ha₃ : a ∈ N₂
      · refine Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff]
          exact ha₃
        · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists]
          intro b hb hab
          cases extraAtomMap_injective _ _ hab
          obtain (hb | hb) := hb
          · cases hb.2 ha₃
          · rw [h] at ha₁
            cases hb.2 ha₁
      · refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
        · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff]
          refine ⟨a, Or.inl ⟨?_, ha₃⟩, rfl⟩
          rw [← h]
          exact ha₁
        · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff]
          exact ha₃
    · cases ha₂ ha₁

name: extraLitterMap'_eq
statement:
theorem extraLitterMap'_eq {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : ξ.Lawful}
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (h : N₁.1 = N₂.1)
    (hN₁ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₁).Dom) (hN₂ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₂).Dom) :
    ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N₁ hN₁ = ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N₂ hN₂
proof:
:=
  subset_antisymm (extraLitterMap'_subset h hN₁ hN₂) (extraLitterMap'_subset h.symm hN₂ hN₁)

name: extraLitterMap'_isNearLitter
statement:
theorem extraLitterMap'_isNearLitter {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    IsNearLitter ((ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN).1 (ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N hN)
proof:
:= by
  rw [extraLitterMap']
  refine ((ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN).2.prop.trans ?_
  erw [IsNear, symmDiff_symmDiff_cancel_left]
  refine Small.bUnion N.2.prop ?_
  intro a ha
  exact small_singleton _

name: extraLitterMap'_disjoint
statement:
theorem extraLitterMap'_disjoint {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : ξ.Lawful}
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (h : N₁.1 ≠ N₂.1)
    (hN₁ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₁).Dom) (hN₂ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₂).Dom) (a : Atom) :
    a ∉ ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N₁ hN₁ ∩ ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N₂ hN₂
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  simp only [extraLitterMap', mem_inter_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨ha₁ | ha₁, ha₂ | ha₂⟩ := h
  · simp only [mem_diff, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists] at ha₁ ha₂
    obtain ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩ := hξ.ran_of_mem_inter a h hN₁ hN₂ ⟨ha₁.1, ha₂.1⟩
    rw [hξ.atom_mem_iff] at ha₁ ha₂
    by_cases ha₃ : a.1 = N₁.1
    · refine ha₂.2 a (Or.inr ⟨ha₂.1, ?_⟩) ?_
      · rw [mem_litterSet, ha₃]
        exact h
      · rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom]
    · refine ha₁.2 a (Or.inr ⟨ha₁.1, ha₃⟩) ?_
      rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom]
  · simp only [mem_diff, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists] at ha₁
    simp only [mem_diff, mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, SetLike.mem_coe] at ha₂
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, ha₂⟩ := ha₂
    rw [extraAtomMap_mem_iff] at ha₁ ha₂
    refine ha₁.2 b (Or.inr ⟨ha₁.1, ?_⟩) rfl
    obtain (hb | hb) := hb
    · rw [mem_litterSet, hb.1]
      exact h.symm
    · cases ha₂ hb.1
  · simp only [mem_diff, SetLike.mem_coe, mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists] at ha₂
    simp only [mem_diff, mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, SetLike.mem_coe] at ha₁
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, ha₁⟩ := ha₁
    rw [extraAtomMap_mem_iff] at ha₁ ha₂
    refine ha₂.2 b (Or.inr ⟨ha₂.1, ?_⟩) rfl
    obtain (hb | hb) := hb
    · rw [mem_litterSet, hb.1]
      exact h
    · cases ha₁ hb.1
  · simp only [mem_diff, mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, SetLike.mem_coe] at ha₁ ha₂
    obtain ⟨⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, ha₁⟩ := ha₁
    obtain ⟨⟨c, hc, hc'⟩, ha₂⟩ := ha₂
    cases extraAtomMap_injective _ _ hc'
    rw [extraAtomMap_mem_iff] at ha₁ ha₂
    obtain (hb | hb) := hb
    · obtain (hc | hc) := hc
      · cases h (hb.1.symm.trans hc.1)
      · cases ha₂ hc.1
    · cases ha₁ hb.1

name: mem_extraLitterMap_iff
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: extraLitterMap_eq
statement:
theorem extraLitterMap_eq {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : ξ.Lawful}
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (h : N₁.1 = N₂.1)
    (hN₁ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₁).Dom) (hN₂ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₂).Dom) :
    ξ.extraLitterMap hξ N₁ hN₁ = ξ.extraLitterMap hξ N₂ hN₂
proof:
:=
  NearLitter.ext (extraLitterMap'_eq h hN₁ hN₂)

name: withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom
statement:
theorem withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    ((ξ.withLitters hξ).nearLitterMap N).get (Or.inl hN) = (ξ.nearLitterMap N).get hN
proof:
:= by
  unfold withLitters
  dsimp only
  rw [Or.elim'_left]

name: withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst
statement:
theorem withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    ((ξ.withLitters hξ).nearLitterMap N.1.toNearLitter).get (Or.inr ⟨⟨_⟩, N, hN, rfl⟩) =
      ξ.extraLitterMap hξ N hN
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hN' : (ξ.nearLitterMap N.1.toNearLitter).Dom
  · rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN', extraLitterMap_eq (by rfl) hN hN', extraLitterMap]
    refine NearLitter.ext ?_
    simp only [extraLitterMap', Litter.toNearLitter_fst, Litter.coe_toNearLitter,
      symmDiff_self, bot_eq_empty, mem_empty_iff_false, iUnion_of_empty, iUnion_empty,
      symmDiff_empty, NearLitter.coe_mk]
  · unfold withLitters
    dsimp only
    rw [Or.elim'_right _ _ _ hN']
    have : ξ.LitterPresent N.1 := ⟨N, hN, rfl⟩
    rw [extraLitterMap_eq this.choose_spec.2 this.choose_spec.1 hN]

name: extraAtomMap_mem_iff'
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_mem_iff' {ξ : BaseNLAction} {hξ : Lawful ξ}
    {a : Atom} (ha : (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).Dom)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : (ξ.nearLitterMap N).Dom) :
    (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ a).get ha ∈ ξ.extraLitterMap hξ N hN ↔ a.1 = N.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_extraLitterMap_iff, extraLitterMap']
  constructor
  · rintro (⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩ | ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩)
    · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff] at ha₁
      contrapose! ha₂
      simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff]
      exact ⟨a, Or.inr ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩, rfl⟩
    · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff] at ha₂
      simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff] at ha₁
      obtain ⟨b, hb, hab⟩ := ha₁
      cases extraAtomMap_injective _ _ hab
      obtain (hb | hb) := hb
      · exact hb.1
      · cases ha₂ hb.1
  · intro ha₁
    by_cases ha₂ : a ∈ N
    · refine Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff]
        exact ha₂
      · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists]
        intro b hb hab
        cases extraAtomMap_injective _ _ hab
        obtain (hb | hb) := hb
        · cases hb.2 ha₂
        · cases hb.2 ha₁
    · refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff]
        exact ⟨a, Or.inl ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩, rfl⟩
      · rw [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff]
        exact ha₂

name: extraAtomMap_ran_of_mem_symmDiff
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_ran_of_mem_symmDiff {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (hN₁ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₁).Dom) (hN₂ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₂).Dom)
    (hN : N₁.fst = (Litter.toNearLitter N₂.1).fst)
    {a : Atom} (ha : a ∈ ((ξ.nearLitterMap N₁).get hN₁ : Set Atom) ∆ ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N₂ hN₂) :
    a ∈ (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ).ran
proof:
:= by
  obtain (⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩ | ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩) := ha
  · contrapose! ha₂
    have ha' : a ∈ (ξ.nearLitterMap N₂).get hN₂
    · by_contra ha'
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hξ.ran_of_mem_symmDiff a (by exact hN) hN₁ hN₂ (Or.inl ⟨ha₁, ha'⟩)
      refine ha₂ ⟨b, Or.inl hb, ?_⟩
      rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom]
    refine Or.inl ⟨ha', ?_⟩
    simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists]
    rintro b hb rfl
    exact ha₂ ⟨b, _, rfl⟩
  · obtain (⟨ha₁, ha₃⟩ | ⟨ha₁, ha₃⟩) := ha₁
    · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists] at ha₃
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hξ.ran_of_mem_symmDiff a (by exact hN) hN₁ hN₂ (Or.inr ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩)
      refine ⟨b, Or.inl hb, ?_⟩
      rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom]
    · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff] at ha₁
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := ha₁
      exact ⟨_, _, rfl⟩

name: extraAtomMap_ran_of_mem_inter
statement:
theorem extraAtomMap_ran_of_mem_inter {ξ : BaseNLAction} (hξ : ξ.Lawful)
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (hN₁ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₁).Dom) (hN₂ : (ξ.nearLitterMap N₂).Dom)
    (hN : N₁.fst ≠ (Litter.toNearLitter N₂.1).fst)
    {a : Atom} (ha : a ∈ ((ξ.nearLitterMap N₁).get hN₁ : Set Atom) ∩ ξ.extraLitterMap' hξ N₂ hN₂) :
    a ∈ (ξ.extraAtomMap hξ).ran
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ha₁, ⟨ha₂, ha₃⟩ | ⟨ha₂, ha₃⟩⟩ := ha
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff, not_exists] at ha₃
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hξ.ran_of_mem_inter a (by exact hN) hN₁ hN₂ ⟨ha₁, ha₂⟩
    refine ⟨b, Or.inl hb, ?_⟩
    rw [extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom]
  · simp only [mem_iUnion, mem_singleton_iff] at ha₂
    obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := ha₂
    rw [SetLike.mem_coe, extraAtomMap_mem_iff] at ha₁ ha₃
    exact ⟨b, _, rfl⟩

name: withLitters_lawful
statement:
theorem withLitters_lawful (ξ : BaseNLAction) (hξ : ξ.Lawful) :
    (ξ.withLitters hξ).Lawful
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  case atomMap_injective => exact extraAtomMap_injective
  case atom_mem_iff =>
    rintro a ha N (hN | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N, hN, hN'⟩⟩)
    · rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN]
      exact extraAtomMap_mem_iff ha hN
    · cases hN'
      rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst hξ hN]
      exact extraAtomMap_mem_iff' ha hN
  case dom_of_mem_symmDiff =>
    rintro a N₁ N₂ h (hN₁ | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N₁, -, hN₁'⟩⟩) (hN₂ | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N₂, -, hN₂'⟩⟩) ha
    · exact Or.inl (hξ.dom_of_mem_symmDiff a h hN₁ hN₂ ha)
    · cases hN₂'
      refine extraAtomMap_dom_of_mem_symmDiff hξ hN₁ ?_
      rw [h]
      rw [symmDiff_comm] at ha
      exact ha
    · cases hN₁'
      refine extraAtomMap_dom_of_mem_symmDiff hξ hN₂ ?_
      rw [← h]
      exact ha
    · cases hN₁'
      cases hN₂'
      rw [Litter.toNearLitter_fst] at h
      obtain (ha | ha) := ha
      · rw [h] at ha
        cases ha.2 ha.1
      · rw [h] at ha
        cases ha.2 ha.1
  case dom_of_mem_inter =>
    rintro a N₁ N₂ h (hN₁ | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N₁, -, hN₁'⟩⟩) (hN₂ | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N₂, -, hN₂'⟩⟩) ha
    · exact Or.inl (hξ.dom_of_mem_inter a h hN₁ hN₂ ha)
    · cases hN₂'
      exact extraAtomMap_dom_of_mem_inter hξ hN₁ h ha.1 ha.2
    · cases hN₁'
      exact extraAtomMap_dom_of_mem_inter hξ hN₂ h.symm ha.2 ha.1
    · cases hN₁'
      cases hN₂'
      simp only [Litter.toNearLitter_fst, ne_eq] at h
      cases h (ha.1.symm.trans ha.2)
  case ran_of_mem_symmDiff =>
    rintro a N₁ N₂ h (hN₁ | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N₁, hN₁, hN₁'⟩⟩) (hN₂ | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N₂, hN₂, hN₂'⟩⟩) ha
    · rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN₁, withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN₂] at ha
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hξ.ran_of_mem_symmDiff a h hN₁ hN₂ ha
      refine ⟨b, Or.inl hb, ?_⟩
      simp only [withLitters, extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom _ hb]
    · cases hN₂'
      refine extraAtomMap_ran_of_mem_symmDiff hξ hN₁ hN₂ h ?_
      rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN₁,
        withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst hξ hN₂] at ha
      exact ha
    · cases hN₁'
      refine extraAtomMap_ran_of_mem_symmDiff hξ hN₂ hN₁ h.symm ?_
      rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN₂,
        withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst hξ hN₁, symmDiff_comm] at ha
      exact ha
    · cases hN₁'
      cases hN₂'
      rw [Litter.toNearLitter_fst] at h
      simp only [h, Litter.toNearLitter_fst, symmDiff_self, bot_eq_empty, mem_empty_iff_false] at ha
  case ran_of_mem_inter =>
    rintro a N₁ N₂ h (hN₁ | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N₁, hN₁, hN₁'⟩⟩) (hN₂ | ⟨⟨_⟩, ⟨N₂, hN₂, hN₂'⟩⟩) ha
    · rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN₁, withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN₂] at ha
      obtain ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩ := hξ.ran_of_mem_inter a h hN₁ hN₂ ha
      refine ⟨b, Or.inl hb, ?_⟩
      simp only [withLitters, extraAtomMap_eq_of_dom _ hb]
    · cases hN₂'
      refine extraAtomMap_ran_of_mem_inter hξ hN₁ hN₂ h ?_
      rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN₁,
        withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst hξ hN₂] at ha
      exact ha
    · cases hN₁'
      refine extraAtomMap_ran_of_mem_inter hξ hN₂ hN₁ h.symm ?_
      rw [withLitters_nearLitterMap_of_dom hξ hN₂,
        withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst hξ hN₁, inter_comm] at ha
      exact ha
    · cases hN₁'
      cases hN₂'
      simp only [mem_inter_iff, SetLike.mem_coe,
        withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst hξ hN₁, withLitters_nearLitterMap_fst hξ hN₂,
        mem_extraLitterMap_iff] at ha
      cases extraLitterMap'_disjoint (by exact h) hN₁ hN₂ a ha

name: withLitters_lawful
statement: theorem withLitters_lawful (ξ : StructNLAction β) (hξ : ξ.Lawful) : (ξ.withLitters hξ).Lawful
proof:
:=
  fun A => (ξ A).withLitters_lawful (hξ A)

name: coe_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_mk (f : α → α) (g s ml mr il ir) : (PartialPerm.mk f g s ml mr il ir : α → α) = f
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coe_symm_mk
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_symm_mk (f : α → α) (g s ml mr il ir) :
    ((PartialPerm.mk f g s ml mr il ir).symm : α → α) = g
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: toFun_as_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem toFun_as_coe : π.toFun = π
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: invFun_as_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem invFun_as_coe : π.invFun = π.symm

:=
  rfl

name: map_domain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem map_domain {x : α} (h : x ∈ π.domain) : π x ∈ π.domain

  π.toFun_domain' h

name: iterate_domain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iterate_domain {x : α} (h : x ∈ π.domain) {n : ℕ} : π^[n] x ∈ π.domain
proof:
:= by
  induction' n with n ih
  exact h
  rw [Function.iterate_succ']
  exact π.map_domain ih

name: left_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem left_inv {x : α} (h : x ∈ π.domain) : π.symm (π x) = x
proof:
:=
  π.left_inv' h

name: right_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem right_inv {x : α} (h : x ∈ π.domain) : π (π.symm x) = x

:=
  π.right_inv' h

name: symm_domain
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_domain : π.symm.domain = π.domain
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: symm_symm
statement:
@[simp]
theorem symm_symm : π.symm.symm = π
proof: := by cases π; rfl

name: eq_symm_apply
statement:
theorem eq_symm_apply {x : α} {y : α} (hx : x ∈ π.domain) (hy : y ∈ π.domain) :
    x = π.symm y ↔ π x = y
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun h => by rw [← π.right_inv hy, h], fun h => by rw [← π.left_inv hx, h]⟩

name: mapsTo
statement: protected theorem mapsTo : MapsTo π π.domain π.domain
proof: := fun _ => π.map_domain

name: leftInvOn

name: rightInvOn

name: invOn
statement: protected theorem invOn : InvOn π.symm π π.domain π.domain
proof:
:=
  ⟨π.leftInvOn, π.rightInvOn⟩

name: injOn

name: bijOn

name: copy_eq
statement:
theorem copy_eq (π : PartialPerm α) (f : α → α) (hf : ⇑π = f) (g : α → α) (hg : ⇑π.symm = g)
    (s : Set α) (hs : π.domain = s) : π.copy f hf g hg s hs = π
proof: := by substs f g s; cases π; rfl

name: image_domain

name: forall_mem_domain

proof:

  π.forall_mem_domain.mpr fun x hx => by rw [π.left_inv hx, h hx]

name: symm
statement: protected theorem symm (h : π.IsStable s) : π.symm.IsStable s

theorem symm_iff : π.symm.IsStable s ↔ π.IsStable s

name: iff_preimage_eq

proof:

  simp only [IsStable, Set.ext_iff, mem_inter_iff, and_congr_right_iff, mem_preimage]

name: iff_symm_preimage_eq

name: leftInvOn_piecewise
statement:
theorem leftInvOn_piecewise {π' : PartialPerm α} [∀ i, Decidable (i ∈ s)] (h : π.IsStable s)
    (h' : π'.IsStable s) :
    LeftInvOn (s.piecewise π.symm π'.symm) (s.piecewise π π') (s.ite π.domain π'.domain)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x (⟨he, hs⟩ | ⟨he, hs : x ∉ s⟩)
  · rw [piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ hs, piecewise_eq_of_mem _ _ _ ((h he).2 hs), π.left_inv he]
  · rw [piecewise_eq_of_not_mem _ _ _ hs, piecewise_eq_of_not_mem _ _ _ ((h'.compl he).2 hs),
      π'.left_inv he]

name: inter_eq_of_inter_eq_of_eqOn
statement:
theorem inter_eq_of_inter_eq_of_eqOn {π' : PartialPerm α} (h : π.IsStable s) (h' : π'.IsStable s)
    (hs : π.domain ∩ s = π'.domain ∩ s) (Heq : EqOn π π' (π.domain ∩ s)) :
    π.domain ∩ s = π'.domain ∩ s
proof: := by rw [← h.image_eq, ← h'.image_eq, ← hs, Heq.image_eq]

name: symm_eqOn_of_inter_eq_of_eqOn
statement:
theorem symm_eqOn_of_inter_eq_of_eqOn {π' : PartialPerm α} (h : π.IsStable s)
    (hs : π.domain ∩ s = π'.domain ∩ s) (Heq : EqOn π π' (π.domain ∩ s)) :
    EqOn π.symm π'.symm (π.domain ∩ s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.image_eq]
  rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  have hx' := hx; rw [hs] at hx'
  rw [π.left_inv hx.1, Heq hx, π'.left_inv hx'.1]

name: image_domain_inter_eq'

name: image_domain_inter_eq

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
protected theorem ext (h : ∀ x, π x = π' x) (hsymm : ∀ x, π.symm x = π'.symm x)
    (hs : π.domain = π'.domain) : π = π'
proof:
:= by
  have A : (π : α → α) = π' := by ext x; exact h x
  have B : (π.symm : α → α) = π'.symm := by ext x; exact hsymm x
  have I : π '' π.domain = π.domain := π.image_domain
  have I' : π' '' π'.domain = π'.domain := π'.image_domain
  rw [A, hs, I'] at I
  cases π; cases π'
  simp_all only [coe_symm_mk, coe_mk, eq_self_iff_true, and_self_iff]

proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨EqOnDomain.symm_domain_eq h, eqOn_of_leftInvOn_of_rightInvOn π.leftInvOn ?_ ?_⟩ <;>
    simp only [symm_domain, EqOnDomain.domain_eq h, π'.symm.mapsTo]
  exact π'.rightInvOn.congr_right π'.symm.mapsTo (EqOnDomain.domain_eq h ▸ h.eqOn.symm)

name: le_card_categorise
statement:
theorem le_card_categorise {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) (b : β) :
    #((r.dom ∪ r.codom : Set α) × ℕ) ≤ #(R.sandbox ∩ R.categorise ⁻¹' {b} : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cardinal.mk_prod, Cardinal.lift_id', Cardinal.mk_eq_aleph0 ℕ, Cardinal.lift_aleph0]
  refine le_trans ?_ (R.le_card_categorise b)
  apply mul_le_of_le
  · exact le_max_left ℵ₀ _
  · exact le_max_right ℵ₀ _
  · exact le_max_left ℵ₀ _

name: catInj_mem_sandbox
statement:
theorem catInj_mem_sandbox {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) (b : β)
    (x : (r.dom ∪ r.codom : Set α) × ℕ) :
    (catInj R b x : α) ∈ R.sandbox
proof:
:=
  (catInj R b x).prop.1

name: categorise_catInj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem categorise_catInj {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) (b : β)
    (x : (r.dom ∪ r.codom : Set α) × ℕ) :
    R.categorise (catInj R b x) = b
proof:
:=
  (catInj R b x).prop.2

name: catInj_ne_of_mem
statement:
theorem catInj_ne_of_mem {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) (b : β)
    (x : (r.dom ∪ r.codom : Set α) × ℕ) (a : α) (ha : a ∈ r.dom ∪ r.codom) :
    (catInj R b x : α) ≠ a
proof:
:= by
  have := R.sandbox_disjoint
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_forall_ne] at this
  exact (this ha (catInj_mem_sandbox R b x)).symm

name: catInj_injective
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := categorise_catInj R b₁ x₁
  have h₂ := categorise_catInj R b₂ x₂
  rw [h, h₂] at h₁
  cases h₁
  rw [Subtype.coe_inj, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h
  exact ⟨rfl, h⟩

name: catInj_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem catInj_inj {r : Rel α α} {R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β}
    {b₁ b₂ : β} {a₁ a₂ : α} {h₁ : a₁ ∈ r.dom ∪ r.codom} {h₂ : a₂ ∈ r.dom ∪ r.codom} {n₁ n₂ : ℕ} :
    (catInj R b₁ (⟨a₁, h₁⟩, n₁) : α) = catInj R b₂ (⟨a₂, h₂⟩, n₂) ↔
      b₁ = b₂ ∧ a₁ = a₂ ∧ n₁ = n₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨rfl, h'⟩ := catInj_injective h
    cases h'
    exact ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: le_permutativeExtension
statement:
theorem le_permutativeExtension (r : Rel α α) (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    r ≤ r.permutativeExtension R
proof:
:=
  le_sup_left

name: dom_permutativeExtension_subset
statement:
theorem dom_permutativeExtension_subset (r : Rel α α) (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    (r.permutativeExtension R).dom ⊆ r.dom ∪ r.codom ∪ R.sandbox
proof:
:= by
  rintro a₁ ⟨a₂, h | h⟩
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨a₂, h⟩)
  cases h with
  | right _ had hac => exact Or.inl (Or.inr hac)
  | _ => right; apply catInj_mem_sandbox

name: dom_permutativeExtension_subset'
statement:
theorem dom_permutativeExtension_subset' (r : Rel α α) (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    (r.permutativeExtension R).dom ⊆ (r.dom ∪ r.codom) ∪
      ((⋃ a ∈ r.dom, ⋃ n, Subtype.val '' Set.range
        (catInj R (R.catPerm.symm^[n + 1] (R.categorise a)))) ∪
      (⋃ a ∈ r.codom, ⋃ n, Subtype.val '' Set.range
        (catInj R (R.catPerm^[n + 1] (R.categorise a)))))
proof:
:= by
  rintro a₁ ⟨a₂, h | h⟩
  · exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨a₂, h⟩)
  cases h with
  | left _ had hac =>
    right; left
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨a₂, had, 0, _, ⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  | leftStep n a had hac =>
    right; left
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨a, had, n + 1, _, ⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  | right _ had hac => exact Or.inl (Or.inr hac)
  | rightStep n a had hac =>
    right; right
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨a, hac, n , _, ⟨_, rfl⟩, rfl⟩

name: card_permutativeExtension
statement:
theorem card_permutativeExtension (r : Rel α α) (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β)
    (hr : r.Coinjective) :
    #(r.permutativeExtension R).dom ≤ max ℵ₀ #r.dom
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_le_mk_of_subset (dom_permutativeExtension_subset' r R)).trans
  apply (mk_union_le _ _).trans
  apply (add_le_add (mk_union_le _ _) (mk_union_le _ _)).trans
  apply add_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) <;> apply add_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _)
  · exact le_max_right _ _
  · exact le_max_of_le_right (card_codom_le_of_coinjective hr)
  · refine (mk_biUnion_le_of_le (max ℵ₀ #r.dom) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro a _
      have := mk_iUnion_le_of_le_lift
          (f := λ n ↦ Subtype.val '' Set.range (catInj R (R.catPerm.symm^[n + 1] (R.categorise a))))
          (max ℵ₀ #r.dom) ?_
      · rw [lift_id', lift_id', mk_eq_aleph0 ℕ, lift_aleph0] at this
        apply this.trans
        exact mul_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _) le_rfl
      · intro n
        apply mk_image_le.trans
        apply mk_range_le.trans
        rw [mk_prod, lift_id', mk_eq_aleph0 ℕ, lift_aleph0]
        refine mul_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
        apply (mk_union_le _ _).trans
        apply add_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
        exact le_max_of_le_right (card_codom_le_of_coinjective hr)
    · exact mul_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _) le_rfl
  · refine (mk_biUnion_le_of_le (max ℵ₀ #r.dom) ?_).trans ?_
    · intro a _
      have := mk_iUnion_le_of_le_lift
          (f := λ n ↦ Subtype.val '' Set.range (catInj R (R.catPerm^[n + 1] (R.categorise a))))
          (max ℵ₀ #r.dom) ?_
      · rw [lift_id', lift_id', mk_eq_aleph0 ℕ, lift_aleph0] at this
        apply this.trans
        exact mul_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_left _ _) le_rfl
      · intro n
        apply mk_image_le.trans
        apply mk_range_le.trans
        rw [mk_prod, lift_id', mk_eq_aleph0 ℕ, lift_aleph0]
        refine mul_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) ?_ (le_max_left _ _)
        apply (mk_union_le _ _).trans
        apply add_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)
        exact le_max_of_le_right (card_codom_le_of_coinjective hr)
    · refine mul_le_of_le (le_max_left _ _) ?_ le_rfl
      exact le_max_of_le_right (card_codom_le_of_coinjective hr)

name: categorise_newOrbits
statement:
theorem categorise_newOrbits {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β)
    {a₁ a₂ : α} (h : newOrbits R a₁ a₂) :
    R.categorise a₂ = R.catPerm (R.categorise a₁)
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | left => simp only [categorise_catInj, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  | leftStep => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.comp_apply,
      categorise_catInj, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  | right => simp only [categorise_catInj]
  | rightStep => simp only [Function.iterate_succ_apply', Function.comp_apply,
      categorise_catInj, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: categorise_permutativeExtension
statement:
theorem categorise_permutativeExtension {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β)
    {a₁ a₂ : α} (h : r.permutativeExtension R a₁ a₂) :
    r a₁ a₂ ∨ R.categorise a₂ = R.catPerm (R.categorise a₁)
proof:
:=
  h.elim Or.inl (Or.inr ∘ categorise_newOrbits R)

name: newOrbits_injective
statement:
theorem newOrbits_injective {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    (newOrbits R).Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ a₃ h₁ h₂
  set a₄ := a₃ with h
  clear_value a₄
  rw [h] at h₁
  cases h₁ with
  | left _ hac had =>
    cases h₂ with
    | left => cases h; rfl
    | _ => cases catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ a₃ (Or.inl hac) h
  | leftStep =>
    cases h₂ with
    | left _ hac had => cases catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ a₄ (Or.inl hac) h.symm
    | leftStep =>
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, catInj_inj, add_left_inj, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
        EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h ⊢
      exact ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.1.symm, h.2.2.symm⟩
    | _ =>
      rw [catInj_inj] at h
      cases h.2.1
      contradiction
  | right _ ha₁c ha₁d =>
    cases h₂ with
    | left _ ha₄c ha₄d => cases catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ a₄ (Or.inl ha₄c) h.symm
    | leftStep n a had hac =>
      rw [catInj_inj] at h
      cases h.2.1
      contradiction
    | right =>
      rw [catInj_inj] at h
      exact h.2.1.symm
    | rightStep => simp only [catInj_inj, AddLeftCancelMonoid.add_eq_zero,
        one_ne_zero, and_false] at h
  | rightStep =>
    cases h₂ with
    | left _ hac had => cases catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ a₄ (Or.inl hac) h.symm
    | leftStep =>
      rw [catInj_inj] at h
      cases h.2.1
      contradiction
    | rightStep =>
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, catInj_inj, add_left_inj, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
        EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h ⊢
      exact ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.1.symm, h.2.2.symm⟩
    | right =>
      simp only [catInj_inj, right_eq_add, AddLeftCancelMonoid.add_eq_zero,
        one_ne_zero, and_false] at h

name: newOrbits_coinjective
statement:
theorem newOrbits_coinjective {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    (newOrbits R).Coinjective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ a₃ h₁ h₂
  set a₄ := a₃ with h
  clear_value a₄
  rw [h] at h₁
  cases h₁ with
  | right _ hac had =>
    cases h₂ with
    | right => cases h; rfl
    | _ => cases catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ a₃ (Or.inr had) h
  | rightStep =>
    cases h₂ with
    | right _ hac had => cases catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ a₄ (Or.inr had) h.symm
    | rightStep =>
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, catInj_inj, add_left_inj, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
        EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h ⊢
      exact ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.1.symm, h.2.2.symm⟩
    | _ =>
      rw [catInj_inj] at h
      cases h.2.1
      contradiction
  | left _ ha₁c ha₁d =>
    cases h₂ with
    | right _ ha₄c ha₄d => cases catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ a₄ (Or.inr ha₄d) h.symm
    | rightStep n a had hac =>
      rw [catInj_inj] at h
      cases h.2.1
      contradiction
    | left =>
      rw [catInj_inj] at h
      exact h.2.1.symm
    | leftStep => simp only [catInj_inj, AddLeftCancelMonoid.add_eq_zero,
        one_ne_zero, and_false] at h
  | leftStep =>
    cases h₂ with
    | right _ hac had => cases catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ a₄ (Or.inr had) h.symm
    | rightStep =>
      rw [catInj_inj] at h
      cases h.2.1
      contradiction
    | leftStep =>
      simp only [Function.comp_apply, catInj_inj, add_left_inj, Function.iterate_succ_apply',
        EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h ⊢
      exact ⟨h.1.symm, h.2.1.symm, h.2.2.symm⟩
    | left =>
      simp only [catInj_inj, right_eq_add, AddLeftCancelMonoid.add_eq_zero,
        one_ne_zero, and_false] at h

name: newOrbits_oneOne
statement:
theorem newOrbits_oneOne {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    (newOrbits R).OneOne
proof:
:=
  ⟨newOrbits_injective R, newOrbits_coinjective R⟩

name: permutativeExtension_codomEqDom
statement:
theorem permutativeExtension_codomEqDom {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    (permutativeExtension r R).CodomEqDom
proof:
:= by
  rw [codomEqDom_iff']
  constructor
  · rintro a₁ a₂ (h | h)
    · by_cases had : a₂ ∈ r.dom
      · obtain ⟨a₃, h'⟩ := had
        exact ⟨a₃, Or.inl h'⟩
      · exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.right a₂ had ⟨a₁, h⟩)⟩
    · cases h with
      | left _ had hac =>
        obtain ⟨a₃, h⟩ := had
        exact ⟨a₃, Or.inl h⟩
      | leftStep n a had hac =>
        cases n with
        | zero => exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.left a had hac)⟩
        | succ n => exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.leftStep n a had hac)⟩
      | right _ had hac => exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.rightStep 0 a₁ had hac)⟩
      | rightStep n a had hac => exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.rightStep (n + 1) a had hac)⟩
  · rintro a₁ a₂ (h | h)
    · by_cases hac : a₁ ∈ r.codom
      · obtain ⟨a₃, h'⟩ := hac
        exact ⟨a₃, Or.inl h'⟩
      · exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.left a₁ ⟨a₂, h⟩ hac)⟩
    · cases h with
      | left _ had hac => exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.leftStep 0 a₂ had hac)⟩
      | leftStep n a had hac => exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.leftStep (n + 1) a had hac)⟩
      | right _ had hac =>
        obtain ⟨a₃, h⟩ := hac
        exact ⟨a₃, Or.inl h⟩
      | rightStep n a had hac =>
        cases n with
        | zero => exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.right a had hac)⟩
        | succ n => exact ⟨_, Or.inr (newOrbits.rightStep n a had hac)⟩

name: disjoint_newOrbits_dom
statement:
theorem disjoint_newOrbits_dom {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    Disjoint r.dom (newOrbits R).dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_forall_ne]
  rintro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ⟨a₃, h⟩
  cases h with
  | right => rintro rfl; contradiction
  | _ => exact (catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ _ (Or.inl ha₁)).symm

name: disjoint_newOrbits_codom
statement:
theorem disjoint_newOrbits_codom {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) :
    Disjoint r.codom (newOrbits R).codom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_forall_ne]
  rintro a₁ ha₁ a₂ ⟨a₃, h⟩
  cases h with
  | left => rintro rfl; contradiction
  | _ => exact (catInj_ne_of_mem R _ _ _ (Or.inr ha₁)).symm

name: permutativeExtension_permutative
statement:
theorem permutativeExtension_permutative {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β)
    (hr : r.OneOne) :
    (permutativeExtension r R).Permutative
proof:
:=
  ⟨sup_oneOne hr (newOrbits_oneOne R) (disjoint_newOrbits_dom R) (disjoint_newOrbits_codom R),
    permutativeExtension_codomEqDom R⟩

name: categorise_permutativeExtension_of_oneOne
statement:
theorem categorise_permutativeExtension_of_oneOne
    {r : Rel α α} (R : OrbitRestriction (r.dom ∪ r.codom) β) (hr : r.OneOne)
    {a₁ a₂ : α} (h : r.permutativeExtension R a₁ a₂) :
    r a₁ a₂ ∨ (a₁ ∉ r.dom ∧ a₂ ∉ r.codom ∧ R.categorise a₂ = R.catPerm (R.categorise a₁))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha₁ : a₁ ∈ r.dom
  · obtain ⟨b₁, h₁⟩ := ha₁
    cases (r.permutativeExtension_permutative R hr).coinjective h (Or.inl h₁)
    exact Or.inl h₁
  by_cases ha₂ : a₂ ∈ r.codom
  · obtain ⟨b₁, h₁⟩ := ha₂
    cases (r.permutativeExtension_permutative R hr).injective h (Or.inl h₁)
    exact Or.inl h₁
  · simp only [ha₁, ha₂, not_false_iff, true_and]
    exact categorise_permutativeExtension R h

name: le_permutativeExtension'
proof:
:=
  r.le_permutativeExtension _

name: permutativeExtension'_permutative
proof:
:=
  permutativeExtension_permutative _ hr

name: dom_permutativeExtension'_subset
proof:
:=
  r.dom_permutativeExtension_subset _

name: CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom
statement:
theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

name: CodomEqDom.mem_dom
statement:
theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

name: CodomEqDom.mem_codom
statement:
theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom
proof:
:= by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

name: codomEqDom_iff'
statement:
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

name: OneOne.inv
statement: theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne
proof:
:=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

name: inv_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: inv_injective
statement: theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α)
proof:
:= by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

name: inv_inj
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

name: inv_injective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩

name: inv_coinjective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_coinjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Coinjective ↔ r.Injective
proof:
:=
  inv_injective_iff.symm

name: inv_surjective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Surjective ↔ r.Cosurjective
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.surjective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.cosurjective⟩⟩

name: inv_cosurjective_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective
proof:
:=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

name: inv_functional_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional
proof:
:=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

name: inv_cofunctional_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional
proof:
:=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

name: inv_dom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_dom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.dom = r.codom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: inv_codom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.codom = r.dom
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: inv_image
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_image {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} :
    r.inv.image s = r.preimage s
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: inv_preimage
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_preimage {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} :
    r.inv.preimage s = r.image s
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: comp_inv
statement:
theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :
    (r.comp s).inv = s.inv.comp r.inv
proof:
:= by
  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

name: Injective.image_injective
statement:
theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

name: subset_image_of_preimage_subset
statement:
theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t
proof:
:= by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

name: Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image
statement:
theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t
proof:
:= by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

name: Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image
statement:
theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t
proof:
:=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

name: OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq
statement:
theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

name: CodomEqDom.inv
statement: theorem CodomEqDom.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) : r.inv.CodomEqDom
proof:
:= by
  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

name: Permutative.inv
statement: theorem Permutative.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.Permutative
proof:
:=
  ⟨h.toOneOne.inv, h.toCodomEqDom.inv⟩

name: Permutative.inv_dom
statement: theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom
proof:
:=
  h.codom_eq_dom

name: Injective.comp
statement:
theorem Injective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Injective) (hs : s.Injective) :
    (r.comp s).Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro a₁ a₂ c ⟨b₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ ⟨b₂, hr₂, hs₂⟩
  cases hs.injective hs₁ hs₂
  exact hr.injective hr₁ hr₂

name: Coinjective.comp
statement:
theorem Coinjective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Coinjective) (hs : s.Coinjective) :
    (r.comp s).Coinjective
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]
  exact Injective.comp (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr)

name: Injective.mono
statement:
theorem Injective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Injective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ b h₁ h₂
  exact hs.injective (h a₁ b h₁) (h a₂ b h₂)

name: Coinjective.mono
statement:
theorem Coinjective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Coinjective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Coinjective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro b₁ b₂ a h₁ h₂
  exact hs.coinjective (h a b₁ h₁) (h a b₂ h₂)

name: OneOne.mono
statement:
theorem OneOne.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.OneOne) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.OneOne
proof:
:=
  ⟨hs.toInjective.mono h, hs.toCoinjective.mono h⟩

name: le_of_graph'_subset
statement:
theorem le_of_graph'_subset {r s : Rel α β} (h : r.graph' ⊆ s.graph') :
    r ≤ s
proof:
:=
  λ x y h' ↦ mem_of_subset_of_mem (a := (x, y)) h h'

name: graph'_subset_of_le
statement:
theorem graph'_subset_of_le {r s : Rel α β} (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph'
proof:
:=
  λ z ↦ h z.1 z.2

name: graph'_subset_iff
statement:
theorem graph'_subset_iff {r s : Rel α β} :
    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph' ↔ r ≤ s
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_of_graph'_subset, graph'_subset_of_le⟩

name: graph'_injective
statement:
theorem graph'_injective :
    Function.Injective (Rel.graph' : Rel α β → Set (α × β))
proof:
:=
  λ _ _ h ↦ le_antisymm (le_of_graph'_subset h.le) (le_of_graph'_subset h.symm.le)

name: image_dom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem image_dom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.image r.dom = r.codom
proof:
:=
  preimage_eq_codom_of_domain_subset r subset_rfl

name: preimage_codom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem preimage_codom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.preimage r.codom = r.dom
proof:
:=
  image_dom

name: preimage_subset_dom
statement:
theorem preimage_subset_dom (r : Rel α β) (t : Set β) :
    r.preimage t ⊆ r.dom
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, _, h⟩
  exact ⟨y, h⟩

name: image_subset_codom
statement:
theorem image_subset_codom (r : Rel α β) (s : Set α) :
    r.image s ⊆ r.codom
proof:
:=
  r.inv.preimage_subset_dom s

name: image_empty_of_disjoint_dom
statement:
theorem image_empty_of_disjoint_dom {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} (h : Disjoint r.dom s) :
    r.image s = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  rw [disjoint_iff_forall_ne] at h
  rintro y ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
  exact h ⟨y, hx₂⟩ hx₁ rfl

name: image_eq_of_inter_eq
statement:
theorem image_eq_of_inter_eq {r : Rel α β} {s t : Set α} (h : s ∩ r.dom = t ∩ r.dom) :
    r.image s = r.image t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, has, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨hat, _⟩ := (h a).mp ⟨has, b, hab⟩
    exact ⟨a, hat, hab⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, hat, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨has, _⟩ := (h a).mpr ⟨hat, b, hab⟩
    exact ⟨a, has, hab⟩

name: Injective.image_diff
statement:
theorem Injective.image_diff {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) (s t : Set α) :
    r.image (s \ t) = r.image s \ r.image t
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
    refine ⟨⟨x, hx₁.1, hx₂⟩, ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨z, hz₁, hz₂⟩
    cases h.injective hx₂ hz₂
    exact hx₁.2 hz₁
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩, hy⟩
    refine ⟨x, ⟨hx₁, ?_⟩, hx₂⟩
    intro hx
    exact hy ⟨x, hx, hx₂⟩

name: Injective.image_symmDiff
statement:
theorem Injective.image_symmDiff {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) (s t : Set α) :
    r.image (s ∆ t) = r.image s ∆ r.image t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.symmDiff_def, Set.symmDiff_def, image_union, h.image_diff, h.image_diff]

name: image_eq_of_le_of_le
statement:
theorem image_eq_of_le_of_le {r s : Rel α β} (h : r ≤ s) {t : Set α} (ht : ∀ x ∈ t, s x ≤ r x) :
    r.image t = s.image t
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, h x y hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    exact ⟨x, hx, ht x hx y hy⟩

name: sup_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_inv {r s : Rel α β} :
    (r ⊔ s).inv = r.inv ⊔ s.inv
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: sup_apply
statement:
theorem sup_apply {r s : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    (r ⊔ s) x y ↔ r x y ∨ s x y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: sup_dom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_dom {r s : Rel α β} :
    (r ⊔ s).dom = r.dom ∪ s.dom
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [dom, mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, sup_apply]
  exact exists_or

name: sup_codom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_codom {r s : Rel α β} :
    (r ⊔ s).codom = r.codom ∪ s.codom
proof:
:=
  sup_dom

name: sup_image
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sup_image {r s : Rel α β} (t : Set α) :
    (r ⊔ s).image t = r.image t ∪ s.image t
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂ | hx₂⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
  · rintro (⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩ | ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩)
    · exact ⟨x, hx₁, Or.inl hx₂⟩
    · exact ⟨x, hx₁, Or.inr hx₂⟩

name: sup_injective
statement:
theorem sup_injective {r s : Rel α β} (hr : r.Injective) (hs : s.Injective)
    (h : Disjoint r.codom s.codom) : (r ⊔ s).Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro x₁ x₂ y (h₁ | h₁) (h₂ | h₂)
  · exact hr.injective h₁ h₂
  · cases h.ne_of_mem ⟨x₁, h₁⟩ ⟨x₂, h₂⟩ rfl
  · cases h.ne_of_mem ⟨x₂, h₂⟩ ⟨x₁, h₁⟩ rfl
  · exact hs.injective h₁ h₂

name: sup_coinjective
statement:
theorem sup_coinjective {r s : Rel α β} (hr : r.Coinjective) (hs : s.Coinjective)
    (h : Disjoint r.dom s.dom) : (r ⊔ s).Coinjective
proof:
:=
  inv_coinjective_iff.mpr <| sup_injective (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) h

name: sup_oneOne
statement:
theorem sup_oneOne {r s : Rel α β} (hr : r.OneOne) (hs : s.OneOne)
    (h₁ : Disjoint r.dom s.dom) (h₂ : Disjoint r.codom s.codom) : (r ⊔ s).OneOne
proof:
:=
  ⟨sup_injective hr.toInjective hs.toInjective h₂,
    sup_coinjective hr.toCoinjective hs.toCoinjective h₁⟩

name: sup_codomEqDom
statement:
theorem sup_codomEqDom {r s : Rel α α} (hr : r.CodomEqDom) (hs : s.CodomEqDom) :
    (r ⊔ s).CodomEqDom
proof:
:=
  ⟨sup_codom.trans <| hr.codom_eq_dom ▸ hs.codom_eq_dom ▸ sup_dom.symm⟩

name: sup_permutative
statement:
theorem sup_permutative {r s : Rel α α} (hr : r.Permutative) (hs : s.Permutative)
    (h : Disjoint r.dom s.dom) : (r ⊔ s).Permutative
proof:
:=
  ⟨sup_oneOne hr.toOneOne hs.toOneOne h (hr.codom_eq_dom ▸ hs.codom_eq_dom ▸ h),
    sup_codomEqDom hr.toCodomEqDom hs.toCodomEqDom⟩

name: inf_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inf_inv {r s : Rel α β} :
    (r ⊓ s).inv = r.inv ⊓ s.inv
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: inf_apply
statement:
theorem inf_apply {r s : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    (r ⊓ s) x y ↔ r x y ∧ s x y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: inf_dom
statement:
theorem inf_dom {r s : Rel α β} :
    (r ⊓ s).dom ⊆ r.dom ∩ s.dom
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨y, hy⟩
  exact ⟨⟨y, hy.1⟩, ⟨y, hy.2⟩⟩

name: inf_codom
statement:
theorem inf_codom {r s : Rel α β} :
    (r ⊓ s).codom ⊆ r.codom ∩ s.codom
proof:
:=
  inf_dom

name: inv_le_inv_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem inv_le_inv_iff {r s : Rel α β} :
    r.inv ≤ s.inv ↔ r ≤ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x y
    exact h y x
  · intro h y x
    exact h x y

name: iSup_apply_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iSup_apply_iff {T : Type _} {r : T → Rel α β} (x : α) (y : β) :
    (⨆ t, r t) x y ↔ ∃ t, r t x y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨⟨_, ⟨_, t, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, ht⟩
    exact ⟨t, ht⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
    exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨_, ⟨_, t, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, ht⟩

name: biSup_apply_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem biSup_apply_iff {T : Type _} {r : T → Rel α β} {s : Set T} (x : α) (y : β) :
    (⨆ t ∈ s, r t) x y ↔ ∃ t ∈ s, r t x y
proof:
:= by
  have := iSup_apply_iff (r := λ t : s ↦ r t) x y
  simp only [iSup_subtype'', Subtype.exists, exists_prop] at this
  exact this

name: iSup_dom
statement:
theorem iSup_dom {T : Type _} (r : T → Rel α β) :
    (⨆ t, r t).dom = ⋃ t, (r t).dom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [dom, iSup_apply_iff, Set.ext_iff, mem_setOf_eq, mem_iUnion]
  exact λ x ↦ exists_comm

name: biSup_dom
statement:
theorem biSup_dom {T : Type _} (r : T → Rel α β) (s : Set T) :
    (⨆ t ∈ s, r t).dom = ⋃ t ∈ s, (r t).dom
proof:
:= by
  have := iSup_dom (λ t : s ↦ r t)
  rwa [iSup_subtype'', iUnion_coe_set] at this

name: isChain_inv
statement:
theorem isChain_inv {T : Type _} {r : T → Rel α β} (h : IsChain (· ≤ ·) (Set.range r)) :
    IsChain (· ≤ ·) (Set.range (λ t ↦ (r t).inv))
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨t₁, rfl⟩ _ ⟨t₂, rfl⟩ _
  dsimp only
  rw [inv_le_inv_iff, inv_le_inv_iff]
  apply h.total ⟨t₁, rfl⟩ ⟨t₂, rfl⟩

name: iSup_inv
statement:
theorem iSup_inv {T : Type _} {r : T → Rel α β} :
    (⨆ t, (r t).inv) = (⨆ t, r t).inv
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm <;>
  · rintro x y h
    simp only [inv, iSup_apply_iff, flip] at h ⊢
    exact h

name: iSup_injective_of_isChain
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro x₁ x₂ y hx₁ hx₂
  rw [iSup_apply_iff] at hx₁ hx₂
  obtain ⟨t₁, hx₁⟩ := hx₁
  obtain ⟨t₂, hx₂⟩ := hx₂
  obtain (h | h) := h₂.total ⟨t₁, rfl⟩ ⟨t₂, rfl⟩
  · exact (h₁ t₂).injective (h x₁ y hx₁) hx₂
  · exact (h₁ t₁).injective hx₁ (h x₂ y hx₂)

name: iSup_coinjective_of_isChain
proof:
:= by
  have := iSup_injective_of_isChain (r := λ t ↦ (r t).inv) ?_ (isChain_inv h₂)
  · rwa [iSup_inv, inv_injective_iff] at this
  · intro t
    rw [inv_injective_iff]
    exact h₁ t

name: iSup_codomEqDom_of_isChain
statement:
theorem iSup_codomEqDom_of_isChain {T : Type _} {r : T → Rel α α} (h : ∀ t, (r t).CodomEqDom) :
    (⨆ t, r t).CodomEqDom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [codomEqDom_iff'] at h ⊢
  simp only [iSup_apply_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro x y ⟨t, ht⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (h t).1 x y ht
    exact ⟨u, t, hu⟩
  · rintro x y ⟨t, ht⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (h t).2 x y ht
    exact ⟨u, t, hu⟩

name: iSup_oneOne_of_isChain
proof:
:=
  ⟨iSup_injective_of_isChain (λ t ↦ (h₁ t).toInjective) h₂,
    iSup_coinjective_of_isChain (λ t ↦ (h₁ t).toCoinjective) h₂⟩

name: iSup_permutative_of_isChain
proof:
:=
  ⟨iSup_oneOne_of_isChain (λ t ↦ (h₁ t).toOneOne) h₂,
    iSup_codomEqDom_of_isChain (λ t ↦ (h₁ t).toCodomEqDom)⟩

name: biSup_permutative_of_isChain
proof:
:= by
  have := iSup_permutative_of_isChain (T := s) (λ t ↦ h₁ t t.prop) ?_
  · rwa [iSup_subtype] at this
  · rwa [image_eq_range] at h₂

name: toFunction_rel
statement:
theorem toFunction_rel (r : Rel α β) (hr : r.Functional) (a : α) :
    r a (r.toFunction hr a)
proof:
:=
  (hr.cosurjective a).choose_spec

name: toFunction_eq_iff
statement:
theorem toFunction_eq_iff (r : Rel α β) (hr : r.Functional) (a : α) (b : β) :
    r.toFunction hr a = b ↔ r a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro rfl
    exact toFunction_rel r hr a
  · intro h
    exact hr.coinjective (toFunction_rel r hr a) h

name: toEquiv_rel
statement:
theorem toEquiv_rel (r : Rel α β) (hr : r.Bijective) (a : α) :
    r a (r.toEquiv hr a)
proof:
:=
  toFunction_rel r hr.toFunctional a

name: toEquiv_eq_iff
statement:
theorem toEquiv_eq_iff (r : Rel α β) (hr : r.Bijective) (a : α) (b : β) :
    r.toEquiv hr a = b ↔ r a b
proof:
:=
  toFunction_eq_iff r hr.toFunctional a b

name: toFunction_image
statement:
theorem toFunction_image (r : Rel α β) (hr : r.Functional) (s : Set α) :
    r.toFunction hr '' s = r.image s
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    rw [toFunction_eq_iff] at hy
    exact ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    refine ⟨x, hx, ?_⟩
    rwa [toFunction_eq_iff]

name: toEquiv_image
statement:
theorem toEquiv_image (r : Rel α β) (hr : r.Bijective) (s : Set α) :
    r.toEquiv hr '' s = r.image s
proof:
:=
  r.toFunction_image hr.toFunctional s

name: card_reflTransGen
statement:
theorem card_reflTransGen₁_lt (hr : ∀ y, #{x | r x y} < κ) (hκ : κ.IsRegular)
    (s : Set α) (hs : #s < κ) :
    #(reflTransGen₁ r s) < κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflTransGen₁, card_biUnion_lt_iff_forall_of_isRegular hκ hs]
  intro x _
  exact hr x

name: card_reflTransGen
statement:
theorem card_reflTransGenₙ_lt (hr : ∀ y, #{x | r x y} < κ) (hκ : κ.IsRegular)
    (s : Set α) (hs : #s < κ) (n : ℕ) :
    #(reflTransGenₙ r n s) < κ
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => exact hs
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [reflTransGenₙ, Function.iterate_succ']
    exact card_reflTransGen₁_lt hr hκ _ ih

name: reflTransGen'_iff
statement:
theorem reflTransGen'_iff (r : Rel α α) (x y : α) :
    reflTransGen' r x y ↔ ReflTransGen r x y
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflTransGen', reflTransGenₙ, Set.mem_iUnion]
  unfold reflTransGen₁
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨n, hx⟩
    induction n generalizing x with
    | zero =>
      cases hx
      exact ReflTransGen.refl
    | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ'] at hx
      obtain ⟨s, ⟨z, _, rfl⟩, _, ⟨hz, rfl⟩, hx⟩ := hx
      exact ReflTransGen.head hx (ih z hz)
  · intro h
    induction h using ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
    | refl => exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    | head hx _ ih =>
      obtain ⟨n, h⟩ := ih
      use n + 1
      rw [Function.iterate_succ']
      refine ⟨_, ⟨_, rfl⟩, _, ⟨h, rfl⟩, hx⟩

name: card_reflTransGen_lt
statement:
theorem card_reflTransGen_lt (hr : ∀ y, #{x | r x y} < κ)
    (hκ₁ : κ.IsRegular) (hκ₂ : ℵ₀ < κ) (y : α) :
    #{x | ReflTransGen r x y} < κ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← reflTransGen'_iff, reflTransGen']
  change #(⋃ n, {x | reflTransGenₙ r n {y} x}) < κ
  suffices #(⋃ n : ULift.{u} ℕ, {x | reflTransGenₙ r n.down {y} x}) < κ by
    convert this using 3
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ULift.exists]
  rw [card_iUnion_lt_iff_forall_of_isRegular hκ₁]
  · simp only [ULift.forall]
    apply card_reflTransGenₙ_lt hr hκ₁
    simp only [mk_fintype, Fintype.card_ofSubsingleton, Nat.cast_one]
    exact one_lt_aleph0.trans hκ₂
  · rw [mk_eq_aleph0]
    exact hκ₂

name: card_transGen_lt
statement:
theorem card_transGen_lt (hr : ∀ y, #{x | r x y} < κ) (hκ₁ : κ.IsRegular) (hκ₂ : ℵ₀ < κ) (y : α) :
    #{x | TransGen r x y} < κ
proof:
:=
  (mk_le_mk_of_subset (λ _ ↦ TransGen.to_reflTransGen)).trans_lt (card_reflTransGen_lt hr hκ₁ hκ₂ y)

name: card_reflTransGen_le
statement:
theorem card_reflTransGen_le (hr : ∀ y, #{x | r x y} ≤ κ) (hκ : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (y : α) :
    #{x | ReflTransGen r x y} ≤ κ
proof:
:= by
  have := card_reflTransGen_lt (r := r) (κ := Order.succ κ) ?_ ?_ ?_ y
  · rwa [Order.lt_succ_iff] at this
  · intro x
    rw [Order.lt_succ_iff]
    exact hr x
  · exact isRegular_succ hκ
  · rwa [Order.lt_succ_iff]

name: card_transGen_le
statement:
theorem card_transGen_le (hr : ∀ y, #{x | r x y} ≤ κ) (hκ : ℵ₀ ≤ κ) (y : α) :
    #{x | TransGen r x y} ≤ κ
proof:
:=
  (mk_le_mk_of_subset (λ _ ↦ TransGen.to_reflTransGen)).trans (card_reflTransGen_le hr hκ y)

name: Set.symmDiff_trans_subset
statement:
theorem Set.symmDiff_trans_subset {α : Type _} (s t u : Set α) :
    s ∆ u ⊆ s ∆ t ∪ t ∆ u
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simp only [mem_symmDiff, mem_union]
  tauto

name: Set.diff_symmDiff_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Set.diff_symmDiff_self {α : Type _} (s t : Set α) :
    s \ (s ∆ t) = s ∩ t
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_symmDiff, mem_diff, mem_inter_iff]
  tauto

name: Set.symmDiff_diff_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Set.symmDiff_diff_self {α : Type _} (s t : Set α) :
    s ∆ (s \ t) = s ∩ t
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_symmDiff, mem_diff, mem_inter_iff]
  tauto

name: Set.inter_union_symmDiff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Set.inter_union_symmDiff {α : Type _} (s t : Set α) :
    s ∩ t ∪ s ∆ t = s ∪ t
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [mem_union, mem_inter_iff, mem_symmDiff]
  tauto

name: Set.inter_subset_symmDiff_union_symmDiff
statement:
theorem Set.inter_subset_symmDiff_union_symmDiff {α : Type _} {s t u v : Set α} (h : Disjoint u v) :
    s ∩ t ⊆ s ∆ u ∪ t ∆ v
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simp only [Set.disjoint_iff, subset_def, mem_empty_iff_false] at h
  simp only [mem_inter_iff, mem_union, and_imp, mem_symmDiff]
  tauto

name: Set.union_symmDiff_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem Set.union_symmDiff_of_disjoint {α : Type _} {s t u : Set α} (h : Disjoint t u) :
    (s ∪ t) ∆ u = (s ∆ u) ∪ t
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_union]
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_forall_ne] at h
  tauto

name: Set.inter_symmDiff_left
statement:
theorem Set.inter_symmDiff_left {α : Type _} {s t : Set α} :
    (s ∩ t) ∆ s = s \ t
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_diff]
  tauto

name: Set.smul_set_def
statement:
theorem Set.smul_set_def {α β : Type _} {x : α} {s : Set β} [SMul α β] :
    x • s = (x • ·) '' s
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Set.subset_smul_set
statement:
theorem Set.subset_smul_set {α β : Type _} {x : α} {s t : Set β} [Group α] [MulAction α β] :
    t ⊆ x • s ↔ x⁻¹ • t ⊆ s
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro h _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    simp only [← mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
    exact h ha
  · intro h a ha
    refine ⟨x⁻¹ • a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · apply h
      rwa [smul_mem_smul_set_iff]
    · simp only [smul_inv_smul]

name: Set.symmDiff_smul_set
statement:
theorem Set.symmDiff_smul_set {α β : Type _} {x : α} {s t : Set β} [Group α] [MulAction α β] :
    x • s ∆ t = (x • s) ∆ (x • t)
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [Set.mem_smul_set, Set.mem_symmDiff]
  aesop

name: Set.bounded_lt_union
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ht
  use max x y
  rintro b (hb | hb)
  · rw [lt_max_iff]
    exact Or.inl (hx b hb)
  · rw [lt_max_iff]
    exact Or.inr (hy b hb)

name: type_withBot
statement:
@[simp]
theorem type_withBot {α : Type u} [Preorder α] [IsWellOrder α (· < ·)] :
    type ((· < ·) : WithBot α → WithBot α → Prop) = 1 + type ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop)
proof:
:= by
  change _ = type EmptyRelation + _
  rw [← type_sum_lex, type_eq]
  exact ⟨withBotOrderIso⟩

name: noMaxOrder_of_isLimit
statement:
theorem noMaxOrder_of_isLimit {α : Type u} [Preorder α] [IsWellOrder α (· < ·)]
    (h : (type ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop)).IsLimit) : NoMaxOrder α
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro a
  have := (succ_lt_of_isLimit h).mpr (typein_lt_type (· < ·) a)
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := typein_surj (· < ·) this
  use b
  have := Order.lt_succ (typein ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop) a)
  rw [← hb, typein_lt_typein] at this
  exact this

name: isLimit_of_noMaxOrder
statement:
theorem isLimit_of_noMaxOrder {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] [Preorder α] [IsWellOrder α (· < ·)]
    (h : NoMaxOrder α) : (type ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop)).IsLimit
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · simp only [isMin_iff_eq_bot, bot_eq_zero, type_eq_zero_iff_isEmpty, not_isEmpty_of_nonempty,
      not_false_eq_true]
  · intro o ho
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h.exists_gt (enum ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop) ⟨o, ho.1⟩)
    have := ho.2
    refine this ?_ (typein_lt_type ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop) x)
    rwa [← typein_lt_typein ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop), typein_enum] at hx

name: isLimit_iff_noMaxOrder
statement:
theorem isLimit_iff_noMaxOrder {α : Type u} [Nonempty α] [Preorder α] [IsWellOrder α (· < ·)] :
    (type ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop)).IsLimit ↔ NoMaxOrder α
proof:
:=
  ⟨noMaxOrder_of_isLimit, isLimit_of_noMaxOrder⟩

name: type_Iio_lt
statement:
theorem type_Iio_lt {α : Type u} [LtWellOrder α] (x : α) :
    type (Subrel ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop) (Set.Iio x)) < type ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop)
proof:
:=
  @typein_lt_type _ _ (inferInstanceAs (IsWellOrder α (· < ·))) x

name: type_Iic_eq
statement:
theorem type_Iic_eq {α : Type u} [LtWellOrder α] (x : α) :
    type (Subrel ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop) (Set.Iic x)) =
    type (Subrel ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop) (Set.Iio x)) + 1
proof:
:= by
  change _ = _ + type EmptyRelation
  rw [← type_sum_lex, type_eq]
  exact ⟨iicOrderIso x⟩

name: type_Iic_lt
statement:
theorem type_Iic_lt {α : Type u} [LtWellOrder α] [NoMaxOrder α] (x : α) :
    type (Subrel ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop) (Set.Iic x)) < type ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop)
proof:
:= by
  rw [type_Iic_eq]
  haveI : Nonempty α := ⟨x⟩
  have h := isLimit_of_noMaxOrder (inferInstanceAs (NoMaxOrder α))
  exact h.2.succ_lt (type_Iio_lt x)

name: lift_typein_apply
statement:
theorem lift_typein_apply {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {r : α → α → Prop} {s : β → β → Prop}
    [IsWellOrder α r] [IsWellOrder β s]
    (f : r ≼i s) (a : α) :
    Ordinal.lift.{max u v, v} (Ordinal.typein s (f a)) =
    Ordinal.lift.{max u v, u} (Ordinal.typein r a)
proof:
:= by
  symm
  apply Quotient.sound
  constructor
  refine RelIso.ofSurjective ⟨⟨λ x ↦ ⟨f x.down, ?_⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩ ?_
  · simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, f.map_rel_iff]
    exact x.down.prop
  · intro x y h
    apply ULift.down_injective
    apply Subtype.coe_injective
    simp only [ULift.up_inj, Subtype.mk.injEq,
      EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq] at h
    exact h
  · intro x y
    simp only [Order.Preimage, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, subrel_val]
    exact f.map_rel_iff
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := f.mem_range_of_rel x.down.prop
    refine ⟨ULift.up ⟨y, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · have := x.down.prop
      rwa [← hy, f.map_rel_iff] at this
    · apply ULift.down_injective
      apply Subtype.coe_injective
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.coe_setOf, RelEmbedding.coe_mk, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
      exact hy

name: card_Iio
statement: theorem card_Iio (o : Ordinal.{u}) : #(Set.Iio o) = Cardinal.lift.{u + 1} o.card
proof:
:= by
  rw [Cardinal.eq.mpr ⟨o.enumIsoToType.toEquiv.trans Equiv.ulift.{u + 1, u}.symm⟩,
    mk_uLift, mk_toType, lift_card]

name: type_Iio
statement:
theorem type_Iio (o : Ordinal.{u}) :
    type ((· < ·) : Set.Iio o → Set.Iio o → Prop) = lift.{u + 1} o
proof:
:= by
  have := Ordinal.lift_type_eq.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
    (r := ((· < ·) : Set.Iio o → Set.Iio o → Prop))
    (s := ((· < ·) : o.toType → o.toType → Prop))
  rw [lift_id, type_toType] at this
  rw [this]
  exact ⟨o.enumIsoToType.toRelIsoLT⟩

name: typein_Iio
statement:
@[simp]
theorem typein_Iio {o : Ordinal.{u}} (x : Set.Iio o) :
    typein ((· < ·) : Set.Iio o → Set.Iio o → Prop) x = lift.{u + 1} x
proof:
:= by
  have := lift_typein_apply
      (r := ((· < ·) : Set.Iio o → Set.Iio o → Prop))
      (s := ((· < ·) : Ordinal → Ordinal → Prop))
      (f := ⟨⟨⟨Subtype.val, Subtype.val_injective⟩, ?_⟩, ?_⟩) x
  · rw [lift_id, lift_id, typein_ordinal] at this
    exact this.symm
  · rfl
  · simp only [RelEmbedding.coe_mk, Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk, Subtype.range_coe_subtype,
      Set.mem_Iio, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Subtype.forall]
    intro a ha b hb
    exact hb.trans ha

name: add_lt_ord
statement:
theorem add_lt_ord (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) {x y : Ordinal.{u}}
    (hx : x < c.ord) (hy : y < c.ord) : x + y < c.ord
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_ord] at hx hy ⊢
  rw [card_add]
  exact Cardinal.add_lt_of_lt h hx hy

name: ord_pos
statement: theorem ord_pos (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : 0 < c.ord
proof:
:= by
  rw [lt_ord, card_zero]
  exact aleph0_pos.trans_le h

name: iioAdd_def
statement:
@[simp]
theorem iioAdd_def (x y : Set.Iio c.ord) :
    letI
proof:
:= iioAdd h
    ((x + y : Set.Iio c.ord) : Ordinal) = x + y :=
  rfl

name: nat_lt_ord
statement: theorem nat_lt_ord (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) (n : ℕ) : n < c.ord
proof:
:= by
  apply (nat_lt_omega0 n).trans_le
  apply ord_mono at h
  rwa [ord_aleph0] at h

name: iioOfNat_coe
statement:
theorem iioOfNat_coe (n : ℕ) :
    letI
proof:
:= iioOfNat h
    ((OfNat.ofNat n : Set.Iio c.ord) : Ordinal) = n :=
  rfl

name: iio_noMaxOrder
statement: theorem iio_noMaxOrder (h : ℵ₀ ≤ c) : NoMaxOrder (Set.Iio c.ord)
proof:
:= by
  letI := iioAdd h
  letI := iioOfNat h
  constructor
  intro x
  use x + 1
  rw [← Subtype.coe_lt_coe, iioAdd_def, lt_add_iff_pos_right, iioOfNat_coe, Nat.cast_one]
  exact zero_lt_one

name: le_def
statement:
theorem le_def [LE β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.le
    x ≤ y ↔ e x ≤ e y :=
  Iff.rfl

name: lt_def
statement:
theorem lt_def [LT β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.lt
    x < y ↔ e x < e y :=
  Iff.rfl

name: min_def
statement:
theorem min_def [Min β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.min
    x ⊓ y = e.symm (e x ⊓ e y) :=
  rfl

name: apply_min
statement:
theorem apply_min [Min β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.min
    e (x ⊓ y) = e x ⊓ e y := by
  rw [min_def, apply_symm_apply]

name: max_def
statement:
theorem max_def [Max β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.max
    x ⊔ y = e.symm (e x ⊔ e y) :=
  rfl

name: apply_max
statement:
theorem apply_max [Max β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.max
    e (x ⊔ y) = e x ⊔ e y := by
  rw [max_def, apply_symm_apply]

name: compare_def
statement:
theorem compare_def [Ord β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.compare
    compare x y = compare (e x) (e y) :=
  rfl

name: ltWellOrder_type
statement:
theorem ltWellOrder_type [LtWellOrder β] :
    letI
proof:
:= e.ltWellOrder
    Ordinal.lift.{max u v, u} (Ordinal.type ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop)) =
    Ordinal.lift.{max u v, v} (Ordinal.type ((· < ·) : β → β → Prop)) := by
  rw [Ordinal.lift_type_eq.{u, v, max u v}]
  exact ⟨e.ltIso⟩

name: ltWellOrder_typein
statement:
theorem ltWellOrder_typein [i : LtWellOrder β] (x : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.ltWellOrder.toLT
    Ordinal.lift.{max u v, v} (Ordinal.typein ((· < ·) : β → β → Prop) (e x)) =
    Ordinal.lift.{max u v, u} (Ordinal.typein ((· < ·) : α → α → Prop) x) := by
  letI := e.ltWellOrder
  refine Ordinal.lift_typein_apply (r := (· < ·)) (s := (· < ·)) (f := ⟨⟨e.toEmbedding, ?_⟩, ?_⟩) x
  · rfl
  · simp only [RelEmbedding.coe_mk, coe_toEmbedding]
    intro a b _
    use e.symm b
    exact apply_symm_apply e b

name: noMaxOrder
statement:
protected theorem noMaxOrder [LT β] [NoMaxOrder β] :
    letI
proof:
:= e.lt
    NoMaxOrder α := by
  letI := e.lt
  constructor
  intro x
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_gt (e x)
  use e.symm y
  rw [lt_def, apply_symm_apply]
  exact hy

name: apply_add
statement:
theorem apply_add [Add β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.add
    e (x + y) = e x + e y := by
  rw [add_def, apply_symm_apply]

name: apply_sub
statement:
theorem apply_sub [Sub β] (x y : α) :
    letI
proof:
:= e.sub
    e (x - y) = e x - e y := by
  rw [sub_def, apply_symm_apply]

name: apply_zero
statement:
theorem apply_zero [Zero β] :
    letI
proof:
:= e.zero
    e 0 = 0 := by
  rw [zero_def, apply_symm_apply]

name: graph'_injective
statement: theorem graph'_injective {α β : Type _} : Injective (graph' : (α → β) → Set (α × β))
proof:
:= by
  intro f g h
  ext x
  have : (x, f x) ∈ graph' f := rfl
  rwa [h] at this

name: card_graph'_eq
statement: theorem card_graph'_eq {α β : Type _} (f : α → β) : #(f.graph') = #α
