    ¬Inflexible A N₁ᴸ → ¬Inflexible A N₂ᴸ → ¬Inflexible A N₃ᴸ → ¬Inflexible A N₄ᴸ →
    N₁ᴸ = N₃ᴸ → N₂ᴸ = N₄ᴸ
proof:
:= by
  intro h₁₂ h₃₄ h₁ h₂ _ _ h₁₃
  obtain ⟨c, hN₁, hN₂⟩ := convNearLitters_of_spec_eq_spec h h₁₂
  obtain (⟨-, rfl⟩ | hN₁) := hN₁
  swap
  · cases h₁ (inflexible_of_mem_dom_nearLitterCondInflexRel ⟨c, hN₁⟩)
  obtain (⟨-, h⟩ | hN₂) := hN₂
  swap
  · cases h₂ (inflexible_of_mem_dom_nearLitterCondInflexRel ⟨_, hN₂⟩)
  rw [NearLitterCond.flex.injEq, FlexCond.mk.injEq, Set.ext_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂⟩ := h₃₄
  obtain ⟨N', hN'₁, hN'₂⟩ := (h i).mp ⟨N₃, hi₁, h₁₃⟩
  cases (T ⇘. A)ᴺ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hi₂ hN'₁
  exact hN'₂

name: atoms_of_inflexible_of_spec_eq_spec
statement:
theorem atoms_of_inflexible_of_spec_eq_spec (h : S.spec = T.spec) (A : β ↝ ⊥)
    (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter) (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (ρ : AllPerm P.δ) :
    A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘. → N₁ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε t → N₂ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε (ρ • t) →
    convNearLitters S T A N₁ N₂ → ∀ (B : P.δ ↝ ⊥), ∀ a ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ,
    ∀ i, (S ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.rel i a → (T ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.rel i (ρᵁ B • a)
proof:
:= by
  rintro hA ht₁ ht₂ hN B a ⟨j, hj⟩ i h'
  obtain ⟨c, h₁, h₂⟩ := convNearLitters_of_spec_eq_spec h hN
  obtain (⟨h₁, -⟩ | ⟨P', t', hA', ht', rfl⟩) := h₁
  · cases h₁ ⟨P, t, hA, ht₁⟩
  cases inflexiblePath_subsingleton hA hA' ht₁ ht'
  cases fuzz_injective (ht₁.symm.trans ht')
  clear hA' ht'
  obtain ⟨t', -, hN₂, -, hBa, hBN⟩ := nearLitterCondRel_inflex h₂
  cases fuzz_injective (ht₂.symm.trans hN₂)
  simp only [Tangle.smul_support, smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_atoms,
    BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters] at hBa
  conv at hBa =>
    rw [funext_iff]; intro
    rw [funext_iff]; intro
    rw [funext_iff]; intro
    rw [eq_iff_iff]
  obtain ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := (hBa B i j).mp ⟨a, h', hj⟩
  cases (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hj hb₂
  rwa [smul_inv_smul]

name: nearLitters_of_inflexible_of_spec_eq_spec
statement:
theorem nearLitters_of_inflexible_of_spec_eq_spec (h : S.spec = T.spec) (A : β ↝ ⊥)
    (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter) (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (ρ : AllPerm P.δ) :
    A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘. → N₁ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε t → N₂ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε (ρ • t) →
    convNearLitters S T A N₁ N₂ → ∀ (B : P.δ ↝ ⊥), ∀ N ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ,
    ∀ i, (S ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.rel i N → (T ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.rel i (ρᵁ B • N)
proof:
:= by
  rintro hA ht₁ ht₂ hN B N ⟨j, hj⟩ i h'
  obtain ⟨c, h₁, h₂⟩ := convNearLitters_of_spec_eq_spec h hN
  obtain (⟨h₁, -⟩ | ⟨P', t', hA', ht', rfl⟩) := h₁
  · cases h₁ ⟨P, t, hA, ht₁⟩
  cases inflexiblePath_subsingleton hA hA' ht₁ ht'
  cases fuzz_injective (ht₁.symm.trans ht')
  clear hA' ht'
  obtain ⟨t', -, hN₂, -, hBa, hBN⟩ := nearLitterCondRel_inflex h₂
  cases fuzz_injective (ht₂.symm.trans hN₂)
  simp only [Tangle.smul_support, smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters,
    BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters] at hBN
  conv at hBN =>
    rw [funext_iff]; intro
    rw [funext_iff]; intro
    rw [funext_iff]; intro
    rw [eq_iff_iff]
  obtain ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := (hBN B i j).mp ⟨N, h', hj⟩
  cases (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hj hb₂
  rwa [smul_inv_smul]

name: sameSpecLe_of_spec_eq_spec
statement:
theorem sameSpecLe_of_spec_eq_spec (h : S.spec = T.spec) :
    SameSpecLE S T where
  atoms_bound_eq
proof:
:= atoms_bound_eq_of_spec_eq_spec h
  nearLitters_bound_eq := nearLitters_bound_eq_of_spec_eq_spec h
  atoms_dom_subset := atoms_dom_subset_of_spec_eq_spec h
  nearLitters_dom_subset := nearLitters_dom_subset_of_spec_eq_spec h
  convAtoms_injective := convAtoms_injective_of_spec_eq_spec h
  atomMemRel_le := atomMemRel_le_of_spec_eq_spec h
  inflexible_of_inflexible := inflexible_of_inflexible_of_spec_eq_spec h
  litter_eq_of_flexible := litter_eq_of_flexible_of_spec_eq_spec h
  atoms_of_inflexible := atoms_of_inflexible_of_spec_eq_spec h
  nearLitters_of_inflexible := nearLitters_of_inflexible_of_spec_eq_spec h

name: atoms_subset_of_sameSpec
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hj
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (sameSpec_comm h).atoms_dom_of_dom hj
  cases (h.convAtoms_oneOne A).injective ⟨i, ha, hb⟩ ⟨j, hc, hj⟩
  exact hc

name: nearLitters_subset_of_sameSpec
proof:
:= by
  intro j hj
  obtain ⟨N, hN₁, hN₂⟩ := hj
  obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := (sameSpec_comm h).nearLitters_dom_of_dom hN₁
  refine ⟨N', hN', ?_⟩
  have := h.atomMemRel_eq A
  rw [atomMemRel, atomMemRel] at this
  conv at this =>
    rw [funext_iff]; intro
    rw [funext_iff]; intro
    rw [eq_iff_iff]
  obtain ⟨N'', hN'', c, hc₁, hc₂⟩ := (this j i).mpr ⟨N, hN₁, b, hN₂, hb⟩
  cases (S ⇘. A)ᴺ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hN' hN''
  cases (S ⇘. A)ᴬ.rel_coinjective.coinjective ha hc₂
  exact hc₁

name: nearLitterCondRelFlex_of_convNearLitters_aux
statement:
theorem nearLitterCondRelFlex_of_convNearLitters_aux (h : SameSpec S T) {A : β ↝ ⊥}
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (hN : convNearLitters S T A N₁ N₂)
    (hN₁i : ¬Inflexible A N₁ᴸ) (hN₂i : ¬Inflexible A N₂ᴸ) (i : κ) :
    (∃ N₃, (S ⇘. A)ᴺ.rel i N₃ ∧ N₁ᴸ = N₃ᴸ) → ∃ N₃, (T ⇘. A)ᴺ.rel i N₃ ∧ N₂ᴸ = N₃ᴸ
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨N₃, hN₃, hN₃'⟩
  obtain ⟨N₄, hN₄⟩ := h.nearLitters_dom_of_dom hN₃
  refine ⟨N₄, hN₄, ?_⟩
  rw [← h.litter_eq_iff_of_flexible hN ⟨i, hN₃, hN₄⟩ hN₁i hN₂i]
  · exact hN₃'
  · rwa [← hN₃']
  · apply (h.inflexible_iff' ⟨i, hN₃, hN₄⟩).mpr.mt
    rwa [← hN₃']

name: nearLitterCondRelFlex_of_convNearLitters
statement:
theorem nearLitterCondRelFlex_of_convNearLitters (h : SameSpec S T) {A : β ↝ ⊥}
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (hN : convNearLitters S T A N₁ N₂)
    (hN₁i : ¬Inflexible A N₁ᴸ) (hN₂i : ¬Inflexible A N₂ᴸ) :
    nearLitterCondRelFlex T A N₂ (.flex ⟨{i | ∃ N₃, (S ⇘. A)ᴺ.rel i N₃ ∧ N₁ᴸ = N₃ᴸ}⟩)
proof:
:= by
  use hN₂i
  rw [NearLitterCond.flex.injEq, FlexCond.mk.injEq]
  ext i
  constructor
  · exact nearLitterCondRelFlex_of_convNearLitters_aux h hN hN₁i hN₂i i
  · refine nearLitterCondRelFlex_of_convNearLitters_aux (sameSpec_comm h) ?_ hN₂i hN₁i i
    rwa [← convNearLitters_inv]

name: nearLitterCondRelInflex_of_convNearLitters
statement:
theorem nearLitterCondRelInflex_of_convNearLitters (h : SameSpec S T) {A : β ↝ ⊥}
    {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter} (hN : convNearLitters S T A N₁ N₂)
    (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (ρ : AllPerm P.δ)
    (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.) (hN₁ : N₁ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε t) (hN₂ : N₂ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε (ρ • t)) :
    nearLitterCondRelInflex T A N₂
      (.inflex P ⟨t.code,
        λ B ↦ (S ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.rel.comp (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ.rel.inv,
        λ B ↦ (S ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.rel.comp (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ.rel.inv⟩)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨P, ρ • t, hA, hN₂, ?_⟩
  rw [NearLitterCond.inflex.injEq]
  refine ⟨rfl, heq_of_eq ?_⟩
  rw [InflexCond.mk.injEq]
  refine ⟨(t.smul_code ρ).symm, ?_, ?_⟩
  · funext B i j
    rw [eq_iff_iff]
    have := h.atoms_iff_of_inflexible A N₁ N₂ P t ρ hA hN₁ hN₂ hN B
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂⟩
      have := (this a ⟨j, ha₂⟩ i).mp ha₁
      refine ⟨ρᵁ B • a, this, ?_⟩
      rwa [Tangle.smul_support, smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_atoms, Rel.inv_apply,
        Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]
    · rintro ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂⟩
      have := (this ((ρᵁ B)⁻¹ • a) ⟨j, ha₂⟩ i).mpr ?_
      · exact ⟨(ρᵁ B)⁻¹ • a, this, ha₂⟩
      · rwa [smul_inv_smul]
  · funext B i j
    rw [eq_iff_iff]
    have := h.nearLitters_iff_of_inflexible A N₁ N₂ P t ρ hA hN₁ hN₂ hN B
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨N', hN'₁, hN'₂⟩
      have := (this N' ⟨j, hN'₂⟩ i).mp hN'₁
      refine ⟨ρᵁ B • N', this, ?_⟩
      rwa [Tangle.smul_support, smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters, Rel.inv_apply,
        Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]
    · rintro ⟨N', hN'₁, hN'₂⟩
      have := (this ((ρᵁ B)⁻¹ • N') ⟨j, hN'₂⟩ i).mpr ?_
      · exact ⟨(ρᵁ B)⁻¹ • N', this, hN'₂⟩
      · rwa [smul_inv_smul]

name: spec_le_spec_of_sameSpec
statement:
theorem spec_le_spec_of_sameSpec (h : SameSpec S T) :
    S.spec ≤ T.spec
proof:
:= by
  intro A
  simp only [spec_atoms, spec_nearLitters]
  refine ⟨h.atoms_bound_eq A, ?_, h.nearLitters_bound_eq A, ?_⟩
  · rintro i _ ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := h.atoms_dom_of_dom ha
    refine ⟨b, hb, ?_⟩
    rw [AtomCond.mk.injEq]
    constructor
    · apply subset_antisymm
      exact atoms_subset_of_sameSpec h ha hb
      exact atoms_subset_of_sameSpec (sameSpec_comm h) hb ha
    · apply subset_antisymm
      exact nearLitters_subset_of_sameSpec h ha hb
      exact nearLitters_subset_of_sameSpec (sameSpec_comm h) hb ha
  · rintro i c ⟨N₁, hN₁, hN'⟩
    obtain ⟨N₂, hN₂⟩ := h.nearLitters_dom_of_dom hN₁
    obtain ⟨hN₁i, rfl⟩ | ⟨P, t, hA, ht, rfl⟩ := hN'
    · have hN₂i := (h.inflexible_iff' ⟨i, hN₁, hN₂⟩).mpr.mt hN₁i
      refine ⟨N₂, hN₂, Or.inl ?_⟩
      exact nearLitterCondRelFlex_of_convNearLitters h ⟨i, hN₁, hN₂⟩ hN₁i hN₂i
    · have hN₂i := (h.inflexible_iff ⟨i, hN₁, hN₂⟩ P t hA).mp ⟨1, by rwa [one_smul]⟩
      obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := hN₂i
      refine ⟨N₂, hN₂, Or.inr ?_⟩
      exact nearLitterCondRelInflex_of_convNearLitters h ⟨i, hN₁, hN₂⟩ P t ρ hA ht hρ

name: spec_eq_spec_iff
statement:
theorem spec_eq_spec_iff (S T : Support β) :
    S.spec = T.spec ↔ SameSpec S T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact sameSpec_antisymm (sameSpecLe_of_spec_eq_spec h) (sameSpecLe_of_spec_eq_spec h.symm)
  · intro h
    apply le_antisymm
    exact spec_le_spec_of_sameSpec h
    exact spec_le_spec_of_sameSpec (sameSpec_comm h)

name: convAtoms_smul_iff_left
statement:
theorem convAtoms_smul_iff_left (A : β ↝ ⊥) (a₁ a₂ : Atom) :
    convAtoms S (ρᵁ • S) A a₁ a₂ ↔ a₁ ∈ (S ⇘. A)ᴬ ∧ a₂ = ρᵁ A • a₁
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂⟩
    use ⟨i, hi₁⟩
    have := (S ⇘. A)ᴬ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hi₁ hi₂
    exact inv_smul_eq_iff.mp this.symm
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
    rwa [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_atoms, Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]

name: convNearLitters_smul_iff_left
statement:
theorem convNearLitters_smul_iff_left (A : β ↝ ⊥) (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter) :
    convNearLitters S (ρᵁ • S) A N₁ N₂ ↔ N₁ ∈ (S ⇘. A)ᴺ ∧ N₂ = ρᵁ A • N₁
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi₁, hi₂⟩
    use ⟨i, hi₁⟩
    have := (S ⇘. A)ᴺ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hi₁ hi₂
    exact inv_smul_eq_iff.mp this.symm
  · rintro ⟨⟨i, hi⟩, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
    rwa [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters, Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]

name: smul_convAtoms_injective
statement:
theorem smul_convAtoms_injective (A : β ↝ ⊥) :
    (convAtoms S (ρᵁ • S) A).Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ b h₁ h₂
  rw [convAtoms_smul_iff_left] at h₁ h₂
  have := h₁.2.symm.trans h₂.2
  rwa [smul_left_cancel_iff] at this

name: atomMemRel_smul_le
statement:
theorem atomMemRel_smul_le (A : β ↝ ⊥) :
    atomMemRel S A ≤ atomMemRel (ρᵁ • S) A
proof:
:= by
  rintro i j ⟨N, hNS, a, haN, haj⟩
  refine ⟨ρᵁ A • N, ?_, ρᵁ A • a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rwa [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters, Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]
  · simp only [BasePerm.smul_nearLitter_atoms, Set.smul_mem_smul_set_iff]
    exact haN
  · rwa [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_atoms, Rel.inv_apply, Enumeration.smul_rel,
      inv_smul_smul]

name: inflexible_of_inflexible_smul
statement:
theorem inflexible_of_inflexible_smul {A : β ↝ ⊥} {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter}
    (h : convNearLitters S (ρᵁ • S) A N₁ N₂)
    (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.) (hN₁ : N₁ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε t) :
    ∃ ρ' : AllPerm P.δ, N₂ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε (ρ' • t)
proof:
:= by
  use ρ ⇘ P.A ↘ P.hδ
  rw [convNearLitters_smul_iff_left] at h
  rw [h.2, BasePerm.smul_nearLitter_litter, hN₁, hA, ← smul_fuzz P.hδ P.hε, allPermDeriv_forget]
  rfl

name: litter_eq_of_flexible_smul
statement:
theorem litter_eq_of_flexible_smul {A : β ↝ ⊥} {N₁ N₂ N₃ N₄ : NearLitter}
    (h₁₂ : convNearLitters S (ρᵁ • S) A N₁ N₂) (h₃₄ : convNearLitters S (ρᵁ • S) A N₃ N₄)
    (h₁₃ : N₁ᴸ = N₃ᴸ) :
    N₂ᴸ = N₄ᴸ
proof:
:= by
  rw [convNearLitters_smul_iff_left] at h₁₂ h₃₄
  rw [h₁₂.2, h₃₄.2, BasePerm.smul_nearLitter_litter, BasePerm.smul_nearLitter_litter, h₁₃]

name: convNearLitters_fuzz
statement:
theorem convNearLitters_fuzz (A : β ↝ ⊥) (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter)
    (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (ρ' : AllPerm P.δ)
    (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.) (hN₁ : N₁ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε t) (hN₂ : N₂ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε (ρ' • t))
    (hN : convNearLitters S (ρᵁ • S) A N₁ N₂) :
    ρ' • t = ρ ⇘ P.A ↘ P.hδ • t
proof:
:= by
  rw [convNearLitters_smul_iff_left] at hN
  rw [hN.2, BasePerm.smul_nearLitter_litter, hN₁, hA,
    show ρᵁ (P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.) = (ρᵁ ⇘ P.A) ↘ P.hε ↘. from rfl,
    ← allPermDeriv_forget, smul_fuzz P.hδ] at hN₂
  exact (fuzz_injective hN₂).symm

name: atoms_of_inflexible_smul
statement:
theorem atoms_of_inflexible_smul (A : β ↝ ⊥) (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter)
    (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (ρ' : AllPerm P.δ)
    (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.) (hN₁ : N₁ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε t) (hN₂ : N₂ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε (ρ' • t))
    (hN : convNearLitters S (ρᵁ • S) A N₁ N₂) (B : P.δ ↝ ⊥)
    (a : Atom) (ha : a ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ)
    (i : κ) (hiS : (S ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.rel i a) :
    ((ρᵁ • S) ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.rel i (ρ'ᵁ B • a)
proof:
:= by
  have := convNearLitters_fuzz S ρ A N₁ N₂ P t ρ' hA hN₁ hN₂ hN
  rw [Tangle.smul_atom_eq_of_mem_support this ha]
  rwa [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_atoms, allPermSderiv_forget, allPermDeriv_forget,
    Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv, Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]

name: nearLitters_of_inflexible_smul
statement:
theorem nearLitters_of_inflexible_smul (A : β ↝ ⊥) (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter)
    (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (ρ' : AllPerm P.δ)
    (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.) (hN₁ : N₁ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε t) (hN₂ : N₂ᴸ = fuzz P.hδε (ρ' • t))
    (hN : convNearLitters S (ρᵁ • S) A N₁ N₂) (B : P.δ ↝ ⊥)
    (N : NearLitter) (ha : N ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ)
    (i : κ) (hiS : (S ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.rel i N) :
    ((ρᵁ • S) ⇘. (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.rel i (ρ'ᵁ B • N)
proof:
:= by
  have := convNearLitters_fuzz S ρ A N₁ N₂ P t ρ' hA hN₁ hN₂ hN
  rw [Tangle.smul_nearLitter_eq_of_mem_support this ha]
  rwa [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters, allPermSderiv_forget, allPermDeriv_forget,
    Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv, Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]

name: sameSpecLe_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sameSpecLe_smul :
    SameSpecLE S (ρᵁ • S)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  case atoms_bound_eq => intro; rfl
  case nearLitters_bound_eq => intro; rfl
  case atoms_dom_subset =>
    intro
    rw [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_atoms, Enumeration.smul_rel_dom]
  case nearLitters_dom_subset =>
    intro
    rw [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters, Enumeration.smul_rel_dom]
  case convAtoms_injective => exact S.smul_convAtoms_injective ρ
  case atomMemRel_le => exact S.atomMemRel_smul_le ρ
  case inflexible_of_inflexible => exact S.inflexible_of_inflexible_smul ρ
  case litter_eq_of_flexible =>
    intros
    apply S.litter_eq_of_flexible_smul ρ <;> assumption
  case atoms_of_inflexible => exact S.atoms_of_inflexible_smul ρ
  case nearLitters_of_inflexible => exact S.nearLitters_of_inflexible_smul ρ

name: smul_spec
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_spec :
    (ρᵁ • S).spec = S.spec
proof:
:= by
  rw [spec_eq_spec_iff]
  apply sameSpec_antisymm
  · have := (ρᵁ • S).sameSpecLe_smul ρ⁻¹
    rwa [allPermForget_inv, inv_smul_smul] at this
  · exact S.sameSpecLe_smul ρ

name: ExactlyApproximates.toApproximates
proof:
:=
  λ A ↦ (h A).toApproximates

name: Approximates.mono
statement:
theorem Approximates.mono {ψ χ : StrApprox β} {ρ : AllPerm β} (hχ : χ.Approximates ρ) (h : ψ ≤ χ) :
    ψ.Approximates ρ
proof:
:=
  λ A ↦ (hχ A).mono (h A)

name: ExactlyApproximates.mono
proof:
:=
  λ A ↦ (hχ A).mono (h A)

name: smul_atom_mem_dom_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, ha⟩ := ha
  cases (h A).atoms a b ha
  exact (ψ A).atoms_permutative.mem_dom ha

name: smul_nearLitter_mem_dom_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N', hN⟩ := hN
  cases (h A).nearLitters N N' hN
  exact (ψ A).nearLitters_permutative.mem_dom hN

name: inv_smul_atom_mem_dom_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, ha⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨c, ha'⟩ := (ψ A).atoms_permutative.mem_codom ha
  cases (h A).atoms c a ha'
  rw [inv_smul_smul]
  exact ⟨_, ha'⟩

name: inv_smul_nearLitter_mem_dom_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N', hN⟩ := hN
  obtain ⟨N'', hN'⟩ := (ψ A).nearLitters_permutative.mem_codom hN
  cases (h A).nearLitters N'' N hN'
  rw [inv_smul_smul]
  exact ⟨_, hN'⟩

name: zsmul_atom_mem_dom_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.inductionOn' (b := 0) with
  | zero => exact ha
  | succ k _ ih =>
    rw [add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_one, mul_smul]
    exact smul_atom_mem_dom_of_approximates h ih
  | pred k _ ih =>
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_neg, zpow_one, mul_smul]
    exact inv_smul_atom_mem_dom_of_approximates h ih

name: zsmul_nearLitter_mem_dom_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.inductionOn' (b := 0) with
  | zero => rwa [zpow_zero, one_smul]
  | succ k _ ih =>
    rw [add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_one, mul_smul]
    exact smul_nearLitter_mem_dom_of_approximates h ih
  | pred k _ ih =>
    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_neg, zpow_one, mul_smul]
    exact inv_smul_nearLitter_mem_dom_of_approximates h ih

name: zsmul_atom_mem_dom_iff_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ha
    have := zsmul_atom_mem_dom_of_approximates h ha (-n)
    rwa [zpow_neg, inv_smul_smul] at this
  · intro ha
    exact zsmul_atom_mem_dom_of_approximates h ha n

name: zsmul_nearLitter_mem_dom_iff_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hN
    have := zsmul_nearLitter_mem_dom_of_approximates h hN (-n)
    rwa [zpow_neg, inv_smul_smul] at this
  · intro hN
    exact zsmul_nearLitter_mem_dom_of_approximates h hN n

name: smul_support_eq_smul_of_approximates
proof:
:= by
  rw [smul_support_eq_smul_iff]
  intro A
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hSA A a ha
    rwa [← (h A).atoms a b hb]
  · intro a ha
    obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hSN A a ha
    rwa [← (h A).nearLitters a b hb]

name: addFlexible_coherent
proof:
:= by
  apply addOrbit_coherent hψ
  intro
  rwa [coherentAt_flexible hL]

name: addInflexible_aux
statement:
theorem addInflexible_aux (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (ρ : AllPerm P.δ) :
    ∀ m n k : ℤ, fuzz P.hδε (ρ ^ m • t) = fuzz P.hδε (ρ ^ n • t) →
      fuzz P.hδε (ρ ^ (m + k) • t) = fuzz P.hδε (ρ ^ (n + k) • t)
proof:
:= by
  intro m n k h
  have := congr_arg (ρ ^ k • ·) (fuzz_injective h)
  dsimp only at this
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul, ← zpow_add, ← zpow_add, add_comm, add_comm k] at this
  rw [this]

name: smul_support_zpow
statement:
theorem smul_support_zpow {ψ : StrApprox β} {ρ : AllPerm β} (h : ψ.Approximates ρ)
    (t : Tangle β) {n : ℤ}
    (hLA : ∀ B, ∀ a ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ, a ∈ (ψ B)ᴬ.dom)
    (hLN : ∀ B, ∀ N ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ, N ∈ (ψ B)ᴺ.dom) :
    ψ • (ρ ^ n • t).support = ρᵁ • (ρ ^ n • t).support
proof:
:= by
  apply smul_support_eq_smul_of_approximates h
  · intro B a ha
    rw [Tangle.smul_support, Support.smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_atoms,
      Enumeration.mem_smul_iff, allPermForget_zpow, Tree.zpow_apply, ← zpow_neg] at ha
    rw [← zsmul_atom_mem_dom_iff_of_approximates h (-n)]
    exact hLA B _ ha
  · intro B N hN
    rw [Tangle.smul_support, Support.smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_nearLitters,
      Enumeration.mem_smul_iff, allPermForget_zpow, Tree.zpow_apply, ← zpow_neg] at hN
    rw [← zsmul_nearLitter_mem_dom_iff_of_approximates h (-n)]
    exact hLN B _ hN

name: addInflexible'_coherent
statement:
theorem addInflexible'_coherent {ψ : StrApprox β} {A : β ↝ ⊥}
    {P : InflexiblePath β} {t : Tangle P.δ} (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.)
    {ρ : AllPerm P.δ} (hρ : Approximates (ψ ⇘ P.A ↘ P.hδ) ρ)
    {hL : ∀ n : ℤ, fuzz P.hδε (ρ ^ n • t) ∉ (ψ A)ᴸ.dom}
    (hψ : ψ.Coherent)
    (hLA : ∀ B, ∀ a ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ, a ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.dom)
    (hLN : ∀ B, ∀ N ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ, N ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.dom) :
    (ψ.addInflexible' P t ρ hL).Coherent
proof:
:= by
  apply addOrbit_coherent hψ
  intro n
  rw [coherentAt_inflexible hA rfl]
  use ρ
  constructor
  · apply smul_support_zpow hρ
    · simp only [Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv]
      exact hLA
    · simp only [Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv]
      exact hLN
  · rw [add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_one, mul_smul]

name: mem_dom_of_inflexible
statement:
theorem mem_dom_of_inflexible {ψ : StrApprox β} {A : β ↝ ⊥} {L : Litter}
    {P : InflexiblePath β} {t : Tangle P.δ} (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.) (ht : L = fuzz P.hδε t)
    {ρ : AllPerm P.δ} (hρ : Approximates (ψ ⇘ P.A ↘ P.hδ) ρ)
    {n : ℤ} (hL : fuzz P.hδε (ρ ^ n • t) ∈ (ψ A)ᴸ.dom)
    (hψ : ψ.Coherent)
    (hLA : ∀ B, ∀ a ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ, a ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.dom)
    (hLN : ∀ B, ∀ N ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ, N ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.dom) :
    L ∈ (ψ A)ᴸ.dom
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.inductionOn' (b := 0) with
  | zero =>
    rw [zpow_zero, one_smul] at hL
    rwa [ht]
  | succ k _ ih =>
    apply ih
    rw [← (ψ A).litters_permutative.codom_eq_dom] at hL
    obtain ⟨L', hL⟩ := hL
    have := smul_eq_of_coherentAt_inflexible' hA rfl (hψ A L' _ hL) ρ⁻¹ ?_
    · rw [smul_smul, ← zpow_neg_one, ← zpow_add, neg_add_cancel_comm_assoc] at this
      rw [← this]
      exact ⟨_, hL⟩
    · have := smul_support_zpow hρ t (n := k) ?_ ?_
      · rw [Tangle.smul_support, allPermForget_zpow] at this
        rw [Tangle.smul_support, smul_smul, allPermForget_inv, ← zpow_neg_one, allPermForget_zpow,
          ← zpow_add, neg_add_cancel_comm_assoc, this, add_comm, zpow_add, zpow_one, mul_smul]
      · simp only [Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv]
        exact hLA
      · simp only [Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv]
        exact hLN
  | pred k _ ih =>
    apply ih
    obtain ⟨L', hL⟩ := hL
    have := smul_eq_of_coherentAt_inflexible hA rfl (hψ A _ L' hL) ρ ?_
    · rw [smul_smul, mul_self_zpow, sub_add_cancel] at this
      rw [← this]
      exact (ψ A).litters_permutative.mem_dom hL
    · apply smul_support_zpow hρ
      · simp only [Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv]
        exact hLA
      · simp only [Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv]
        exact hLN

name: le_addInflexible
statement:
theorem le_addInflexible (ψ : StrApprox β) (A : β ↝ ⊥)
    (P : InflexiblePath β) (t : Tangle P.δ) (ρ : AllPerm P.δ) :
    ψ ≤ ψ.addInflexible A P t ρ
proof:
:= by
  rw [addInflexible]
  split_ifs
  · exact le_addOrbit
  · exact le_rfl

name: addInflexible_coherent
statement:
theorem addInflexible_coherent {ψ : StrApprox β} {A : β ↝ ⊥}
    {P : InflexiblePath β} {t : Tangle P.δ} (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.)
    {ρ : AllPerm P.δ} (hρ : Approximates (ψ ⇘ P.A ↘ P.hδ) ρ)
    (hψ : ψ.Coherent)
    (hLA : ∀ B, ∀ a ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ, a ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.dom)
    (hLN : ∀ B, ∀ N ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ, N ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.dom) :
    (ψ.addInflexible A P t ρ).Coherent
proof:
:= by
  rw [addInflexible]
  split_ifs
  · exact addInflexible'_coherent hA hρ hψ hLA hLN
  · exact hψ

name: mem_addInflexible_dom
statement:
theorem mem_addInflexible_dom {ψ : StrApprox β} {A : β ↝ ⊥} {L : Litter}
    {P : InflexiblePath β} {t : Tangle P.δ} (hA : A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘.) (hL : L = fuzz P.hδε t)
    {ρ : AllPerm P.δ} (hρ : Approximates (ψ ⇘ P.A ↘ P.hδ) ρ)
    (hψ : ψ.Coherent)
    (hLA : ∀ B, ∀ a ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ, a ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.dom)
    (hLN : ∀ B, ∀ N ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ, N ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.dom) :
    L ∈ (ψ.addInflexible A P t ρ A)ᴸ.dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [addInflexible]
  split_ifs with hL'
  · rw [addInflexible', addOrbit_apply, BaseApprox.addOrbit_litters, Rel.sup_dom,
      BaseApprox.addOrbitLitters_dom]
    right
    use 0
    simp only [zpow_zero, one_smul, hL]
  · push_neg at hL'
    obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hL'
    exact mem_dom_of_inflexible hA hL hρ hn hψ hLA hLN

name: exists_extension_of_minimal
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_minimal (ψ : StrApprox β) (A : β ↝ ⊥) (L : Litter) (hψ : ψ.Coherent)
    (foa : ∀ δ < β, [LeLevel δ] → FreedomOfAction δ)
    (hLA : ∀ B, ∀ a, pos a < pos L → a ∈ (ψ B)ᴬ.dom)
    (hLN : ∀ B, ∀ N, pos N < pos L → N ∈ (ψ B)ᴺ.dom) :
    ∃ χ ≥ ψ, χ.Coherent ∧ L ∈ (χ A)ᴸ.dom
proof:
:= by
  obtain (⟨P, t, hA, ht⟩ | hL) := inflexible_cases A L
  · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := foa P.δ (P.hδ.trans_le P.A.le) (ψ ⇘ (P.A ↘ P.hδ)) (hψ.deriv (P.A ↘ P.hδ))
    have h₁ : ∀ (B : P.δ ↝ ⊥), ∀ a ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴬ, a ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴬ.dom := by
      intro B a ha
      apply hLA
      rw [ht]
      exact (pos_atom_lt_pos t B a ha).trans (pos_fuzz P.hδε t)
    have h₂ : ∀ (B : P.δ ↝ ⊥), ∀ N ∈ (t.support ⇘. B)ᴺ, N ∈ (ψ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B))ᴺ.dom := by
      intro B N hN
      apply hLN
      rw [ht]
      exact (pos_nearLitter_lt_pos t B N hN).trans (pos_fuzz P.hδε t)
    refine ⟨addInflexible ψ A P t ρ, le_addInflexible ψ A P t ρ, ?_, ?_⟩
    · refine addInflexible_coherent hA ?_ hψ h₁ h₂
      rw [Tree.deriv_sderiv]
      exact hρ.toApproximates
    · refine mem_addInflexible_dom hA ht ?_ hψ h₁ h₂
      rw [Tree.deriv_sderiv]
      exact hρ.toApproximates
  · by_cases hL' : L ∈ (ψ A)ᴸ.dom
    · use ψ
    · refine ⟨addFlexible ψ A L hL', le_addOrbit, addFlexible_coherent hψ hL, ?_⟩
      rw [addFlexible, addOrbit_apply, BaseApprox.addOrbit_litters, Rel.sup_dom,
        BaseApprox.addOrbitLitters_dom]
      right
      use 0

name: exists_extension_of_minimal'
statement:
theorem exists_extension_of_minimal' (ψ : StrApprox β) (A : β ↝ ⊥)
    (L : Litter) (hL : L ∉ (ψ A)ᴸ.dom) (hψ : ψ.Coherent)
    (foa : ∀ δ < β, [LeLevel δ] → FreedomOfAction δ)
    (hL' : ∀ B L', pos L' < pos L → L' ∈ (ψ B)ᴸ.dom) :
    ∃ χ > ψ, χ.Coherent
proof:
:= by
  have := exists_extension_of_minimal ψ A L hψ foa ?_ ?_
  · obtain ⟨χ, hχ₁, hχ₂, hχ₃⟩ := this
    refine ⟨χ, ⟨hχ₁, ?_⟩, hχ₂⟩
    intro h
    exact hL (Rel.dom_mono (h A).2 hχ₃)
  · intro B a ha
    apply BaseApprox.mem_dom_atoms_of_litter_mem_dom
    exact hL' B aᴸ (a.pos_litter_lt_pos.trans ha)
  · intro B N hN
    apply BaseApprox.mem_dom_nearLitters
    · apply hL'
      exact (N.pos_litter_lt_pos).trans hN
    · intro a ha
      apply BaseApprox.mem_dom_atoms_of_litter_mem_dom
      apply hL'
      have := N.pos_atom_lt_pos a (Or.inl ha)
      exact a.pos_litter_lt_pos.trans (this.trans hN)

name: exists_total
statement:
theorem exists_total (ψ : StrApprox β) (hψ : ψ.Coherent)
    (foa : ∀ δ < β, [LeLevel δ] → FreedomOfAction δ) :
    ∃ χ ≥ ψ, χ.Coherent ∧ χ.Total
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ₁, hχ₂⟩ := exists_maximal_coherent ψ hψ
  refine ⟨χ, hχ₁, hχ₂.1, ?_⟩
  intro A L
  induction L using pos_induction generalizing A with
  | h L ih =>
    by_contra hL
    obtain ⟨χ', hχ'⟩ := exists_extension_of_minimal' χ A L hL hχ₂.1 foa (λ B L' h' ↦ ih L' h' B)
    exact hχ'.1.2 (hχ₂.2 hχ'.2 hχ'.1.1)

name: exists_exactlyApproximates_of_total
statement:
theorem exists_exactlyApproximates_of_total (ψ : StrApprox β) (hψ₁ : ψ.Coherent) (hψ₂ : ψ.Total) :
    ∃ ρ, ψ.ExactlyApproximates ρ
proof:
:= by
  revert β
  intro β
  induction β using (inferInstanceAs <| IsWellFounded TypeIndex (· < ·)).induction
  case ind _ _ β ih =>
  induction β using WithBot.recBotCoe with
  | bot =>
    intro _ ψ _ hψ₂
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := allPerm_of_basePerm ((ψ Path.nil).basePerm (hψ₂ Path.nil))
    use ρ
    intro A
    cases A.eq_nil
    rw [hρ]
    exact BaseApprox.exactlyApproximates_basePerm _
  | coe β =>
    intro _ ψ hψ₁ hψ₂
    choose ρs hρs using ih
    have := allPerm_of_smulFuzz (γ := β) (λ {δ} _ hδ ↦ ρs δ hδ (ψ ↘ hδ)
        (hψ₁.deriv (Path.single hδ)) (hψ₂.deriv (Path.single hδ))) ?_
    · obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := this
      use ρ
      intro A
      cases A using Path.recScoderiv with
      | scoderiv _ δ A hδ =>
        have : LtLevel δ := ⟨hδ.trans_le LeLevel.elim⟩
        specialize hρs δ hδ (ψ ↘ hδ) (hψ₁.deriv (Path.single hδ)) (hψ₂.deriv (Path.single hδ))
        rw [← hρ δ hδ] at hρs
        have := hρs A
        rwa [allPermSderiv_forget] at this
    · intro δ ε _ _ hδ hε hδε t
      dsimp only
      have := hψ₁ (Path.single hε ↘.) (fuzz hδε t)
          ((ρs ε hε (ψ ↘ hε) (hψ₁.deriv (Path.single hε)) (hψ₂.deriv (Path.single hε)))ᵁ
            (Path.nil ↘.) • fuzz hδε t) ?_
      · apply smul_eq_of_coherentAt_inflexible
          (P := ⟨β, δ, ε, hδ, hε, hδε, Path.nil⟩) rfl rfl this
        rw [smul_support_eq_smul_iff]
        intro A
        constructor
        · intro a _
          obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := (hψ₂ (A ↗ hδ)).atoms a
          cases (hρs δ hδ (ψ ↘ hδ) (hψ₁.deriv (Path.single hδ))
            (hψ₂.deriv (Path.single hδ)) A).atoms a b hb
          simp only [Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv]
          exact hb
        · intro N _
          obtain ⟨N', hN'⟩ := (hψ₂ (A ↗ hδ)).nearLitters N
          cases (hρs δ hδ (ψ ↘ hδ) (hψ₁.deriv (Path.single hδ))
            (hψ₂.deriv (Path.single hδ)) A).nearLitters N N' hN'
          simp only [Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv]
          exact hN'
      · obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ := hψ₂ (Path.single hε ↘.) (fuzz hδε t)
        cases (hρs ε hε (ψ ↘ hε) (hψ₁.deriv (Path.single hε)) (hψ₂.deriv (Path.single hε))
          (Path.nil ↘.)).litters _ _ hL
        exact hL

name: freedomOfAction
statement: theorem freedomOfAction : FreedomOfAction β
proof:
:= by
  revert β
  intro β
  induction β using (inferInstanceAs <| IsWellFounded TypeIndex (· < ·)).induction
  case ind _ _ β ih =>
    intro _ ψ hψ
    obtain ⟨χ, hχ₁, hχ₂, hχ₃⟩ := exists_total ψ hψ ih
    obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := exists_exactlyApproximates_of_total χ hχ₂ hχ₃
    exact ⟨ρ, hρ.mono hχ₁⟩

name: approximates_of_flexApprox_exactlyApproximates
statement:
theorem approximates_of_flexApprox_exactlyApproximates {ξ : StrAction β} (hξ : ξ.Coherent)
    {ρ : AllPerm β} (hρ : ξ.flexApprox.ExactlyApproximates ρ) :
    ξ.Approximates ρ
proof:
:= by
  intro A
  constructor
  · intro a₁ a₂ ha
    have := ((ξ A).flexApprox_flexApprox (ξ.mapFlexible_of_coherent hξ A)).atoms_le_atoms a₁ a₂ ha
    exact (hρ A).atoms a₁ a₂ (Or.inl this)
  intro N₁ N₂ h
  symm
  induction N₁ using pos_induction generalizing A N₂ with
  | h N₁ ih =>
    apply BaseAction.smul_nearLitter_of_smul_litter
      ((ξ A).flexApprox_flexApprox (ξ.mapFlexible_of_coherent hξ A)) (hρ A) h
    obtain (⟨P, t, hA, ht⟩ | hN₁) := inflexible_cases A N₁ᴸ
    · rw [ht, hA]
      suffices (ρ ⇘ P.A)ᵁ ↘ P.hε ↘. • fuzz P.hδε t = N₂ᴸ by
        rw [← this, allPermDeriv_forget]
        rfl
      rw [smul_fuzz P.hδ P.hε P.hδε]
      obtain ⟨ρ', hρ', _⟩ := (hξ A N₁ᴸ N₂ᴸ (BaseAction.litters.mk h)).inflexible P t hA ht
      refine (smul_eq_of_coherentAt_inflexible hA ht (hξ A N₁ᴸ N₂ᴸ (BaseAction.litters.mk h))
        (ρ ⇘ P.A ↘ P.hδ) ?_).symm
      simp only [smul_support_eq_smul_iff, Tree.sderiv_apply, Tree.deriv_apply, Path.deriv_scoderiv,
        allPermSderiv_forget, allPermDeriv_forget] at hρ' ⊢
      intro B
      constructor
      · intro a ha
        have ha' := (hρ' B).1 a ha
        have := ((ξ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B)).flexApprox_flexApprox
          (mapFlexible_of_coherent hξ _)).atoms_le_atoms _ _ ha'
        rwa [(hρ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B)).atoms _ _ (Or.inl this)] at ha'
      · intro N hN
        have hN' := (hρ' B).2 N hN
        have := ih N ?_ (P.A ↘ P.hδ ⇘ B) _ hN'
        · rwa [this]
        · apply (pos_nearLitter_lt_pos t B N hN).trans
          apply (pos_fuzz P.hδε t).trans
          rw [← ht]
          exact N₁.pos_litter_lt_pos
    · have := ((ξ A).flexApprox_flexApprox (ξ.mapFlexible_of_coherent hξ A)).litters_of_flexible
        hN₁ (BaseAction.litters.mk h)
      obtain ⟨N₃, hN₃⟩ := (ξ.flexApprox A).mem_dom_nearLitters
        (N := N₁ᴸᴺ) ⟨N₂ᴸ, this⟩ (λ a h ↦ (h.2 h.1).elim)
      rw [(ξ.flexApprox A).litters_permutative.coinjective this hN₃.1]
      exact (congr_arg (·ᴸ) ((hρ A).nearLitters _ _ hN₃)).symm

name: freedomOfAction
statement: theorem freedomOfAction : FreedomOfAction β
proof:
:= by
  intro ξ hξ
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ⟩ := ξ.flexApprox.freedomOfAction
    (ξ.flexApprox_coherent (ξ.mapFlexible_of_coherent hξ))
  exact ⟨ρ, approximates_of_flexApprox_exactlyApproximates hξ hρ⟩

name: mem_symmDiff_iff_mem_symmDiff
statement:
theorem mem_symmDiff_iff_mem_symmDiff {ξ : BaseAction} {a₁ a₂ : Atom} {N₁ N₂ N₃ N₄ : NearLitter} :
    ξ.atoms a₁ a₂ → ξ.nearLitters N₁ N₂ → ξ.nearLitters N₃ N₄ →
      (a₁ ∈ N₁ᴬ ∆ N₃ᴬ ↔ a₂ ∈ N₂ᴬ ∆ N₄ᴬ)
proof:
:= by
  intro ha hN₁₂ hN₃₄
  simp only [Set.mem_symmDiff, ξ.mem_iff_mem' ha hN₁₂, ξ.mem_iff_mem' ha hN₃₄]

name: nearLitters_coinjective
statement: theorem nearLitters_coinjective (ξ : BaseAction) : ξ.nearLitters.Coinjective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro N₁ N₂ N h₁ h₂
  apply NearLitter.ext
  rw [← Set.symmDiff_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro a ha
  have := ξ.interference_subset_codom' ⟨_, h₁⟩ ⟨_, h₂⟩
  rw [interference_eq_of_litter_eq ((ξ.litter_eq_litter_iff' h₁ h₂).mp rfl)] at this
  obtain ⟨b, hba⟩ := this ha
  rw [← mem_symmDiff_iff_mem_symmDiff hba h₁ h₂] at ha
  simp only [symmDiff_self, Set.bot_eq_empty, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at ha

name: nearLitters_injective
statement: theorem nearLitters_injective (ξ : BaseAction) : ξ.nearLitters.Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro N₁ N₂ N h₁ h₂
  apply NearLitter.ext
  rw [← Set.symmDiff_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro a ha
  have := ξ.interference_subset_dom' ⟨_, h₁⟩ ⟨_, h₂⟩
  rw [interference_eq_of_litter_eq ((ξ.litter_eq_litter_iff' h₁ h₂).mpr rfl)] at this
  obtain ⟨b, hba⟩ := this ha
  rw [mem_symmDiff_iff_mem_symmDiff hba h₁ h₂] at ha
  simp only [symmDiff_self, Set.bot_eq_empty, Set.mem_empty_iff_false] at ha

name: litters_iff
statement:
theorem litters_iff {ξ : BaseAction} (L₁ L₂ : Litter) :
    ξᴸ L₁ L₂ ↔ ∃ N₁ N₂, N₁ᴸ = L₁ ∧ N₂ᴸ = L₂ ∧ ξᴺ N₁ N₂
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟩
    refine ⟨_, _, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
    assumption
  · rintro ⟨N₁, N₂, rfl, rfl, h⟩

  obtain ⟨N₄, N₂, h₄, rfl, h₂⟩ := h₂

      (⟨N.valᴸ, N.prop.chooseᴸ, ⟨N.prop.choose_spec⟩⟩ : ξᴸ.dom)) ?_
  · exact this.trans_lt ξ.nearLitters_dom_small
  · rintro ⟨L₁, L₂, hL⟩
    rw [litters_iff] at hL
    obtain ⟨N₁, N₂, rfl, rfl, h⟩ := hL
    exact ⟨⟨N₁, N₂, h⟩, rfl⟩

name: inv_le_inv
statement:
theorem inv_le_inv {ξ ζ : BaseAction} (h : ξ⁻¹ ≤ ζ⁻¹) :
    ξ ≤ ζ
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have := h.1
    rwa [inv_atoms, inv_atoms, Rel.inv_le_inv_iff] at this
  · have := h.2
    rwa [inv_nearLitters, inv_nearLitters, Rel.inv_inj] at this

name: inv_le
statement:
theorem inv_le {ξ ζ : BaseAction} (h : ξ⁻¹ ≤ ζ) :
    ξ ≤ ζ⁻¹
proof:
:=
  inv_le_inv h

name: inv_le_inv_iff
statement:
theorem inv_le_inv_iff {ξ ζ : BaseAction} :
    ξ⁻¹ ≤ ζ⁻¹ ↔ ξ ≤ ζ
proof:
:=
  ⟨inv_le_inv, inv_le_inv (ξ := ξ⁻¹) (ζ := ζ⁻¹)⟩

name: le_extend
proof:
:=
  ⟨le_sup_left, rfl⟩

name: Nice.mem_litter_dom_iff
statement:
theorem Nice.mem_litter_dom_iff {ξ : BaseAction} (h : ξ.Nice)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : N ∈ ξᴺ.dom) {a : Atom} (ha : a ∉ ξᴬ.dom) :
    a ∈ Nᴬ ↔ aᴸ = Nᴸ
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! ha
  apply h.symmDiff_subset_dom N hN
  rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
  tauto

name: Nice.mem_litter_codom_iff
statement:
theorem Nice.mem_litter_codom_iff {ξ : BaseAction} (h : ξ.Nice)
    {N : NearLitter} (hN : N ∈ ξᴺ.codom) {a : Atom} (ha : a ∉ ξᴬ.codom) :
    a ∈ Nᴬ ↔ aᴸ = Nᴸ
proof:
:= by
  contrapose! ha
  apply h.symmDiff_subset_codom N hN
  rw [Set.mem_symmDiff]
  tauto

name: inside_small
statement:
theorem inside_small (ξ : BaseAction) :
    Small ξ.inside
proof:
:= by
  have : Small (⋃ N ∈ ξᴺ.dom, Nᴬ \ Nᴸᴬ) := by
    apply small_biUnion ξ.nearLitters_dom_small
    intro N _
    exact N.diff_small
  apply this.mono
  rintro a ⟨N, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  exact ⟨N, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩

name: insideCandidates_not_small
statement:
theorem insideCandidates_not_small (ξ : BaseAction) (L : Litter) :
    ¬Small {a | ξ.InsideCandidate L a}
proof:
:= by
  have h : Small (⋃ N ∈ ξᴺ.codom, ⋃ (_ : Nᴸ = L), Lᴬ \ Nᴬ) := by
    apply small_biUnion ξ.nearLitters_codom_small
    intro N _
    apply small_iUnion_Prop
    rintro rfl
    exact N.diff_small'
  have h' := L.atoms_not_small
  contrapose! h'
  apply (small_union (small_union ξ.atoms_codom_small h) h').mono
  rintro a rfl
  rw [Set.mem_union, or_iff_not_imp_left]
  intro ha
  rw [Set.mem_union, not_or] at ha
  constructor
  · rfl
  · exact ha.1
  · intro N hN₁ hN₂
    by_contra ha'
    apply ha.2
    simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨N, hN₁, hN₂, rfl, ha'⟩

name: card_inside_lt_card_insideCandidates
statement:
theorem card_inside_lt_card_insideCandidates (ξ : BaseAction) (L : Litter) :
    #ξ.inside < #{a | ξ.InsideCandidate L a}
proof:
:=
  ξ.inside_small.trans_le <| κ_le_of_not_small <| ξ.insideCandidates_not_small L

name: insideMap_litter_eq
statement:
theorem insideMap_litter_eq {ξ : BaseAction} (L : Litter) (x : ξ.inside) :

proof:

  (ξ.insideMap L x).prop.litter_eq

name: insideMap_not_mem_codom
statement:
theorem insideMap_not_mem_codom {ξ : BaseAction} (L : Litter) (x : ξ.inside) :
    (ξ.insideMap L x : Atom) ∉ ξᴬ.codom
proof:
:=
  (ξ.insideMap L x).prop.not_mem_codom

name: insideMap_mem_nearLitter
statement:
theorem insideMap_mem_nearLitter  {ξ : BaseAction} (L : Litter) (x : ξ.inside) {N : NearLitter} :
    N ∈ ξᴺ.codom → Nᴸ = L → (ξ.insideMap L x : Atom) ∈ Nᴬ
proof:

  (ξ.insideMap L x).prop.mem_nearLitter

name: insideRel_dom_small
statement: theorem insideRel_dom_small (ξ : BaseAction) : Small ξ.insideRel.dom
proof:
:= by
  apply ξ.inside_small.mono
  rintro a ⟨_, N₁, N₂, h, _, _, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨N₁, h⟩

name: insideRel_injective
statement: theorem insideRel_injective (ξ : BaseAction) : ξ.insideRel.Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro a b c ⟨Na₁, Na₂, ha₁, ha₂⟩ ⟨Nb₁, Nb₂, hb₁, hb₂⟩
  have := ha₂.2.2.symm.trans hb₂.2.2
  have ha := insideMap_litter_eq Na₂ᴸ ⟨a, Na₁, ha₁⟩
  have hb := insideMap_litter_eq Nb₂ᴸ ⟨b, Nb₁, hb₁⟩
  have hab := ha.symm.trans ((congr_arg (·ᴸ) this).trans hb)
  rwa [hab, Subtype.coe_inj, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, Subtype.mk_eq_mk] at this

name: insideRel_coinjective
statement: theorem insideRel_coinjective (ξ : BaseAction) : ξ.insideRel.Coinjective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro a b c ⟨Na₁, Na₂, ha₁, ha₂⟩ ⟨Nb₁, Nb₂, hb₁, hb₂⟩
  have : Na₁ᴸ = Nb₁ᴸ := by
    have : c ∉ interference Na₁ Nb₁ := λ h ↦ ha₂.2.1 (ξ.interference_subset_dom ha₁.1 hb₁.1 h)
    by_contra hN
    rw [interference_eq_of_litter_ne hN] at this
    exact this ⟨ha₁.2.1, hb₁.2.1⟩
  rw [ξ.litter_eq_litter_iff ha₂.1 hb₂.1] at this
  rw [ha₂.2.2, hb₂.2.2, this]

name: insideRel_oneOne
statement: theorem insideRel_oneOne (ξ : BaseAction) : ξ.insideRel.OneOne
proof:
:=
  ⟨ξ.insideRel_injective, ξ.insideRel_coinjective⟩

name: insideRel_dom
statement: theorem insideRel_dom (ξ : BaseAction) : Disjoint ξᴬ.dom ξ.insideRel.dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  rintro a ⟨ha, _, _, _, _, _, ha', _⟩
  contradiction

name: insideRel_codom
statement: theorem insideRel_codom (ξ : BaseAction) : Disjoint ξᴬ.codom ξ.insideRel.codom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, b, N₁, N₂, h, _, _, rfl⟩
  exact insideMap_not_mem_codom N₂ᴸ ⟨b, N₁, h⟩ ⟨a, ha⟩

name: insideRel_mem_iff_mem
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨N₁', N₂', h, hN', ha₁, rfl⟩ := ha
  constructor
  · intro h'
    apply insideMap_mem_nearLitter N₂'ᴸ ⟨a₁, N₁', h⟩ ⟨N₁, hN⟩
    rw [← litter_eq_litter_iff hN hN']
    by_contra hL
    refine ha₁ (ξ.interference_subset_dom ⟨N₂, hN⟩ ⟨N₂', hN'⟩ ?_)
    rw [interference_eq_of_litter_ne hL]
    exact ⟨h', h.2.1⟩
  · intro h'
    contrapose! ha₁
    apply ξ.interference_subset_dom ⟨N₂, hN⟩ ⟨N₂', hN'⟩
    rw [interference_eq_of_litter_eq]
    · exact Or.inr ⟨h.2.1, ha₁⟩
    rw [litter_eq_litter_iff hN hN']
    by_contra this
    apply ξ.insideMap_not_mem_codom N₂'ᴸ ⟨a₁, N₁', h⟩
    apply ξ.interference_subset_codom ⟨N₁, hN⟩ ⟨N₁', hN'⟩
    rw [interference_eq_of_litter_ne this]
    exact ⟨h', insideMap_mem_nearLitter N₂'ᴸ ⟨a₁, N₁', h⟩ ⟨N₁', hN'⟩ rfl⟩

name: insideExtension_atoms
statement:
theorem insideExtension_atoms (ξ : BaseAction) :
    ξ.insideExtensionᴬ = ξᴬ ⊔ ξ.insideRel
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: le_insideExtension
statement: theorem le_insideExtension (ξ : BaseAction) : ξ ≤ ξ.insideExtension
proof:

name: insideExtension_spec
statement:
theorem insideExtension_spec {ξ : BaseAction} (N : NearLitter) (hN : N ∈ ξᴺ.dom) :
    Nᴬ \ Nᴸᴬ ⊆ ξ.insideExtensionᴬ.dom
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  by_contra ha'
  rw [insideExtension_atoms, Rel.sup_dom, Set.mem_union, not_or] at ha'
  apply ha'.2
  obtain ⟨N', hN⟩ := hN
  exact ⟨_, N, N', ⟨⟨N', hN⟩, ha.1, ha.2⟩, hN, ha'.1, rfl⟩

name: card_not_sandbox
statement:
theorem card_not_sandbox (ξ : BaseAction) :
    #{L | ¬ξ.Sandbox L} ≤ #κ
proof:
:= by
  rw [not_sandbox_eq]
  apply (mk_union_le _ _).trans
  apply add_le_of_le κ_isRegular.aleph0_le
  · refine (mk_biUnion_le_of_le 1 ?_).trans ?_
    · simp only [mk_fintype, Fintype.card_ofSubsingleton, Nat.cast_one, le_refl, implies_true]
    rw [mul_one]
    exact ξ.atoms_codom_small.le
  · refine (mk_biUnion_le_of_le #κ ?_).trans ?_
    · intro N _
      refine (mk_biUnion_le_of_le 1 ?_).trans ?_
      · simp only [mk_fintype, Fintype.card_ofSubsingleton, Nat.cast_one, le_refl, implies_true]
      · rw [mul_one, N.card_atoms]
    · exact mul_le_of_le κ_isRegular.aleph0_le ξ.nearLitters_codom_small.le le_rfl

name: exists_sandbox
statement: theorem exists_sandbox (ξ : BaseAction) : {L | ξ.Sandbox L}.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  suffices #{L | ξ.Sandbox L} + #{L | ¬ξ.Sandbox L} ≤ #κ by
    have h := mk_sum_compl {L | ξ.Sandbox L}
    have := h.symm.trans_le this
    rw [card_litter, ← not_lt] at this
    exact this κ_lt_μ
  rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at h
  rw [h, mk_eq_zero, zero_add]
  exact ξ.card_not_sandbox

name: sandbox_spec
statement: theorem sandbox_spec (ξ : BaseAction) : ξ.Sandbox ξ.sandbox
proof:
:=
  ξ.exists_sandbox.some_mem

name: outside_small
statement:
theorem outside_small (ξ : BaseAction) :
    Small ξ.outside
proof:
:= by
  have : Small (⋃ N ∈ ξᴺ.dom, Nᴸᴬ \ Nᴬ) := by
    apply small_biUnion ξ.nearLitters_dom_small
    intro N _
    exact N.diff_small'
  apply this.mono
  rintro a ⟨N, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩
  simp only [Set.mem_iUnion]
  exact ⟨N, h₁, h₃, h₂⟩

name: card_outside_lt_card_sandbox

name: outsideRel_dom
statement: theorem outsideRel_dom (ξ : BaseAction) : Disjoint ξᴬ.dom ξ.outsideRel.dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  rintro a ⟨ha, _, _, _, _, _, ha', _⟩
  contradiction

name: outsideRel_codom
statement: theorem outsideRel_codom (ξ : BaseAction) : Disjoint ξᴬ.codom ξ.outsideRel.codom
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  rintro _ ⟨⟨a, hab⟩, b, _, hb', rfl⟩
  exact (outsideMap_litter ⟨b, hb'⟩).atom_not_mem _ ⟨a, hab⟩ rfl

name: outsideRel_mem_iff_mem
statement:
theorem outsideRel_mem_iff_mem {ξ : BaseAction} (hξ : ∀ N ∈ ξᴺ.dom, Nᴬ \ Nᴸᴬ ⊆ ξᴬ.dom)
    {a₁ a₂ : Atom} {N₁ N₂ : NearLitter}
    (ha : ξ.outsideRel a₁ a₂) (hN : ξᴺ N₁ N₂) :
    a₁ ∈ N₁ᴬ ↔ a₂ ∈ N₂ᴬ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨h₁, ⟨N₁', ⟨N₂', hN'⟩, h₂, h₃⟩, rfl⟩ := ha
  have := (outsideMap_litter ⟨a₁, N₁', ⟨N₂', hN'⟩, h₂, h₃⟩).nearLitter_not_mem N₂ _ rfl ⟨N₁, hN⟩
  apply (iff_false_right this).mpr
  intro h₄
  suffices N₁'ᴸ ≠ N₁ᴸ from h₁ (hξ N₁ ⟨N₂, hN⟩ ⟨h₄, h₃.trans_ne this⟩)
  contrapose! h₁
  apply ξ.interference_subset_dom ⟨N₂', hN'⟩ ⟨N₂, hN⟩
  rw [interference_eq_of_litter_eq h₁]
  exact Or.inr ⟨h₄, h₂⟩

name: outsideExtension_atoms
statement:
theorem outsideExtension_atoms (ξ : BaseAction) (hξ : ∀ N ∈ ξᴺ.dom, Nᴬ \ Nᴸᴬ ⊆ ξᴬ.dom) :
    (ξ.outsideExtension hξ)ᴬ = ξᴬ ⊔ ξ.outsideRel
proof:
:=

name: le_outsideExtension
statement:
theorem le_outsideExtension (ξ : BaseAction) (hξ : ∀ N ∈ ξᴺ.dom, Nᴬ \ Nᴸᴬ ⊆ ξᴬ.dom) :

name: outsideExtension_spec
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  by_contra ha'
  rw [outsideExtension_atoms, Rel.sup_dom, Set.mem_union, not_or] at ha'
  apply ha'.2
  obtain ⟨N', hN⟩ := hN
  exact ⟨_, ha'.1, ⟨N, ⟨N', hN⟩, ha.2, ha.1⟩, rfl⟩

name: le_doubleInsideExtension
statement:
theorem le_doubleInsideExtension (ξ : BaseAction) :
    ξ ≤ ξ.doubleInsideExtension
proof:
:=
  ξ.le_insideExtension.trans <| inv_le <| ξ.insideExtension⁻¹.le_insideExtension

name: doubleInsideExtension_dom
statement:
theorem doubleInsideExtension_dom {ξ : BaseAction} (N : NearLitter) (hN : N ∈ ξᴺ.dom) :
    Nᴬ \ Nᴸᴬ ⊆ ξ.doubleInsideExtensionᴬ.dom
proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  have := ξ.insideExtension_spec N hN ha
  rw [doubleInsideExtension, inv_atoms, insideExtension_atoms, Rel.inv_dom, Rel.sup_codom]
  left
  exact this

statement:
theorem doubleInsideExtension_codom {ξ : BaseAction} (N : NearLitter) (hN : N ∈ ξᴺ.codom) :

proof:

  ξ.insideExtension⁻¹.insideExtension_spec N hN

name: niceExtension_aux
statement:
theorem niceExtension_aux {ξ : BaseAction} (N : NearLitter) (hN : N ∈ ξᴺ.codom) :

proof:
:= by
  intro a ha
  rw [inv_atoms, outsideExtension_atoms, Rel.inv_dom, Rel.sup_codom]
  left
  exact doubleInsideExtension_codom N hN ha

name: le_niceExtension
statement:
theorem le_niceExtension (ξ : BaseAction) :
    ξ ≤ ξ.niceExtension
proof:
:=
  ξ.le_doubleInsideExtension.trans <|
    (ξ.doubleInsideExtension.le_outsideExtension _).trans <| inv_le <|
    (ξ.doubleInsideExtension.outsideExtension _)⁻¹.le_outsideExtension _

name: niceExtension_nice
statement: theorem niceExtension_nice (ξ : BaseAction) : ξ.niceExtension.Nice
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro N hN a (ha | ha)
    · rw [niceExtension, inv_atoms, Rel.inv_dom, outsideExtension_atoms, Rel.sup_codom]
      left
      rw [inv_atoms, Rel.inv_codom, outsideExtension_atoms, Rel.sup_dom]
      left
      exact ξ.doubleInsideExtension_dom N hN ha
    · rw [niceExtension, inv_atoms, Rel.inv_dom, outsideExtension_atoms, Rel.sup_codom]
      left
      rw [inv_atoms, Rel.inv_codom]
      exact outsideExtension_spec (ξ := ξ.doubleInsideExtension) N hN ha
  · rintro N hN a (ha | ha)
    · rw [niceExtension, inv_atoms, Rel.inv_codom, outsideExtension_atoms, Rel.sup_dom]
      left
      rw [inv_atoms, Rel.inv_dom, outsideExtension_atoms, Rel.sup_codom]
      left
      exact ξ.doubleInsideExtension_codom N hN ha
    · rw [niceExtension, inv_atoms, Rel.inv_codom]
      exact outsideExtension_spec
        (ξ := (ξ.doubleInsideExtension.outsideExtension ξ.doubleInsideExtension_dom)⁻¹) N hN ha

name: InflexiblePath.coderiv_A
statement:
@[simp]
theorem InflexiblePath.coderiv_A {β β' : TypeIndex} (P : InflexiblePath β) (B : β' ↝ β) :
    (P ⇗ B).A = B ⇘ P.A
proof:
:=

name: inflexible_iff
statement:
theorem inflexible_iff [LeLevel β] (A : β ↝ ⊥) (L : Litter) :
    Inflexible A L ↔ ∃ P : InflexiblePath β, ∃ t, A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘. ∧ L = fuzz P.hδε t
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: not_inflexible_iff
statement:
theorem not_inflexible_iff [LeLevel β] (A : β ↝ ⊥) (L : Litter) :
    ¬Inflexible A L ↔ ∀ P : InflexiblePath β, ∀ t, A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘. → L ≠ fuzz P.hδε t
proof:
:= by
  rw [inflexible_iff]
  push_neg
  rfl

name: inflexible_deriv
statement:
theorem inflexible_deriv [LeLevel β] {A : β ↝ ⊥} {L : Litter} (h : Inflexible A L)
    {β' : TypeIndex} [LeLevel β'] (B : β' ↝ β) :
    Inflexible (B ⇘ A) L
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, t, hA, ht⟩ := h
  refine ⟨P ⇗ B, t, ?_, ht⟩
  rw [hA]
  rfl

name: inflexible_cases
statement:
theorem inflexible_cases [LeLevel β] (A : β ↝ ⊥) (L : Litter) :
    (∃ P : InflexiblePath β, ∃ t, A = P.A ↘ P.hε ↘. ∧ L = fuzz P.hδε t) ∨ ¬Inflexible A L
proof:
:=
  Classical.em _

name: inflexiblePath_subsingleton
proof:
:= by
  subst hP₁
  subst ht₁
  have := fuzz_β_eq ht₂ 
  obtain ⟨γ₁, δ₁, ε₁, _, _, _, A₁⟩ := P₁
  obtain ⟨γ₂, δ₂, ε₂, _, _, _, A₂⟩ := P₂
  cases this
  cases Path.sderivBot_index_injective hP₂ 
  cases Path.sderiv_index_injective (Path.sderivBot_path_injective hP₂) 
  cases Path.sderiv_path_injective (Path.sderivBot_path_injective hP₂) 
  rfl

name: card_inflexiblePath_lt
statement: theorem card_inflexiblePath_lt (β : TypeIndex) : #(InflexiblePath β) < (#μ).ord.cof
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_le_of_injective inflexiblePathEmbedding.injective).trans_lt
  simp only [mk_prod, Cardinal.lift_id]
  apply mul_lt_of_lt aleph0_lt_μ_ord_cof.le (TypeIndex.card_Iic_lt β)
  apply mul_lt_of_lt aleph0_lt_μ_ord_cof.le (TypeIndex.card_Iic_lt β)
  exact card_path_any_lt β

name: smul_atoms
statement:
theorem smul_atoms {X : Type _} [BaseActionClass X] (ξ : X) (S : BaseSupport) :
    (ξ • S)ᴬ = Sᴬ.comp ξᴬ (BaseActionClass.atoms_oneOne ξ).toCoinjective
proof:
:=

name: smul_nearLitters
statement:
theorem smul_nearLitters {X : Type _} [BaseActionClass X] (ξ : X) (S : BaseSupport) :
