:= by
  rw [StrSet.coe_ext_iff]
  intro β hβ z
  haveI : LtLevel β := ⟨hβ⟩
  rw [StrSet.mem_smul_iff, NewSet.typedMem_forget, NewSet.typedMem_forget,
    NewSet.smul_c, smul_members]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨(ρ.sderiv β)⁻¹ • y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rwa [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem] at hy
    · simp only [ConNF.smul_forget, allPermForget_inv, forget_sderiv]
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, hyz⟩
    rw [eq_inv_smul_iff] at hyz
    cases hyz
    refine ⟨ρ.sderiv β • y, Set.smul_mem_smul_set hy, ?_⟩
    simp only [ConNF.smul_forget, forget_sderiv]

name: NewSet.exists_support
statement:
theorem NewSet.exists_support (x : letI := newPreModelData; TSet α) :
    letI
proof:
:= newPreModelData
    ∃ S : Support α, S.Supports x := by
  letI := newPreModelData
  obtain (_ | x) := x
  · use ⟨.empty, .empty⟩
    constructor
    · intros
      rfl
    · rintro ⟨⟩
  · obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := x.hS
    refine ⟨S, ?_, λ h ↦ (WithBot.bot_ne_coe.symm h).elim⟩
    intro ρ hρ
    apply congr_arg some
    apply NewSet.ext
    exact hS ρ hρ

name: NewSet.coe_ne_empty
statement: theorem NewSet.coe_ne_empty (x : NewSet) : xᵁ ≠ (StrSet.coeEquiv.symm λ _ _ ↦ ∅)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  by_cases hα : IsMin α
  · obtain ⟨s, ⟨a, ha⟩, hs⟩ := x.c.eq_of_isMin hα
    have : aᵁ ∈[WithBot.bot_lt_coe _] xᵁ := by rwa [← mem_members, hs, Code.members_bot]
    rw [h, StrSet.mem_iff, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at this
    cases this
  · rw [not_isMin_iff] at hα
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := hα
    have : LtLevel β := ⟨WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hβ⟩
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := x.c.members_nonempty x.hc β
    rw [mem_members, h, StrSet.mem_iff, Equiv.apply_symm_apply] at hy
    cases hy

name: Code.hasSet
statement:
theorem Code.hasSet (c : Code)
    (hc : ∃ S : Support α, ∀ ρ : NewPerm, ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • c = c) :
    ∃ x : NewSet, Represents x.c c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := represents_cofunctional.surjective c
  refine ⟨⟨d, hd.even, ?_⟩, hd⟩
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := hc
  use S
  intro ρ hρ
  have := hS ρ hρ
  have hρd := hd.smul ρ
  rw [this] at hρd
  rw [← represents_cofunctional.injective hd hρd]

name: Code.toSet_spec
statement:
theorem Code.toSet_spec (c : Code)
    (hc : ∃ S : Support α, ∀ ρ : NewPerm, ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • c = c) :
    Represents (c.toSet hc).c c
proof:
:=
  (c.hasSet hc).choose_spec

name: Code.mem_toSet'
proof:
:= by
  rw [← NewSet.mem_members, members_eq_of_represents (c.toSet_spec hc)]

name: Code.mem_toSet
proof:
:=
  Code.mem_toSet' ⟨β, s, hs⟩ y

name: NearLitter.code_aux
statement:
theorem NearLitter.code_aux {N : NearLitter} :
    {x : TSet ⊥ | StrSet.botEquiv xᵁ ∈ Nᴬ}.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  have : #Nᴬ ≠ 0 := by rw [NearLitter.card_atoms]; exact mk_ne_zero κ
  rw [Cardinal.mk_ne_zero_iff_nonempty] at this
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := this
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := tSetForget_surjective (StrSet.botEquiv.symm a)
  use x
  rwa [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hx, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

name: NearLitter.smul_code
statement:
theorem NearLitter.smul_code (ρ : NewPerm) (N : NearLitter) :
    ρ • N.code = (ρᵁ ↘. • N).code
proof:
:= by
  simp only [code, NewPerm.smul_mk, BasePerm.smul_nearLitter_atoms, Code.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq,
    true_and]
  ext a
  rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_setOf_eq, smul_forget,
    allPermForget_inv, StrSet.strPerm_smul_bot, Tree.inv_apply, ← NewPerm.forget_sderiv,
    Tree.sderiv_apply, ← Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
  rfl

name: newTyped_aux
statement:
theorem newTyped_aux {N : NearLitter} :
    ∃ S : Support α, ∀ ρ : NewPerm, ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • N.code = N.code
proof:
:= by
  use ⟨.empty, .singleton ⟨Path.nil ↘., N⟩⟩
  intro ρ hρ
  rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ
  have := (hρ (Path.nil ↘.)).2 N ((Enumeration.mem_singleton_iff _ _).mpr rfl)
  conv_rhs => rw [← this]
  rw [NearLitter.smul_code]
  rfl

name: newTyped_c_eq
statement:
theorem newTyped_c_eq (N : NearLitter) :
    (newTyped N).c = N.code
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := Code.toSet_spec N.code newTyped_aux
  have h₂ : Represents N.code N.code := Represents.refl _ (Code.bot_even _ _)
  exact represents_cofunctional.injective h₁ h₂

name: mem_newTyped_iff
statement:
theorem mem_newTyped_iff (a : TSet ⊥) (N : NearLitter) :
    aᵁ ∈[WithBot.bot_lt_coe _] (newTyped N)ᵁ ↔ StrSet.botEquiv aᵁ ∈ Nᴬ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [newTyped, NearLitter.code, Code.mem_toSet, Set.mem_setOf_eq]

name: newTyped_injective
statement: theorem newTyped_injective : Function.Injective newTyped
proof:
:= by
  intro N₁ N₂ hN
  rw [NearLitter.ext_iff]
  ext a
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := tSetForget_surjective (StrSet.botEquiv.symm a)
  rw [Equiv.eq_symm_apply] at hx
  cases hx
  rw [← mem_newTyped_iff, ← mem_newTyped_iff, hN]

name: smul_newTyped
statement:
theorem smul_newTyped (ρ : NewPerm) (N : NearLitter) :
    ρ • newTyped N = newTyped (ρᵁ ↘. • N)
proof:
:= by
  apply NewSet.ext
  simp only [NewSet.smul_c, BasePerm.smul_nearLitter_atoms, newTyped_c_eq, NearLitter.smul_code]

name: newSingleton_aux
statement:
theorem newSingleton_aux {γ : Λ} [LtLevel γ] {x : TSet γ} :
    ∃ S : Support α, ∀ ρ : NewPerm, ρᵁ • S = S → ρ • newSingletonCode x = newSingletonCode x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_support x
  use S ↗ LtLevel.elim
  intro ρ hρ
  suffices ρ.sderiv γ • x = x by simp only [newSingletonCode, NewPerm.smul_mk,
    Set.smul_set_singleton, Code.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, Set.singleton_eq_singleton_iff,
    true_and, this]
  apply hS.supports
  rwa [Support.smul_scoderiv, Support.scoderiv_inj, NewPerm.forget_sderiv] at hρ

name: mem_none_iff
statement:
theorem mem_none_iff {β : TypeIndex} [LtLevel β] (y : TSet β) :
    y ∈[LtLevel.elim] (show TSet α from none) ↔
    yᵁ ∈[LtLevel.elim] (StrSet.coeEquiv.symm λ _ _ ↦ ∅)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: mem_some_iff
statement:
theorem mem_some_iff {β : TypeIndex} [LtLevel β] (y : TSet β) (x : NewSet) :
    y ∈[LtLevel.elim] (show TSet α from some x) ↔
    yᵁ ∈[LtLevel.elim] xᵁ
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: mem_newSingleton_iff
statement:
theorem mem_newSingleton_iff {γ : Λ} [LtLevel γ] (x y : TSet γ) :
    y ∈[LtLevel.elim] (show TSet α from some (newSingleton x)) ↔ y = x
proof:
:= by
  simp only [newSingleton, newSingletonCode, mem_some_iff, Code.mem_toSet, Set.mem_singleton_iff]

name: not_mem_none
statement:
theorem not_mem_none {β : TypeIndex} [LtLevel β] (z : TSet β) :
    ¬z ∈[LtLevel.elim] (show TSet α from none)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_none_iff, StrSet.mem_iff, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact id

name: newModelData_ext
statement:
theorem newModelData_ext (β : Λ) [LtLevel β] (x y : TSet α)
    (h : ∀ z : TSet β, z ∈[LtLevel.elim] x ↔ z ∈[LtLevel.elim] y) :
    x = y
proof:
:= by
  obtain (_ | x) := x <;> obtain (_ | y) := y
  · rfl
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Code.members_nonempty y.hc β
    rw [NewSet.mem_members] at hz
    cases not_mem_none z ((h z).mpr hz)
  · obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Code.members_nonempty x.hc β
    rw [NewSet.mem_members] at hz
    cases not_mem_none z ((h z).mp hz)
  · apply congr_arg some
    apply NewSet.ext
    apply Code.ext x.hc y.hc β
    ext z
    rw [NewSet.mem_members, NewSet.mem_members]
    exact h z

name: card_newPositionDeny
statement:
theorem card_newPositionDeny (t : Tangle α) :
    #(newPositionDeny t) < (#μ).ord.cof
proof:
:= by
  rw [newPositionDeny]
  apply (mk_union_le _ _).trans_lt
  apply add_lt_of_lt aleph0_lt_μ_ord_cof.le
  apply (mk_union_le _ _).trans_lt
  apply add_lt_of_lt aleph0_lt_μ_ord_cof.le
  all_goals apply mk_image_le.trans_lt
  · refine lt_of_le_of_lt ?_ (one_lt_aleph0.trans aleph0_lt_μ_ord_cof)
    rw [mk_le_one_iff_set_subsingleton]
    intro N₁ hN₁ N₂ hN₂
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq] at hN₁ hN₂
    rwa [hN₁, Option.some_inj, newTyped_injective.eq_iff] at hN₂
  · exact (Enumeration.coe_small _).trans_le κ_le_μ_ord_cof
  · exact (Enumeration.coe_small _).trans_le κ_le_μ_ord_cof

name: pos_atom_lt_newPosition
statement:
theorem pos_atom_lt_newPosition (h : #(Tangle α) ≤ #μ) (t : Tangle α) (a : Atom)
    (A : α ↝ ⊥) (ha : a ∈ (t.support ⇘. A)ᴬ) :
    pos a < (newPosition h).pos t
proof:
:= by
  apply funOfDeny_gt_deny
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := ha
  refine Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩)
  exact ⟨i, ⟨A, a⟩, hi, rfl⟩

name: pos_nearLitter_lt_newPosition
statement:
theorem pos_nearLitter_lt_newPosition (h : #(Tangle α) ≤ #μ) (t : Tangle α) (N : NearLitter)
    (A : α ↝ ⊥) (hN : N ∈ (t.support ⇘. A)ᴺ) :
    pos N < (newPosition h).pos t
proof:
:= by
  apply funOfDeny_gt_deny
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hN
  refine Or.inr ⟨_, ?_, rfl⟩
  exact ⟨i, ⟨A, N⟩, hi, rfl⟩

name: pos_le_pos_of_typed
statement:
theorem pos_le_pos_of_typed (h : #(Tangle α) ≤ #μ) (N : NearLitter) (t : Tangle α)
    (ht : t.set = some (newTyped N)) :
    pos N ≤ (newPosition h).pos t
proof:
:= by
  apply le_of_lt
  apply funOfDeny_gt_deny
  refine Or.inl (Or.inl ?_)
  simp only [ht, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, EmbeddingLike.apply_eq_iff_eq, exists_eq_right]

name: smul_newTyped'
statement:
theorem smul_newTyped' (ρ : AllPerm α) (N : NearLitter) :
    ρ • (show TSet α from some (newTyped N)) = some (newTyped (ρᵁ ↘. • N))
proof:
:= by
  change some _ = some _
  dsimp only
  rw [smul_newTyped ρ N]

name: cloud_aux
statement:
theorem cloud_aux (β : TypeIndex) [LtLevel β] (γ : Λ) [LtLevel γ] (hβγ : β ≠ γ)
    (s : Set (TSet β)) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    (typed '' {N | ∃ t : Tangle β, t.set ∈ s ∧ Nᴸ = fuzz hβγ t} : Set (TSet γ)).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs
  rw [Set.image_nonempty]
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_support x
  exact ⟨(fuzz hβγ ⟨x, S, hS⟩)ᴺ, ⟨x, S, hS⟩, hx, rfl⟩

name: eq_coe_of_cloud
statement:
theorem eq_coe_of_cloud {c d : Code} (h : Cloud c d) :
    ∃ (γ : Λ) (_ : LtLevel γ) (s : Set (TSet γ)) (hs : s.Nonempty), d = ⟨γ, s, hs⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨⟩ := h
  exact ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩

name: cloud_mk_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟩
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hβγ, rfl⟩
    exact .mk c.β γ hβγ c.s c.hs

name: subset_of_cloud
statement:
theorem subset_of_cloud {β : TypeIndex} {γ : Λ} [LtLevel β] [LtLevel γ]
    {hβγ : β ≠ γ} {s₁ s₂ : Set (TSet β)}
    (h : {N : NearLitter | ∃ t : Tangle β, t.set ∈ s₁ ∧ Nᴸ = fuzz hβγ t} =
      {N | ∃ t : Tangle β, t.set ∈ s₂ ∧ Nᴸ = fuzz hβγ t}) :
    s₁ ⊆ s₂
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_support x
  have : (fuzz hβγ ⟨x, S, hS⟩)ᴺ ∈
      {N : NearLitter | ∃ t : Tangle β, t.set ∈ s₁ ∧ Nᴸ = fuzz hβγ t} :=
    ⟨⟨x, S, hS⟩, hx, rfl⟩
  rw [h] at this
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htN⟩ := this
  cases fuzz_injective htN
  exact ht

name: cloud_injective
statement: theorem cloud_injective : Cloud.Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro ⟨β, s, hs⟩ ⟨γ, t, ht⟩ d h₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨δ, _, u, hu, rfl⟩ := eq_coe_of_cloud h₁
  rw [cloud_mk_iff] at h₁ h₂
  obtain ⟨hβδ, rfl⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨hγδ, h⟩ := h₂
  have h' := TypedNearLitters.typed_injective.image_injective h
  have : β = γ := by
    rw [Set.image_nonempty] at hu
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hu
    have hy := hx
    rw [h'] at hy
    obtain ⟨t₁, -, hN₁⟩ := hx
    obtain ⟨t₂, -, hN₂⟩ := hy
    exact fuzz_β_eq (hN₁.symm.trans hN₂)
  cases this
  simp only [Code.mk.injEq, heq_eq_eq, true_and]
  apply subset_antisymm
  · exact subset_of_cloud h'
  · exact subset_of_cloud h'.symm

name: Code.positions_nonempty
statement: theorem Code.positions_nonempty (c : Code) : c.positions.Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := c.hs
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_support x
  exact ⟨_, ⟨x, S, hS⟩, hx, rfl⟩

name: Code.positions_lt_of_cloud
statement:
theorem Code.positions_lt_of_cloud {c d : Code} (h : Cloud c d) :
    ∀ ν₂ ∈ d.positions, ∃ ν₁ ∈ c.positions, ν₁ < ν₂
proof:
:= by
  rintro _ ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨β, γ, hβγ, s, hs⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨N, ⟨v, hv, hvN⟩, hu⟩ := ht
  refine ⟨_, ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
  apply (pos_fuzz hβγ v).trans_le
  rw [← hvN]
  apply (NearLitter.pos_litter_lt_pos N).le.trans
  exact TypedNearLitters.pos_le_pos_of_typed N t hu.symm

name: Code.cloud_subrelation
statement: theorem Code.cloud_subrelation : Subrelation Cloud (InvImage (· < ·) pos)
proof:
:= by
  intro c d h
  have := positions_lt_of_cloud h d.pos (WellFounded.min_mem _ _ _)
  obtain ⟨ν, hν₁, hν₂⟩ := this
  rw [InvImage]
  have := WellFounded.not_lt_min (inferInstanceAs (WellFoundedLT μ)).wf
    c.positions c.positions_nonempty hν₁
  rw [← not_le]
  contrapose! this
  exact hν₂.trans_le this

name: cloud_wf
statement: theorem cloud_wf : WellFounded Cloud
proof:
:= by
  apply Code.cloud_subrelation.wf
  apply InvImage.wf
  exact (inferInstanceAs (WellFoundedLT μ)).wf

name: eq_of_cloud
statement:
theorem eq_of_cloud {c : Code} {γ : TypeIndex} [LtLevel γ]
    {s t : Set (TSet γ)} {hs : s.Nonempty} {ht : t.Nonempty}
    (hcs : Cloud c ⟨γ, s, hs⟩) (hct : Cloud c ⟨γ, t, ht⟩) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  cases hcs
  cases hct
  rfl

name: not_even_and_odd
statement: theorem not_even_and_odd (c : Code) : ¬(c.Even ∧ c.Odd)
proof:
:= by
  induction c using cloud_wf.induction
  case h c ih =>
    intro hc
    obtain ⟨⟨_, hc⟩, ⟨_, d, hdc, hd⟩⟩ := hc
    exact ih d hdc ⟨hd, hc d hdc⟩

name: even_or_odd
statement: theorem even_or_odd (c : Code) : c.Even ∨ c.Odd
proof:
:= by
  induction c using cloud_wf.induction
  case h c ih =>
    by_cases h' : ∀ d, Cloud d c → d.Odd
    · left
      exact .mk c h'
    · right
      push_neg at h'
      obtain ⟨d, hd₁, hd₂⟩ := h'
      obtain (hd | hd) := ih d hd₁
      · exact .mk c d hd₁ hd
      · cases hd₂ hd

name: not_even
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_even (c : Code) : ¬c.Even ↔ c.Odd
proof:
:= by
  have := even_or_odd c
  have := not_even_and_odd c
  tauto

name: not_odd
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_odd (c : Code) : ¬c.Odd ↔ c.Even
proof:
:= by
  have := not_even c
  tauto

name: Represents.even
statement: theorem Represents.even {c d : Code} (h : Represents c d) : c.Even
proof:
:= by
  cases h <;> assumption

name: represents_injective
statement: theorem represents_injective : Represents.Injective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro c₁ c₂ d (⟨_, hc₁⟩ | ⟨_, _, hc₁, hc₁d⟩) (⟨_, hc₂⟩ | ⟨_, _, hc₂, hc₂d⟩)
  · rfl
  · cases not_even_and_odd c₁ ⟨hc₁, c₁, c₂, hc₂d, hc₂⟩
  · cases not_even_and_odd c₂ ⟨hc₂, c₂, c₁, hc₁d, hc₁⟩
  · exact cloud_injective.injective hc₁d hc₂d

name: represents_surjective
statement: theorem represents_surjective : Represents.Surjective
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro c
  obtain (hc | ⟨_, d, hdc, hd⟩) := even_or_odd c
  · exact ⟨c, .refl c hc⟩
  · exact ⟨d, .cloud d c hd hdc⟩

name: represents_cofunctional
statement: theorem represents_cofunctional : Represents.Cofunctional
proof:
:=
  ⟨represents_injective, represents_surjective⟩

name: eq_of_represents
statement:
theorem eq_of_represents {c : Code} {γ : TypeIndex} [LtLevel γ]
    {s t : Set (TSet γ)} {hs : s.Nonempty} {ht : t.Nonempty}
    (hcs : Represents c ⟨γ, s, hs⟩) (hct : Represents c ⟨γ, t, ht⟩) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  obtain (⟨_, hc⟩ | ⟨_, _, hc, hcs⟩) := hcs <;>
  obtain (⟨_, _⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, hct⟩) := hct
  · rfl
  · obtain ⟨_, γ, hβγ, _, _⟩ := hct
    cases hβγ rfl
  · obtain ⟨_, γ, hβγ, _, _⟩ := hcs
    cases hβγ rfl
  · exact eq_of_cloud hcs hct

name: exists_represents
statement:
theorem exists_represents {c : Code} (hc : c.Even) (γ : Λ) [LtLevel γ] :
    ∃ (s : Set (TSet γ)) (hs : s.Nonempty), Represents c ⟨γ, s, hs⟩
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hβγ : c.β = γ
  · obtain ⟨β, s, hs⟩ := c
    cases hβγ
    exact ⟨s, hs, .refl ⟨γ, s, hs⟩ hc⟩
  · exact ⟨_, _, .cloud c _ hc (.mk c.β γ hβγ c.s c.hs)⟩

name: Code.members_eq_of_represents
statement:
theorem Code.members_eq_of_represents {c : Code} {β : TypeIndex} [LtLevel β]
    {s : Set (TSet β)} {hs : s.Nonempty} (hc : Represents c ⟨β, s, hs⟩) :
    c.members β = s
proof:
:= by
  apply subset_antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨t, ht, hxt, hct⟩
    cases eq_of_represents hc hct
    exact hxt
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨s, hs, hx, hc⟩

name: Code.members_nonempty
statement:
theorem Code.members_nonempty {c : Code} (hc : c.Even) (β : Λ) [LtLevel β] :
    (c.members β).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨x, hx⟩, hc⟩ := exists_represents hc β
  exact ⟨x, s, ⟨x, hx⟩, hx, hc⟩

name: Code.ext
statement:
theorem Code.ext {c d : Code} (hc : c.Even) (hd : d.Even) (β : Λ) [LtLevel β]
    (h : c.members β = d.members β) : c = d
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, s, hs, hxs, hcs⟩ := members_nonempty hc β
  obtain ⟨y, t, ht, hyt, hdt⟩ := members_nonempty hd β
  have hs' := members_eq_of_represents hcs
  have ht' := members_eq_of_represents hdt
  rw [hs', ht'] at h
  cases h
  exact represents_cofunctional.injective hcs hdt

name: Code.eq_of_isMin
statement:
theorem Code.eq_of_isMin (c : Code) (hα : IsMin α) :
    ∃ s hs, c = ⟨⊥, s, hs⟩
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨β, s, hs⟩ := c
  cases β using WithBot.recBotCoe
  case bot => exact ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩
  case coe β hβ => cases hα.not_lt (WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mp hβ.elim)

name: Code.bot_even
statement:
theorem Code.bot_even (s : Set (TSet ⊥)) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    (Code.mk ⊥ s hs).Even
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  rintro _ ⟨⟩

name: Code.members_bot
statement:
theorem Code.members_bot (s : Set (TSet ⊥)) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    (Code.mk ⊥ s hs).members ⊥ = s
proof:
:= by
  ext x : 1
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, ht, hxt, ⟨⟩ | ⟨_, _, _, _, _⟩⟩
    exact hxt
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨s, hs, hx, .refl _ (bot_even s hs)⟩

name: Code.ext'
statement:
theorem Code.ext' {c d : Code} (hc : c.Even) (hd : d.Even)
    (h : ∀ (β : TypeIndex) [LtLevel β], c.members β = d.members β) :
    c = d
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hα : IsMin α
  · obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := c.eq_of_isMin hα
    obtain ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩ := d.eq_of_isMin hα
    have := h ⊥
    rw [members_bot, members_bot] at this
    cases this
    rfl
  · rw [not_isMin_iff] at hα
    obtain ⟨β, hβ⟩ := hα
    have : LtLevel β := ⟨WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr hβ⟩
    apply ext hc hd β
    exact h β

name: externalRel_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem externalRel_smul (r : TSet α) (ρ : AllPerm α) :
    ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ (ρ • r) =
      InvImage (ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ r) ((ρ ↘ hβ ↘ hγ ↘ hδ)⁻¹ • ·)
proof:
:= by
  ext a b
  simp only [ExternalRel, mem_smul_iff', allPerm_inv_sderiv', smul_op, InvImage]

name: apply_eq_of_isWellOrder
proof:
:= by
  let emb : r ≼i r := ⟨⟨⟨f, hf.injective⟩, λ {a b} ↦ (hf' a b).symm⟩, ?_⟩
  · have : emb = InitialSeg.refl r := Subsingleton.elim _ _
    intro x
    exact congr_arg (λ f ↦ f x) this
  · intro a b h
    exact hf.surjective _

name: apply_eq_of_isWellOrder'
statement:
theorem apply_eq_of_isWellOrder' {X : Type _} {r : Rel X X} {f : X → X}
    (hr : IsWellOrder r.field (InvImage r Subtype.val)) (hf : Function.Bijective f)
    (hf' : ∀ x y, r x y ↔ r (f x) (f y)) :
    ∀ x ∈ r.field, f x = x
proof:
:= by
  have : ∀ x ∈ r.field, f x ∈ r.field := by
    rintro x (⟨y, h⟩ | ⟨y, h⟩)
    · exact Or.inl ⟨f y, (hf' x y).mp h⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨f y, (hf' y x).mp h⟩
  have := apply_eq_of_isWellOrder (f := λ x ↦ ⟨f x.val, this x.val x.prop⟩) hr ⟨?_, ?_⟩ ?_
  · intro x hx
    exact congr_arg Subtype.val (this ⟨x, hx⟩)
  · intro x y h
    rw [Subtype.mk.injEq] at h
    exact Subtype.val_injective (hf.injective h)
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := hf.surjective x.val
    refine ⟨⟨y, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · obtain (⟨z, h⟩ | ⟨z, h⟩) := x.prop <;>
          rw [← hy] at h <;>
          obtain ⟨z, rfl⟩ := hf.surjective z
      · exact Or.inl ⟨z, (hf' y z).mpr h⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨z, (hf' z y).mpr h⟩
    · simp only [hy]
  · intros
    apply hf'

name: exists_common_support_of_internallyWellOrdered'
proof:
:= by
  obtain (h | ⟨r, h, rfl⟩) := h
  · obtain (h | ⟨y, hy⟩) := h.eq_empty_or_singleton
    · use ⟨Enumeration.empty, Enumeration.empty⟩
      intro y hy
      rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem] at h
      cases h y hy
    · obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := TSet.exists_support y
      use S ↗ hε ↗ hδ ↗ hγ
      intro z hz
      rw [Set.eq_singleton_iff_unique_mem] at hy
      cases hy.2 z hz
      refine ⟨?_, λ h ↦ by cases h⟩
      intro ρ hρ
      simp only [Support.smul_scoderiv, ← allPermSderiv_forget', Support.scoderiv_inj] at hρ
      simp only [smul_singleton, singleton_inj]
      exact hS _ hρ
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := TSet.exists_support r
  use S
  intro a ha
  refine ⟨?_, λ h ↦ by cases h⟩
  intro ρ hρ
  have := hS ρ hρ
  simp only [smul_singleton, singleton_inj]
  apply apply_eq_of_isWellOrder' (r := ExternalRel hγ hδ hε r)
  · exact h
  · exact MulAction.bijective (ρ ↘ hγ ↘ hδ ↘ hε)
  · intro x y
    conv_rhs => rw [← this]
    simp only [externalRel_smul, InvImage, inv_smul_smul]
  · rwa [mem_field_iff] at ha

name: Support.Supports.ofSingleton
proof:
:= ⟨α⟩
    letI : LeLevel α := ⟨le_rfl⟩
    (S.strong ↘ hβ).Supports x := by
  refine ⟨?_, λ h ↦ by cases h⟩
  intro ρ hρ
  open scoped Pointwise in
  have := sUnion_singleton_symmetric_aux hγ hβ {y | y ∈' x} S ?_ ρ hρ
  · apply ConNF.ext hγ
    intro z
    simp only [Set.ext_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem] at this
    rw [mem_smul_iff', allPerm_inv_sderiv', this]
  · intro ρ hρ
    ext z
    simp only [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem, Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    have := h.supports ρ hρ
    simp only [smul_singleton, singleton_inj] at this
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨y, h₁, h₂⟩
      rw [← smul_eq_iff_eq_inv_smul, smul_singleton] at h₂
      refine ⟨_, ?_, h₂⟩
      rw [← this]
      simp only [mem_smul_iff', allPerm_inv_sderiv', inv_smul_smul]
      exact h₁
    · rintro ⟨y, h, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨(ρ ↘ hβ ↘ hγ)⁻¹ • y, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rwa [← allPerm_inv_sderiv', ← mem_smul_iff', this]
      · simp only [smul_singleton, allPerm_inv_sderiv']

name: supports_of_supports_singletons
proof:
:=
  ⟨_, λ x hx ↦ (h x hx).ofSingleton hβ hγ⟩

name: exists_common_support_of_internallyWellOrdered
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_common_support_of_internallyWellOrdered' hγ hδ hε h
  have := supports_of_supports_singletons (S := S)
      (s := singleton hδ '' (singleton hε '' {y | y ∈' x})) hγ hδ ?_
  swap
  · simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, exists_exists_and_eq_and, forall_exists_index,
      and_imp, forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂]
    exact hS
  obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := this
  have := supports_of_supports_singletons (S := T)
      (s := singleton hε '' {y | y ∈' x}) hδ hε ?_
  swap
  · simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
      forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂] at hT ⊢
    exact hT
  simp only [Set.mem_image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, forall_exists_index, and_imp,
    forall_apply_eq_imp_iff₂] at this
  exact this

name: internallyWellOrdered_of_common_support_of_nontrivial
statement:
theorem internallyWellOrdered_of_common_support_of_nontrivial {x : TSet γ}
    (hx : {y : TSet δ | y ∈' x}.Nontrivial)
    (S : Support δ) (hS : ∀ y : TSet δ, y ∈' x → S.Supports y) :
    InternallyWellOrdered hβ hγ hδ x
proof:
:= by
  have := exists_of_symmetric
      {p : TSet β | ∃ a b : TSet δ, p = ⟨a, b⟩' ∧ a ∈' x ∧ b ∈' x ∧ WellOrderingRel a b} hβ ?_
  swap
  · use S ↗ hδ ↗ hγ ↗ hβ
    intro ρ hρ
    ext z
    simp only [Support.smul_scoderiv, ← allPermSderiv_forget', Support.scoderiv_inj] at hρ
    simp only [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem, Set.mem_setOf_eq]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, b, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
      refine ⟨a, b, ?_, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
      rw [inv_smul_eq_iff] at h₁
      rw [h₁, smul_op, op_inj]
      exact ⟨(hS a h₂).supports _ hρ, (hS b h₃).supports _ hρ⟩
    · rintro ⟨a, b, h₁, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
      refine ⟨a, b, ?_, h₂, h₃, h₄⟩
      rw [h₁, smul_op, op_inj]
      simp only [allPerm_inv_sderiv', inv_smul_eq_iff]
      rw [(hS a h₂).supports _ hρ, (hS b h₃).supports _ hρ]
      exact ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := this
  right
  use r
  have hr' : ∀ a b, ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ r a b ↔ a ∈' x ∧ b ∈' x ∧ WellOrderingRel a b := by
    intro a b
    rw [ExternalRel, hr]
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, op_inj]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, b, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h⟩
      exact h
    · intro h
      exact ⟨a, b, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h⟩
  have hrx : ∀ a, a ∈ (ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ r).field ↔ a ∈' x := by
    intro a
    constructor
    · rintro (⟨b, h⟩ | ⟨b, h⟩)
      · rw [hr'] at h
        exact h.1
      · rw [hr'] at h
        exact h.2.1
    · intro h
      obtain ⟨b, h₁, h₂⟩ := hx.exists_ne a
      obtain (h₃ | h₃ | h₃) := WellOrderingRel.isWellOrder.trichotomous a b
      · refine Or.inl ⟨b, ?_⟩
        rw [hr']
        exact ⟨h, h₁, h₃⟩
      · cases h₂ h₃.symm
      · refine Or.inr ⟨b, ?_⟩
        rw [hr']
        exact ⟨h₁, h, h₃⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  swap
  · apply ext hδ
    intro z
    rw [mem_field_iff, hrx]
  refine @IsWellOrder.mk _ _ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · constructor
    intro a b
    obtain (h | h | h) := WellOrderingRel.isWellOrder.trichotomous a.val b.val
    · apply Or.inl
      rw [InvImage, hr']
      exact ⟨(hrx a).mp a.prop, (hrx b).mp b.prop, h⟩
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (Subtype.val_injective h))
    · apply Or.inr ∘ Or.inr
      rw [InvImage, hr']
      exact ⟨(hrx b).mp b.prop, (hrx a).mp a.prop, h⟩
  · constructor
    intro a b c h₁ h₂
    rw [InvImage, hr'] at h₁ h₂ ⊢
    exact ⟨h₁.1, h₂.2.1, WellOrderingRel.isWellOrder.trans _ _ _ h₁.2.2 h₂.2.2⟩
  · constructor
    apply InvImage.wf
    refine Subrelation.wf ?_ WellOrderingRel.isWellOrder.wf
    intro a b h
    rw [hr'] at h
    exact h.2.2

name: internallyWellOrdered_of_common_support
proof:
:= by
  obtain (hx | hx) := Set.subsingleton_or_nontrivial {y : TSet δ | y ∈' x}
  · exact Or.inl hx
  · exact internallyWellOrdered_of_common_support_of_nontrivial hβ hγ hδ hx S hS

name: powerset_internallyWellOrdered
statement:
theorem powerset_internallyWellOrdered {x : TSet δ} (h : InternallyWellOrdered hγ hδ hε x) :
    InternallyWellOrdered hβ hγ hδ (powerset hδ hε x)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := exists_common_support_of_internallyWellOrdered hγ hδ hε h
  apply internallyWellOrdered_of_common_support hβ hγ hδ S
  intro y hy
  simp only [mem_powerset_iff] at hy
  refine ⟨?_, λ h ↦ by cases h⟩
  intro ρ hρ
  apply ext hε
  intro z
  constructor
  · intro hz
    simp only [mem_smul_iff', allPerm_inv_sderiv'] at hz
    have := (hS _ (hy _ hz)).supports ρ hρ
    simp only [smul_singleton, smul_inv_smul, singleton_inj] at this
    rwa [this]
  · intro hz
    have := (hS z (hy _ hz)).supports ρ hρ
    simp only [smul_singleton, singleton_inj] at this
    rw [← this]
    simp only [mem_smul_iff', allPerm_inv_sderiv', inv_smul_smul]
    exact hz

name: inter_comm
statement:
theorem inter_comm (x y : TSet α) :
    x ⊓' y = y ⊓' x
proof:
:= by
  apply ext hβ
  intro z
  rw [mem_inter_iff, mem_inter_iff]
  exact And.comm

name: mem_union_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_union_iff (x y : TSet α) :
    ∀ z : TSet β, z ∈' x ⊔' y ↔ z ∈' x ∨ z ∈' y
proof:
:= by
  rw [union]
  intro z
  rw [mem_compl_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_compl_iff, mem_compl_iff, or_iff_not_and_not]

name: union_comm
statement:
theorem union_comm (x y : TSet α) :
    x ⊔' y = y ⊔' x
proof:
:= by
  apply ext hβ
  intro z
  rw [mem_union_iff, mem_union_iff]
  exact Or.comm

name: mem_symmDiff_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_symmDiff_iff (x y : TSet α) :
    ∀ z : TSet β, z ∈' x ∆' y ↔ (z ∈' x ↔ ¬(z ∈' y))
proof:
:= by
  rw [symmDiff]
  intro z
  simp only [mem_union_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_compl_iff]
  tauto

name: mem_diff_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_diff_iff (x y : TSet α) :
    ∀ z : TSet β, z ∈' x \' y ↔ z ∈' x ∧ ¬(z ∈' y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [diff]
  intro z
  simp only [mem_union_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_compl_iff]

name: high
statement:
theorem high {α : Λ} :
    (α : TypeIndex) < higherIndex α
proof:
:=
  WithBot.coe_lt_coe.mpr (exists_gt α).choose_spec

name: tSet_nonempty
statement: theorem tSet_nonempty (h : ∃ β : Λ, (β : TypeIndex) < α) : Nonempty (TSet α)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α', hα⟩ := h
  constructor
  apply typeLower high high high hα
  apply cardinalOne high high

name: mem_empty_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_empty_iff :
    ∀ x : TSet β, ¬x ∈' empty hβ
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [empty, mem_inter_iff, mem_compl_iff]
  exact and_not_self

name: mem_univ_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_univ_iff :
    ∀ x : TSet β, x ∈' univ hβ
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  simp only [univ, mem_compl_iff, mem_empty_iff, not_false_eq_true]

name: mem_orderedPairs_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_orderedPairs_iff (x : TSet β) :
    x ∈' orderedPairs hβ hγ hδ ↔ ∃ a b, x = ⟨a, b⟩'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [orderedPairs, mem_vCross_iff, mem_univ_iff, and_true]

name: op_mem_converse_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem op_mem_converse_iff (x : TSet α) :
    ∀ a b, ⟨a, b⟩' ∈' converse hβ hγ hδ x ↔ ⟨b, a⟩' ∈' x
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  simp only [converse, mem_inter_iff, converse'_spec, mem_orderedPairs_iff, op_inj, exists_and_left,
    exists_eq', and_true]

name: mem_cross_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cross_iff (x y : TSet γ) :
    ∀ a, a ∈' cross hβ hγ hδ x y ↔ ∃ b c, a = ⟨b, c⟩' ∧ b ∈' x ∧ c ∈' y
proof:
:= by
  intro a
  rw [cross, mem_inter_iff, mem_vCross_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h₁, b, c, rfl, h₂⟩
    simp only [op_mem_converse_iff, mem_vCross_iff, op_inj] at h₁
    obtain ⟨b', c', ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h₁⟩ := h₁
    exact ⟨b, c, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩
  · rintro ⟨b, c, rfl, h₁, h₂⟩
    simp only [op_mem_converse_iff, mem_vCross_iff, op_inj]
    exact ⟨⟨c, b, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h₁⟩, ⟨b, c, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h₂⟩⟩

name: singletonImage_spec
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singletonImage_spec (x : TSet β) :
    ∀ z w,
    ⟨ {z}', {w}' ⟩' ∈' singletonImage hβ hγ hδ hε x ↔ ⟨z, w⟩' ∈' x
proof:
:= by
  intro z w
  rw [singletonImage, mem_inter_iff, singletonImage'_spec, and_iff_left_iff_imp]
  intro hzw
  rw [mem_cross_iff]
  refine ⟨{z}', {w}', rfl, ?_⟩
  simp only [mem_cardinalOne_iff, singleton_inj, exists_eq', and_self]

name: exists_of_mem_singletonImage
proof:
:= by
  simp only [singletonImage, mem_inter_iff, mem_cross_iff, op_inj, mem_cardinalOne_iff] at h
  obtain ⟨-, _, _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨a, rfl⟩, ⟨b, rfl⟩⟩ := h
  exact ⟨a, b, rfl, rfl⟩

name: externalRel_converse
statement:
@[simp]
theorem externalRel_converse (r : TSet α) :
    ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ (converse hβ hγ hδ r) = (ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ r).inv
proof:
:= by
  ext
  simp only [ExternalRel, op_mem_converse_iff, Rel.inv_apply]

name: mem_codom_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_codom_iff (r : TSet α) (x : TSet δ) :
    x ∈' codom hβ hγ hδ r ↔ x ∈ (ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ r).codom
proof:
:= by
  simp only [codom, mem_compl_iff, mem_typeLower_iff, not_forall, not_not]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
    obtain ⟨a, b, rfl, hb⟩ := exists_of_mem_singletonImage high hβ hγ hδ hy
    rw [singleton_inj] at hb
    subst hb
    rw [singletonImage_spec] at hy
    exact ⟨a, hy⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, ha⟩
    use {a}'
    rw [singletonImage_spec]
    exact ha

name: mem_dom_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_dom_iff (r : TSet α) (x : TSet δ) :
    x ∈' dom hβ hγ hδ r ↔ x ∈ (ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ r).dom
proof:
:= by
  rw [dom, mem_codom_iff, externalRel_converse, Rel.inv_codom]

name: mem_field_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_field_iff (r : TSet α) (x : TSet δ) :
    x ∈' field hβ hγ hδ r ↔ x ∈ (ExternalRel hβ hγ hδ r).field
proof:
:= by
  rw [field, mem_union_iff, mem_dom_iff, mem_codom_iff, Rel.field, Set.mem_union]

name: subset_spec
statement:
@[simp]
theorem subset_spec :
    ∀ a b, ⟨a, b⟩' ∈' subset hβ hγ hδ hε ↔ a ⊆[TSet ε] b
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  simp only [subset, mem_inter_iff, subset'_spec, mem_orderedPairs_iff, op_inj, exists_and_left,
    exists_eq', and_true]

name: singleton_subset_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem singleton_subset_iff (a : TSet β) (b : TSet α) :
    {a}' ⊆[TSet β] b ↔ a ∈' b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply h a
    rw [typedMem_singleton_iff']
  · intro h x hx
    rw [typedMem_singleton_iff'] at hx
    cases hx
    exact h

name: membership_spec
statement:
@[simp]
theorem membership_spec :
    ∀ a b, ⟨{a}', b⟩' ∈' membership hβ hγ hδ hε ↔ a ∈' b
proof:
:= by
  intro a b
  rw [membership, mem_inter_iff, subset_spec]
  simp only [mem_cross_iff, op_inj, mem_cardinalOne_iff, mem_univ_iff, and_true, exists_and_right,
    exists_and_left, exists_eq', exists_eq_left', singleton_inj]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h a ((typedMem_singleton_iff' hε a a).mpr rfl)
  · intro h c hc
    simp only [typedMem_singleton_iff'] at hc
    cases hc
    exact h

name: mem_powerset_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_powerset_iff (x y : TSet β) :
    x ∈' powerset hβ hγ y ↔ x ⊆[TSet γ] y
proof:
:= by
  rw [powerset, mem_dom_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, h⟩
    simp only [ExternalRel, mem_inter_iff, subset_spec, mem_vCross_iff, op_inj,
      typedMem_singleton_iff', exists_eq_right, exists_and_right, exists_eq', true_and] at h
    cases h.2
    exact h.1
  · intro h
    refine ⟨y, ?_⟩
    simp only [ExternalRel, mem_inter_iff, subset_spec, h, mem_vCross_iff, op_inj,
      typedMem_singleton_iff', exists_eq_right, and_true, exists_eq', and_self]

name: mem_doubleSingletons_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_doubleSingletons_iff (x : TSet γ) :
    ∀ y : TSet β, y ∈' doubleSingletons hβ hγ hδ x ↔
    ∃ z : TSet δ, z ∈' x ∧ y = { {z}' }'
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  rw [doubleSingletons, mem_inter_iff, mem_cross_iff, mem_cardinalOne_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨b, c, h₁, h₂, h₃⟩, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
    obtain ⟨hbc, rfl⟩ := (op_eq_singleton_iff _ _ _ _ _).mp h₁.symm
    exact ⟨c, h₃, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, h, rfl⟩
    constructor
    · refine ⟨z, z, ?_⟩
      rw [eq_comm, op_eq_singleton_iff]
      tauto
    · exact ⟨_, rfl⟩

name: mem_singletonUnion_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_singletonUnion_iff (x : TSet α) :
    ∀ y : TSet γ, y ∈' singletonUnion hβ hγ x ↔ {y}' ∈' x
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  simp only [singletonUnion, mem_typeLower_iff, mem_vCross_iff, op_inj]
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨a, b, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, hy⟩ := h {y}'
    exact hy
  · intro h b
    exact ⟨b, _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, h⟩

name: mem_singletons_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_singletons_iff (x : TSet β) :

name: mem_sUnion_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_sUnion_iff (x : TSet α) :
    ∀ y : TSet γ, y ∈' sUnion hβ hγ x ↔ ∃ t : TSet β, t ∈' x ∧ y ∈' t
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  simp only [sUnion, mem_singletonUnion_iff, mem_dom_iff, Rel.dom, ExternalRel, mem_inter_iff,
    mem_cross_iff, op_inj, mem_cardinalOne_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, membership_spec]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, h₁, a, b, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨c, h₂⟩, h₃⟩
    rw [singleton_inj] at h₂
    cases h₂
    exact ⟨z, h₃, h₁⟩
  · rintro ⟨z, h₂, h₃⟩
    exact ⟨z, h₃, _, _, ⟨rfl, rfl⟩, ⟨y, rfl⟩, h₂⟩

name: mem_orderedTriples_iff
statement:

    mem_vCross_iff, and_true]

  · rintro ⟨_, _, rfl, ⟨a, rfl⟩, ⟨b, c, rfl⟩⟩
    exact ⟨_, _, _, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, b, c, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨_, _, rfl, ⟨_, rfl⟩, ⟨_, _, rfl⟩⟩

name: insertion2_spec
statement:

proof:

name: insertion3_spec

    exact ⟨a, h₂, h₁⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, h₁, h₂⟩

name: exists_smallUnion
statement:
theorem exists_smallUnion (s : Set (TSet α)) (hs : Small s) :
    ∃ x : TSet α, ∀ y : TSet β, y ∈' x ↔ ∃ t ∈ s, y ∈' t
proof:
:= by
  apply exists_of_symmetric
  have := exists_support (α := α)
  choose S hS using this
  refine ⟨⟨Enumeration.ofSet (⋃ t ∈ s, (S t)ᴬ) ?_, Enumeration.ofSet (⋃ t ∈ s, (S t)ᴺ) ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · apply small_biUnion hs
    intros
    exact (S _)ᴬ.coe_small
  · apply small_biUnion hs
    intros
    exact (S _)ᴺ.coe_small
  intro ρ hρ
  suffices ∀ t ∈ s, ρ • t = t by
    ext y
    rw [Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨t, h₁, h₂⟩
      refine ⟨t, h₁, ?_⟩
      rw [← this t h₁]
      rwa [mem_smul_iff', allPerm_inv_sderiv']
    · rintro ⟨t, h₁, h₂⟩
      refine ⟨t, h₁, ?_⟩
      have := this t h₁
      rw [smul_eq_iff_eq_inv_smul] at this
      rwa [this, mem_smul_iff', inv_inv, smul_inv_smul]
  intro t ht
  apply (hS t).supports ρ
  refine smul_eq_of_le ?_ hρ
  intro A
  constructor
  · intro a ha
    rw [← Support.derivBot_atoms, Support.mk_atoms, ← Enumeration.mem_path_iff,
      Enumeration.mem_ofSet_iff, Set.mem_iUnion]
    use t
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    use ht
    exact ha
  · intro a ha
    rw [← Support.derivBot_nearLitters, Support.mk_nearLitters, ← Enumeration.mem_path_iff,
      Enumeration.mem_ofSet_iff, Set.mem_iUnion]
    use t
    rw [Set.mem_iUnion]
    use ht
    exact ha

    ∀ x : TSet β, x ∈' smallUnion hβ s hs ↔ ∃ t ∈ s, x ∈' t
proof:

name: mem_disjoint_iff'
statement:
theorem mem_disjoint_iff' (x y : TSet δ) :
    ⟨x, y⟩' ∈' disjoint hβ hγ hδ hε ↔ ∀ z : TSet ε, ¬z ∈' x ⊓' y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [disjoint, mem_compl_iff, mem_image_iff, Rel.image, mem_singletons_iff,
    mem_cardinalOne_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ExternalRel, mem_inter_iff, not_exists, not_and,
    forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_eq_apply_imp_iff, insertion3_spec, subset_spec,
    singleton_subset_iff, insertion2_spec]

name: mem_disjoint_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_disjoint_iff (x y : TSet δ) :
    ⟨x, y⟩' ∈' disjoint hβ hγ hδ hε ↔ x ⊓' y = empty hε
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_disjoint_iff']
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply ext hε
    simp only [h, mem_empty_iff, implies_true]
  · intro h
    rw [← ext_iff hε] at h
    simp only [h, mem_empty_iff, not_false_eq_true, implies_true]

name: mem_unionEq_iff'
statement:
theorem mem_unionEq_iff' (x y z : TSet ζ) :
    ⟨ { {z}' }', ⟨y, x⟩' ⟩[hγ, hδ] ∈' unionEq hβ hγ hδ hε hζ hη ↔
      ∀ a : TSet η, ¬(a ∈' x ↔ ¬a ∈' y ∧ ¬a ∈' z)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [unionEq, mem_compl_iff, mem_image_iff, Rel.image, mem_singletons_iff,
    mem_cardinalOne_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ExternalRel, mem_symmDiff_iff, mem_union_iff, not_or,
    not_exists, not_and, forall_exists_index, and_imp, forall_eq_apply_imp_iff, insertion2_spec,
    subset_spec, singleton_subset_iff, insertion3_spec, singletonImage_spec]

name: mem_unionEq_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_unionEq_iff (x y z : TSet ζ) :
    ⟨ { {z}' }', ⟨y, x⟩' ⟩[hγ, hδ] ∈' unionEq hβ hγ hδ hε hζ hη ↔ y ⊔' z = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_unionEq_iff']
  constructor
  · intro h
    apply ext hη
    intro t
    rw [mem_union_iff]
    have := h t
    rw [iff_comm, not_iff, not_and_or, not_not, not_not] at this
    exact this
  · rintro rfl a
    rw [iff_comm, not_iff, not_and_or, not_not, not_not, mem_union_iff]

name: mem_binPartRel_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_binPartRel_iff (x y z : TSet ζ) :
    ⟨ { {x}' }', ⟨y, z⟩' ⟩[hγ, hδ] ∈' binPartRel hβ hγ hδ hε hζ hη ↔
    x ⊓' y = empty hη ∧ x ⊔' y = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [binPartRel, mem_inter_iff, insertion3_spec, mem_disjoint_iff, mem_unionEq_iff]
  rw [union_comm]

name: mem_cardAdd_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cardAdd_iff (x y : TSet α) (z : TSet β) :
    z ∈' cardAdd hβ hγ x y ↔
    ∃ a b : TSet β, a ∈' x ∧ b ∈' y ∧ a ⊓' b = empty hγ ∧ a ⊔' b = z
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cardAdd, mem_image_iff, Rel.image, Set.mem_setOf_eq, ExternalRel, mem_singletons_iff,
    exists_and_left]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, _, ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, h⟩
    rw [mem_binPartRel_iff] at h
    refine ⟨a, ha, b, hb, ?_⟩
    rwa [inter_comm, union_comm]
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, h, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, ha, _, ⟨_, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    rw [mem_binPartRel_iff, inter_comm, union_comm]
    exact ⟨h, rfl⟩

name: mem_succ_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_succ_iff (x : TSet α) (y : TSet β) :
    y ∈' succ hβ hγ x ↔
    ∃ a : TSet β, a ∈' x ∧ ∃ b : TSet γ, ¬b ∈' a ∧ y = a ⊔' {b}'
proof:
:= by
  simp only [succ, mem_cardAdd_iff, mem_cardinalOne_iff, exists_and_left]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, _, ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩, h, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, ha, b, ?_, rfl⟩
    intro hba
    rw [← ext_iff hγ] at h
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, typedMem_singleton_iff', mem_empty_iff, iff_false, not_and] at h
    exact h b hba rfl
  · rintro ⟨a, ha, b, hb, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨a, ha, _, ⟨b, rfl⟩, ?_, rfl⟩
    apply ext hγ
    intro z
    simp only [mem_inter_iff, typedMem_singleton_iff', mem_empty_iff, iff_false, not_and]
    rintro h rfl
    exact hb h

name: mem_cardinalNat_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_cardinalNat_iff (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ a : TSet β, a ∈' cardinalNat hβ hγ n ↔
    ∃ s : Finset (TSet γ), s.card = n ∧ ∀ b : TSet γ, b ∈' a ↔ b ∈ s
proof:
:= by
  induction n
  case zero =>
    intro a
    rw [cardinalNat]
    simp only [typedMem_singleton_iff', Finset.card_eq_zero, exists_eq_left, Finset.notMem_empty,
      iff_false]
    constructor
    · rintro rfl
      simp only [mem_empty_iff, not_false_eq_true, implies_true]
    · intro h
      apply ext hγ
      simp only [h, mem_empty_iff, implies_true]
  case succ n ih =>
    intro a
    simp only [cardinalNat, mem_succ_iff, ih]
    open scoped Classical in
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨b, ⟨s, hsn, hs⟩, a, ha, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨insert a s, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem, hsn]
        rwa [← hs]
      · intro c
        simp only [mem_union_iff, hs, typedMem_singleton_iff', Finset.mem_insert]
        exact Or.comm
    · rintro ⟨s, h₁, h₂⟩
      rw [Finset.card_eq_succ] at h₁
      obtain ⟨b, s, hbs, rfl, hns⟩ := h₁
      refine ⟨a \' {b}', ⟨s, hns, ?_⟩, b, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro c
        simp only [mem_diff_iff, h₂, Finset.mem_insert, typedMem_singleton_iff']
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨h₁ | h₁, h₂⟩
          · contradiction
          · assumption
        · intro h
          refine ⟨Or.inr h, ?_⟩
          rintro rfl
          contradiction
      · simp only [mem_diff_iff, typedMem_singleton_iff', not_true_eq_false, and_false,
          not_false_eq_true]
      · apply ext hγ
        intro z
        simp only [h₂, Finset.mem_insert, mem_union_iff, mem_diff_iff, typedMem_singleton_iff']
        tauto

statement:
@[simp]
theorem Path.recScoderiv'_nil {motive : ∀ β, β ↝ γ → Sort _}

name: Path.recScoderiv'_cons

@[simp]
theorem Path.recScoderiv'_cons {motive : ∀ β, β ↝ γ → Sort _}

    (scoderiv : ∀ α β (A : β ↝ γ) (h : β < α), motive β A → motive α (A ↗ h))
    (A : RevPath γ β) (h : β < α) :
    recScoderiv' (motive := motive) nil scoderiv (A.cons h) =
      scoderiv α β A.rev h (recScoderiv' nil scoderiv A)

name: Path.recScoderiv_scoderiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Path.recScoderiv_scoderiv {motive : ∀ β, β ↝ γ → Sort _}
    (nil : motive γ .nil)
    (scoderiv : ∀ α β (A : β ↝ γ) (h : β < α), motive β A → motive α (A ↗ h))
    {α β : TypeIndex} (A : β ↝ γ) (h : β < α) :
    recScoderiv (motive := motive) nil scoderiv (A ↗ h) =
      scoderiv α β A h (recScoderiv nil scoderiv A)
proof:
:= by
  unfold recScoderiv
  rw [cast_eq_iff_heq, scoderiv_rev, recScoderiv'_cons]
  congr 1
  · exact A.rev_rev
  · exact HEq.symm (cast_heq _ _)

proof:

name: Path.toList_sderiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Path.toList_sderiv (A : α ↝ β) (h : γ < β) :

proof:

name: Path.eq_of_toList_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Path.eq_of_toList_eq (A : α ↝ β) (B : α ↝ γ) : A.toList = B.toList → β = γ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  cases A with
  | nil =>
    cases B with
    | nil => rfl
    | sderiv γ δ B hδ => simp only [Set.coe_setOf, toList_nil, toList_sderiv, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        List.nil_eq, reduceCtorEq] at h
  | sderiv γ δ A hδ =>
    cases B with
    | nil => simp only [Set.coe_setOf, toList_sderiv, Set.mem_setOf_eq, toList_nil,
        reduceCtorEq] at h
    | sderiv γ δ B hδ =>
      simp only [toList_sderiv, Set.mem_setOf_eq, List.cons.injEq, Subtype.mk.injEq] at h
      exact h.1

name: Path.toList_injective
statement:
theorem Path.toList_injective (α β : TypeIndex) :
    Function.Injective (toList : (α ↝ β) → List {β | β < α})
proof:
:= by
  intro A B h
  induction A with
  | nil =>
    cases B with
    | nil => rfl
    | sderiv γ δ B hδ => simp only [Set.coe_setOf, toList_nil, toList_sderiv, Set.mem_setOf_eq,
        List.nil_eq, reduceCtorEq] at h
  | sderiv γ δ A hδ ih =>
    cases B with
    | nil => simp only [Set.coe_setOf, toList_sderiv, Set.mem_setOf_eq, toList_nil,
        reduceCtorEq] at h
    | sderiv γ' δ' B hδ' =>
      rw [toList_sderiv, toList_sderiv, List.cons.injEq] at h
      cases eq_of_toList_eq A B h.2
      cases ih h.2
      rfl

name: card_path_lt
statement: theorem card_path_lt (α β : TypeIndex) : #(α ↝ β) < (#μ).ord.cof
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_le_of_injective (Path.toList_injective α β)).trans_lt
  apply (mk_list_le_max {β | β < α}).trans_lt
  rw [max_lt_iff]
  exact ⟨aleph0_lt_κ.trans_le κ_le_μ_ord_cof, α.card_Iio_lt⟩

name: card_path_lt'
statement: theorem card_path_lt' (α β : TypeIndex) : #(α ↝ β) < #μ
proof:
:=
  (card_path_lt α β).trans_le (Ordinal.cof_ord_le #μ)

name: card_path_ne_zero
statement: theorem card_path_ne_zero (α : TypeIndex) : #(α ↝ ⊥) ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  letI : Nonempty (α ↝ ⊥) := ⟨Path.nil ↘.⟩
  mk_ne_zero _

name: card_path_any_lt_
statement: theorem card_path_any_lt_Λ (α : TypeIndex) : #((β : Λ) × α ↝ β) < (#μ).ord.cof
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_le_of_injective (f := λ x ↦ x.2 ↘.) ?_).trans_lt (card_path_lt α ⊥)
  rintro ⟨β, A⟩ ⟨γ, B⟩ h
  cases h
  rfl

name: card_path_any_lt
statement: theorem card_path_any_lt (α : TypeIndex) : #((β : TypeIndex) × α ↝ β) < (#μ).ord.cof
proof:
:= by
  refine (mk_le_of_injective (f := λ x : (β : TypeIndex) × α ↝ β ↦
      match x with
      | ⟨⊥, A⟩ => (false, A)
      | ⟨β, A⟩ => (true, A ↘.)) ?_).trans_lt ?_
  · rintro ⟨_ | β, A⟩ ⟨_ | γ, B⟩ h
    · cases h; rfl
    · cases h
    · cases h
    · cases h; rfl
  · simp only [mk_prod, mk_fintype, Fintype.card_bool, Nat.cast_ofNat, lift_ofNat, lift_id']
    apply mul_lt_of_lt (aleph0_lt_κ.le.trans κ_le_μ_ord_cof)
    · refine lt_of_lt_of_le ?_ (aleph0_lt_κ.le.trans κ_le_μ_ord_cof)
      have := nat_lt_aleph0 2
      rwa [Nat.cast_ofNat] at this
    · exact card_path_lt α ⊥

name: one_strPerm_smul
statement: theorem one_strPerm_smul {α : TypeIndex} (x : StrSet α) : strPerm_smul 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  induction α using WellFoundedLT.induction
  case ind α ih =>
    cases α using WithBot.recBotCoe
    case bot => rw [strPerm_smul_bot_def, Tree.one_apply, one_smul, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
    case coe α =>
      rw [strPerm_smul_coe_def, coe_ext_iff']
      intro β hβ y
      simp only [Tree.one_sderiv, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, ih β hβ, Set.image_id']

name: mul_strPerm_smul

proof:
:= by
  induction α using WellFoundedLT.induction
  case ind α ih =>
    cases α using WithBot.recBotCoe
    case bot =>
      simp only [strPerm_smul_bot_def, Tree.mul_apply, mul_smul, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
    case coe α =>
      simp only [strPerm_smul_coe_def, coe_ext_iff']
      intro β hβ y
      simp only [Tree.mul_sderiv, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, Set.mem_image, exists_exists_and_eq_and,
        ih β hβ]

name: StrSet.mem_smul_iff

  case bot => cases not_lt_bot h
  case coe α => rw [mem_iff, mem_iff, strPerm_smul_coe, Set.mem_smul_set_iff_inv_smul_mem]

proof:

name: smul_eq_smul_iff
statement:
theorem smul_eq_smul_iff (π₁ π₂ : BasePerm) (S : BaseSupport) :
    π₁ • S = π₂ • S ↔ (∀ a ∈ Sᴬ, π₁ • a = π₂ • a) ∧ (∀ N ∈ Sᴺ, π₁ • N = π₂ • N)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    constructor
    · rintro a ⟨i, ha⟩
      have := congr_arg (·ᴬ.rel i (π₁ • a)) h
      simp only [smul_atoms, Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul, eq_iff_iff] at this
      have := Sᴬ.rel_coinjective.coinjective ha (this.mp ha)
      rw [eq_inv_smul_iff] at this
      rw [this]
    · rintro N ⟨i, hN⟩
      have := congr_arg (·ᴺ.rel i (π₁ • N)) h
      simp only [smul_nearLitters, Enumeration.smul_rel, inv_smul_smul, eq_iff_iff] at this
      have := Sᴺ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hN (this.mp hN)
      rw [eq_inv_smul_iff] at this
      rw [this]
  · intro h
    ext : 2
    · rfl
    · ext i a : 3
      rw [smul_atoms, smul_atoms, Enumeration.smul_rel, Enumeration.smul_rel]
      constructor
      · intro ha
        have := h.1 _ ⟨i, ha⟩
        rw [smul_inv_smul, ← inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
        rwa [this]
      · intro ha
        have := h.1 _ ⟨i, ha⟩
        rw [smul_inv_smul, smul_eq_iff_eq_inv_smul] at this
        rwa [← this]
    · rfl
    · ext i a : 3
      rw [smul_nearLitters, smul_nearLitters, Enumeration.smul_rel, Enumeration.smul_rel]
      constructor
      · intro hN
        have := h.2 _ ⟨i, hN⟩
        rw [smul_inv_smul, ← inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
        rwa [this]
      · intro hN
        have := h.2 _ ⟨i, hN⟩
        rw [smul_inv_smul, smul_eq_iff_eq_inv_smul] at this
        rwa [← this]

name: smul_eq_iff
statement:
theorem smul_eq_iff (π : BasePerm) (S : BaseSupport) :
    π • S = S ↔ (∀ a ∈ Sᴬ, π • a = a) ∧ (∀ N ∈ Sᴺ, π • N = N)
proof:
:= by
  have := smul_eq_smul_iff π 1 S
  simp only [one_smul] at this
  exact this

name: smul_coderiv
statement:
theorem smul_coderiv {α : TypeIndex} (π : StrPerm α) (S : Support β) (A : α ↝ β) :
    π • S ⇗ A = (π ⇘ A • S) ⇗ A
proof:
:= by
  ext B i x
  · rfl
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨C, x⟩, hS, hx⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hx
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨⟨C, x⟩, hS, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨C, x⟩, hS, hx⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hx
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨⟨C, _⟩, hS, rfl⟩
  · rfl
  · constructor
    · rintro ⟨⟨C, x⟩, hS, hx⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hx
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨⟨C, x⟩, hS, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨C, a⟩, hS, hx⟩
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq] at hx
      obtain ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact ⟨⟨C, _⟩, hS, rfl⟩

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h A
    have := congr_arg (· ⇘. A) h
    simp only [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_eq_smul_iff] at this
    exact this
  · intro h
    apply ext

    simp only [smul_derivBot, BaseSupport.smul_eq_smul_iff]
    exact h A

name: smul_eq_of_subsupport

  intro A

  · rintro a ⟨i, hi⟩

    have hi₂ := (h₂ A).1 i a hi
    have := (T ⇘. A)ᴬ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hi₁ hi₂
    dsimp only at this
    rwa [smul_eq_iff_eq_inv_smul]
  · rintro N ⟨i, hi⟩
    have hi₁ := (h₁ A).2 i N hi
    have hi₂ := (h₂ A).2 i N hi
    have := (T ⇘. A)ᴺ.rel_coinjective.coinjective hi₁ hi₂

name: mem_path_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_path_iff {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} (E : Enumeration (α ↝ ⊥ × X))
    (A : α ↝ ⊥) (x : X) :
    (A, x) ∈ E ↔ x ∈ E ⇘. A
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: ext_path
proof:
:= by
  ext i x
  · have := congr_arg bound (h (Path.nil ↘.))
    exact this
  · have := congr_arg rel (h x.1)
    exact iff_of_eq (congr_fun₂ this i x.2)

name: deriv_derivBot
statement:
theorem deriv_derivBot {X : Type _} {α β : TypeIndex} (E : Enumeration (α ↝ ⊥ × X))
    (A : α ↝ β) (B : β ↝ ⊥) :
    E ⇘ A ⇘. B = E ⇘. (A ⇘ B)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: coderiv_deriv_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coderiv_deriv_eq {X : Type _} {α β : TypeIndex} (E : Enumeration (β ↝ ⊥ × X)) (A : α ↝ β) :
    E ⇗ A ⇘ A = E
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_path
  intro B
  ext i x
  · rfl
  · simp only [derivBot_rel, deriv_rel, coderiv_rel,
      Path.coderiv_eq_deriv, Path.deriv_right_inj, exists_eq_left']

name: eq_of_mem_scoderiv_botDeriv
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, ⟨B, y⟩, hi₁, hi₂⟩ := hx
  cases hi₂
  exact ⟨B, rfl⟩

name: scoderiv_botDeriv_eq
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scoderiv_botDeriv_eq {X : Type _} {α β : TypeIndex} (S : Enumeration (β ↝ ⊥ × X))
    (A : β ↝ ⊥) (h : β < α) :
    S ↗ h ⇘. (A ↗ h) = S ⇘. A
proof:
:= by
  ext i x
  · rfl
  · simp only [derivBot_rel, scoderiv_rel, Path.scoderiv_left_inj, exists_eq_left']

name: mulAction_aux
statement:
theorem mulAction_aux {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [MulAction BasePerm X] (π : StrPerm α) :
    Function.Injective (λ x : α ↝ ⊥ × X ↦ (x.1, (π x.1)⁻¹ • x.2))
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨A₁, x₁⟩ ⟨A₂, x₂⟩ h
  rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at h
  cases h.1
  exact Prod.ext h.1 (smul_left_cancel _ h.2)

name: smulPath_rel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smulPath_rel {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [MulAction BasePerm X]
    (π : StrPerm α) (E : Enumeration (α ↝ ⊥ × X)) (i : κ) (x : α ↝ ⊥ × X) :
    (π • E).rel i x ↔ E.rel i (x.1, (π x.1)⁻¹ • x.2)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: smul_eq_of_forall_smul_eq
statement:
theorem smul_eq_of_forall_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [MulAction BasePerm X]
    {π : StrPerm α} {E : Enumeration (α ↝ ⊥ × X)}
    (h : ∀ A : α ↝ ⊥, ∀ x : X, (A, x) ∈ E → π A • x = x) :
    π • E = E
proof:
:= by
  ext i x
  · rfl
  · obtain ⟨A, x⟩ := x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      have := h A ((π A)⁻¹ • x) ⟨i, hx⟩
      rw [smul_inv_smul] at this
      rw [this]
      exact hx
    · intro hx
      have := h A x ⟨i, hx⟩
      rw [← this]
      rwa [smulPath_rel, inv_smul_smul]

name: smul_eq_smul_of_forall_smul_eq
statement:
theorem smul_eq_smul_of_forall_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [MulAction BasePerm X]
    {π₁ π₂ : StrPerm α} {E : Enumeration (α ↝ ⊥ × X)}
    (h : ∀ A : α ↝ ⊥, ∀ x : X, (A, x) ∈ E → π₁ A • x = π₂ A • x) :
    π₁ • E = π₂ • E
proof:
:= by
  have := smul_eq_of_forall_smul_eq (π := π₂⁻¹ * π₁) (E := E) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
  intro A x hAx
  rw [Tree.mul_apply, mul_smul, Tree.inv_apply, inv_smul_eq_iff]
  exact h A x hAx

name: smul_eq_of_mem_of_smul_eq
statement:
theorem smul_eq_of_mem_of_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [MulAction BasePerm X]
    {π : StrPerm α} {E : Enumeration (α ↝ ⊥ × X)}
    (h : π • E = E) (A : α ↝ ⊥) (x : X) (hx : (A, x) ∈ E) :
    π A • x = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hx⟩ := hx
  have := congr_fun₂ (congr_arg rel h) i (A, x)
  have := E.rel_coinjective.coinjective hx (this.mpr hx)
  rw [Prod.mk.injEq, eq_inv_smul_iff] at this
  exact this.2

name: smul_eq_iff
statement:
theorem smul_eq_iff {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [MulAction BasePerm X]
    (π : StrPerm α) (E : Enumeration (α ↝ ⊥ × X)) :
    π • E = E ↔ ∀ A : α ↝ ⊥, ∀ x : X, (A, x) ∈ E → π A • x = x
proof:
:=
  ⟨smul_eq_of_mem_of_smul_eq, smul_eq_of_forall_smul_eq⟩

name: allPerm_deriv_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allPerm_deriv_nil [PreCoherentData] {β : TypeIndex} [LeLevel β]
    (ρ : AllPerm β) :
    ρ ⇘ (.nil : β ↝ β) = ρ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: allPerm_deriv_sderiv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allPerm_deriv_sderiv [PreCoherentData] {β γ δ : TypeIndex}
    [LeLevel β] [LeLevel γ] [LeLevel δ]
    (ρ : AllPerm β) (A : β ↝ γ) (h : δ < γ) :
    ρ ⇘ (A ↘ h) = ρ ⇘ A ↘ h
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: allPermDeriv_forget
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allPermDeriv_forget [CoherentData] {β γ : TypeIndex} [LeLevel β] [iγ : LeLevel γ]
    (A : β ↝ γ) (ρ : AllPerm β) :
    (ρ ⇘ A)ᵁ = ρᵁ ⇘ A
proof:
:= by
  revert iγ
  induction A with
  | nil =>
    intro
    rw [allPerm_deriv_nil, Tree.deriv_nil]
  | sderiv δ ε A h ih =>
    intro
    have : LeLevel δ := ⟨A.le.trans LeLevel.elim⟩
    rw [allPerm_deriv_sderiv, allPermSderiv_forget, ih, Tree.deriv_sderiv]

name: allPerm_inv_sderiv
statement:
theorem allPerm_inv_sderiv [CoherentData] {β γ : TypeIndex} [LeLevel β] [iγ : LeLevel γ]
    (h : γ < β) (ρ : AllPerm β) :
    ρ⁻¹ ↘ h = (ρ ↘ h)⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  apply allPermForget_injective
  rw [allPermSderiv_forget, allPermForget_inv, Tree.inv_sderiv, allPermForget_inv,
    allPermSderiv_forget]

name: TSet.mem_smul_iff
statement:
theorem TSet.mem_smul_iff [CoherentData] {β γ : TypeIndex} [LeLevel β] [iγ : LeLevel γ]
    {x : TSet γ} {y : TSet β} (h : γ < β) (ρ : AllPerm β) :
    x ∈[h] ρ • y ↔ ρ⁻¹ ↘ h • x ∈[h] y
proof:
:= by
  simp only [← forget_mem_forget, smul_forget, StrSet.mem_smul_iff, allPermSderiv_forget,
    allPermForget_inv, Tree.inv_sderiv]

name: CoherentData.smul_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem CoherentData.smul_singleton [CoherentData] {β γ : Λ} [LeLevel β] [LeLevel γ]
    (hγ : (γ : TypeIndex) < β) (x : TSet γ) (ρ : AllPerm β) :
    ρ • singleton hγ x = singleton hγ (ρ ↘ hγ • x)
proof:
:= by
  apply tSet_ext hγ
  intro z
  rw [TSet.mem_smul_iff, allPerm_inv_sderiv, typedMem_singleton_iff, typedMem_singleton_iff,
    inv_smul_eq_iff]

name: mem_iff
statement:
theorem mem_iff (x : X) (E : Enumeration X) :

proof:
:=

name: mem_congr

theorem mem_congr {E F : Enumeration X} (h : E = F) :

name: dom_small

name: coe_small

theorem coe_small (E : Enumeration X) :

name: graph'_small
statement:
theorem graph'_small (E : Enumeration X) :

name: not_mem_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem not_mem_empty (x : X) : x ∉ Enumeration.empty
proof:

  cases h

name: mem_singleton_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_singleton_iff (x y : X) :
    y ∈ singleton x ↔ y = x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, _, h⟩
    exact h
  · intro h
    exact ⟨0, rfl, h⟩

name: singleton_injective
statement: theorem singleton_injective : Function.Injective (singleton : X → Enumeration X)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y h
  have := mem_singleton_iff y x
  rw [← h, mem_singleton_iff] at this
  exact this.mp rfl

name: card_enumeration_ge
statement: theorem card_enumeration_ge (X : Type u) : #X ≤ #(Enumeration X)
proof:
:=
  mk_le_of_injective Enumeration.singleton_injective

name: card_enumeration_le
statement: theorem card_enumeration_le (h : #X ≤ #μ) : #(Enumeration X) ≤ #μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_le_of_injective (enumerationEmbedding X).injective).trans
  rw [mk_prod, lift_id, lift_id]
  apply mul_le_of_le aleph0_lt_μ.le κ_le_μ
  apply card_small_le
  rw [mk_prod, lift_id, lift_id]
  exact mul_le_of_le aleph0_lt_μ.le κ_le_μ h

name: card_enumeration_lt
statement: theorem card_enumeration_lt (h : #X < #μ) : #(Enumeration X) < #μ
proof:
:= by
  apply (mk_le_of_injective (enumerationEmbedding X).injective).trans_lt
  rw [mk_prod, lift_id, lift_id]
  apply mul_lt_of_lt aleph0_lt_μ.le κ_lt_μ
  apply (mk_subtype_le _).trans_lt
  rw [mk_set]
  apply μ_isStrongLimit.2
  rw [mk_prod, lift_id, lift_id]
  exact mul_lt_of_lt aleph0_lt_μ.le κ_lt_μ h

name: card_enumeration_eq
statement: theorem card_enumeration_eq (h : #X = #μ) : #(Enumeration X) = #μ
proof:
:=
  le_antisymm (card_enumeration_le h.le) (h.symm.le.trans (card_enumeration_ge X))

name: exists_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_equiv (s : Set X) (hs : Small s) :
    Nonempty ((i : κ) × (s ≃ Set.Iio i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Small] at hs
  refine ⟨κEquiv.symm ⟨(#s).ord, ?_⟩, Nonempty.some ?_⟩
  · rwa [Set.mem_Iio, ord_lt_ord]
  · rw [← Cardinal.eq, Set.Iio, κ_card_Iio_eq, Equiv.apply_symm_apply, card_ord]

name: mem_ofSet_iff

theorem mem_ofSet_iff (s : Set X) (hs : Small s) (x : X) :

proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hx, _⟩
    exact hx
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(exists_equiv s hs).some.2 ⟨x, h⟩, h, rfl⟩

name: ofSet_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem ofSet_coe (s : Set X) (hs : Small s) :

proof:

  rw [← mem_ofSet_iff s hs]

theorem mem_image {f : X → Y} (y : Y) :

name: smul_rel
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_rel {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (π : G) (E : Enumeration X) (i : κ) (x : X) :
    (π • E).rel i x ↔ E.rel i (π⁻¹ • x)
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: mem_smul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_smul {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (π : G) (E : Enumeration X) (x : X) :
    x ∈ π • E ↔ π⁻¹ • x ∈ E
proof:
:=
