name: smul_rel_dom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_rel_dom {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (π : G) (E : Enumeration X) :
    (π • E).rel.dom = E.rel.dom
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, h⟩
    exact ⟨π⁻¹ • x, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, h⟩
    use π • x
    rwa [smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]

name: smul_rel_codom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_rel_codom {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (π : G) (E : Enumeration X) :
    (π • E).rel.codom = π • E.rel.codom
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, h⟩
    exact ⟨π⁻¹ • x, ⟨i, h⟩, smul_inv_smul π x⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, ⟨i, h⟩, rfl⟩
    use i
    rwa [smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]

name: smul_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_coe {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X]
    (π : G) (E : Enumeration X) :
    ((π • E : Enumeration X) : Set X) = π • (E : Set X)
proof:
:=
  smul_rel_codom π E

name: mem_smul_iff
statement:
theorem mem_smul_iff {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X] (x : X) (g : G) (E : Enumeration X) :
    x ∈ g • E ↔ g⁻¹ • x ∈ E
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: eq_of_smul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem eq_of_smul_eq_smul {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X] {g₁ g₂ : G} {E : Enumeration X}
    (h : g₁ • E = g₂ • E) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ E) : g₁ • x = g₂ • x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hx
  have : (g₁ • E).rel i (g₁ • x) := by rwa [smul_rel, inv_smul_smul]
  rw [h] at this
  have := E.rel_coinjective.coinjective hi this
  exact (eq_inv_smul_iff.mp this).symm

name: eq_of_smul_eq
statement:
theorem eq_of_smul_eq {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X] {g : G} {E : Enumeration X}
    (h : g • E = E) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ E) : g • x = x
proof:
:= by
  have := eq_of_smul_eq_smul (g₁ := g) (g₂ := 1) ?_ x hx
  · rwa [one_smul] at this
  · rwa [one_smul]

name: smul_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_singleton {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X] {g : G} {x : X} :
    g • singleton x = singleton (g • x)
proof:
:= by
  apply Enumeration.ext
  · rfl
  · ext i y
    rw [smul_rel]
    simp only [singleton, and_congr_right_iff, inv_smul_eq_iff]

name: add_bound
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_bound (E F : Enumeration X) :
    (E + F).bound = E.bound + F.bound
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: rel_add_iff
statement:
theorem rel_add_iff {E F : Enumeration X} (i : κ) (x : X) :
    (E + F).rel i x ↔ E.rel i x ∨ ∃ j, E.bound + j = i ∧ F.rel j x
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: add_rel_dom
statement:
theorem add_rel_dom {X : Type _} (E F : Enumeration X) :
    (E + F).rel.dom = E.rel.dom ∪ (E.bound + ·) '' F.rel.dom
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Rel.dom, rel_add_iff, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_union, Set.mem_image]
  aesop

name: mem_add_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_add_iff {E F : Enumeration X} (x : X) :
    x ∈ E + F ↔ x ∈ E ∨ x ∈ F
proof:
:= by
  simp only [mem_iff, Rel.codom, Set.mem_setOf, rel_add_iff]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, (hi | ⟨j, rfl, hj⟩)⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨i, hi⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨j, hj⟩
  · rintro (⟨i, hi⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩)
    · exact ⟨i, Or.inl hi⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Or.inr ⟨j, rfl, hj⟩⟩

name: coe_add
statement:
@[simp]
theorem coe_add {E F : Enumeration X} :
    (E + F : Set X) = (E : Set X) ∪ F
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact mem_add_iff x

name: add_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem add_empty (E : Enumeration X) :
    E + .empty = E
proof:
:= by
  ext i x
  · rw [add_bound, empty, add_zero]
  · simp only [empty, rel_add_iff, and_false, exists_const, or_false]

name: add_inj_of_bound_eq_bound
statement:
theorem add_inj_of_bound_eq_bound {E F G H : Enumeration X} (h : E.bound = F.bound)
    (h' : E + G = F + H) : E = F ∧ G = H
proof:
:= by
  have := congr_arg (·.rel) h'
  conv at this => dsimp only; rw [funext_iff]; intro; rw [funext_iff]; intro; rw [eq_iff_iff]
  constructor
  · apply Enumeration.ext h
    ext i x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain (hx' | ⟨j, rfl, _⟩) := (this i x).mp (Or.inl hx)
      · exact hx'
      · have := E.lt_bound _ ⟨x, hx⟩
        rw [h, add_lt_iff_neg_left] at this
        cases (κ_zero_le j).not_gt this
    · intro hx
      obtain (hx' | ⟨j, rfl, _⟩) := (this i x).mpr (Or.inl hx)
      · exact hx'
      · have := F.lt_bound _ ⟨x, hx⟩
        rw [h, add_lt_iff_neg_left] at this
        cases (κ_zero_le j).not_gt this
  · apply Enumeration.ext
    · have := congr_arg (·.bound) h'
      simp only [add_bound, h, add_right_inj] at this
      exact this
    ext i x
    constructor
    · intro hx
      obtain (hx' | ⟨j, hj₁, hj₂⟩) := (this (E.bound + i) x).mp (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl, hx⟩)
      · have := F.lt_bound _ ⟨x, hx'⟩
        rw [h, add_lt_iff_neg_left] at this
        cases (κ_zero_le i).not_gt this
      · simp only [h, Rel.inv_apply, Function.graph_def, add_right_inj] at hj₁
        rw [← hj₁]
        exact hj₂
    · intro hx
      obtain (hx' | ⟨j, hj₁, hj₂⟩) := (this (F.bound + i) x).mpr (Or.inr ⟨i, rfl, hx⟩)
      · have := E.lt_bound _ ⟨x, hx'⟩
        rw [h, add_lt_iff_neg_left] at this
        cases (κ_zero_le i).not_gt this
      · simp only [h, Rel.inv_apply, Function.graph_def, add_right_inj] at hj₁
        rw [← hj₁]
        exact hj₂

name: add_inj_iff_of_bound_eq_bound
statement:
theorem add_inj_iff_of_bound_eq_bound {E F G H : Enumeration X} (h : E.bound = F.bound) :
    E + G = F + H ↔ E = F ∧ G = H
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact add_inj_of_bound_eq_bound h
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    rfl

name: smul_add
statement:
theorem smul_add {G X : Type _} [Group G] [MulAction G X] (g : G) (E F : Enumeration X) :
    g • (E + F) = g • E + g • F
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Support.Supports.mono
statement:
theorem Support.Supports.mono {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex} [PreModelData α]
    [MulAction (AllPerm α) X] {S T : Support α} {x : X}
    (hS : S.Supports x) (h : S ≤ T) (hT : α = ⊥ → Tᴺ = .empty) :
    T.Supports x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ρ hρ
    apply hS.supports
    rw [Support.smul_eq_iff] at hρ ⊢
    intro A
    constructor
    · intro a ha
      exact (hρ A).1 a ((h A).1 a ha)
    · intro N hN
      exact (hρ A).2 N ((h A).2 N hN)
  · exact hT

name: tSetForget_injective
statement:
theorem tSetForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {x₁ x₂ : TSet α}
    (h : x₁ᵁ = x₂ᵁ) : x₁ = x₂
proof:
:=
  ModelData.tSetForget_injective' h

name: tSetForget_surjective
statement:
theorem tSetForget_surjective [ModelData ⊥] (x : StrSet ⊥) :
    ∃ y : TSet ⊥, yᵁ = x
proof:
:=
  ModelData.tSetForget_surjective_of_bot' rfl x

name: allPermForget_injective
statement:
theorem allPermForget_injective {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α}
    (h : ρ₁ᵁ = ρ₂ᵁ) : ρ₁ = ρ₂
proof:
:=
  ModelData.allPermForget_injective' h

name: allPermForget_one
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_one {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] :
    (1 : AllPerm α)ᵁ = 1
proof:
:=
  ModelData.allPermForget_one'

name: allPermForget_mul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_mul {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α) :
    (ρ₁ * ρ₂)ᵁ = ρ₁ᵁ * ρ₂ᵁ
proof:
:=
  ModelData.allPermForget_mul' ρ₁ ρ₂

name: smul_forget
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_forget {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (x : TSet α) :
    (ρ • x)ᵁ = ρᵁ • xᵁ
proof:
:=
  ModelData.smul_forget' ρ x

name: allPermForget_inv
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_inv {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) : ρ⁻¹ᵁ = ρᵁ⁻¹
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_inv_iff_mul_eq_one, ← allPermForget_mul, inv_mul_cancel, allPermForget_one]

name: allPermForget_npow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_npow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℕ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [pow_zero, pow_zero, allPermForget_one]
  | succ n h => rw [pow_succ, pow_succ, allPermForget_mul, h]

name: allPermForget_zpow
statement:
@[simp]
theorem allPermForget_zpow {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (n : ℤ) :
    (ρ ^ n)ᵁ = ρᵁ ^ n
proof:
:= by
  induction n using Int.negInduction with
  | nat n => rw [zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_npow]
  | neg h' n => simp only [zpow_neg, zpow_natCast, allPermForget_inv, allPermForget_npow]

name: Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul
statement:
theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρ₁ᵁ • S = ρ₂ᵁ • S) :
    ρ₁ • x = ρ₂ • x
proof:
:= by
  have := h.supports (ρ₂⁻¹ * ρ₁) ?_
  · rwa [mul_smul, inv_smul_eq_iff] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_mul, mul_smul, allPermForget_inv, inv_smul_eq_iff]

name: Support.Supports.smul_eq_of_smul_eq
statement:
theorem Support.Supports.smul_eq_of_smul_eq {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) {ρ : AllPerm α} (hρ : ρᵁ • S = S) :
    ρ • x = x
proof:
:= by
  have := smul_eq_smul (ρ₁ := ρ) (ρ₂ := 1) h ?_
  · rwa [one_smul] at this
  · rwa [allPermForget_one, one_smul]

name: Support.Supports.smul
statement:
theorem Support.Supports.smul {X : Type _} {α : TypeIndex}
    [ModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    {S : Support α} {x : X} (h : S.Supports x) (ρ : AllPerm α) :
    (ρᵁ • S).Supports (ρ • x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro σ hσ
    rw [smul_smul, ← allPermForget_mul] at hσ
    have := h.smul_eq_smul hσ
    rwa [mul_smul] at this
  · intro h'
    rw [smul_nearLitters, h.nearLitters_eq_empty_of_bot h']
    rfl

name: TSet.forget_mem_forget
statement:
theorem TSet.forget_mem_forget {β α : TypeIndex} [ModelData β] [ModelData α] (h : β < α)
    {x : TSet β} {y : TSet α} :
    xᵁ ∈[h] yᵁ ↔ x ∈[h] y
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Tangle.smul_set
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Tangle.smul_set {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (t : Tangle α) :
    (ρ • t).set = ρ • t.set
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Tangle.smul_support
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Tangle.smul_support {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (ρ : AllPerm α) (t : Tangle α) :
    (ρ • t).support = ρᵁ • t.support
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Tangle.smul_eq_smul
proof:
:=
  Tangle.ext (t.support_supports.smul_eq_smul h) h

name: Tangle.smul_eq
proof:
:= by
  have := smul_eq_smul (ρ₁ := ρ) (ρ₂ := 1) (t := t) (by rwa [allPermForget_one, one_smul])
  rwa [one_smul] at this

name: Tangle.smul_atom_eq_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem Tangle.smul_atom_eq_of_mem_support {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α]
    {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} {t : Tangle α} (h : ρ₁ • t = ρ₂ • t)
    {a : Atom} {A : α ↝ ⊥} (ha : a ∈ (t.support ⇘. A)ᴬ) :
    ρ₁ᵁ A • a = ρ₂ᵁ A • a
proof:
:=
  Enumeration.eq_of_smul_eq_smul (congr_arg (λ t ↦ (t.support ⇘. A)ᴬ) h) a ha

name: Tangle.smul_nearLitter_eq_of_mem_support
statement:
theorem Tangle.smul_nearLitter_eq_of_mem_support {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α]
    {ρ₁ ρ₂ : AllPerm α} {t : Tangle α} (h : ρ₁ • t = ρ₂ • t)
    {N : NearLitter} {A : α ↝ ⊥} (hN : N ∈ (t.support ⇘. A)ᴺ) :
    ρ₁ᵁ A • N = ρ₂ᵁ A • N
proof:
:=
  Enumeration.eq_of_smul_eq_smul (congr_arg (λ t ↦ (t.support ⇘. A)ᴺ) h) N hN

name: card_tangle_le_of_card_tSet
statement:
theorem card_tangle_le_of_card_tSet {α : TypeIndex} [ModelData α] (h : #(TSet α) ≤ #μ) :
    #(Tangle α) ≤ #μ
proof:
:= by
  have := mk_le_of_injective (f := λ t : Tangle α ↦ (t.set, t.support)) ?_
  · apply this.trans
    rw [mk_prod, lift_id, lift_id]
    apply mul_le_of_le μ_isStrongLimit.aleph0_le h
    rw [card_support]
  · intro t₁ t₂ ht
    rw [Prod.mk.injEq] at ht
    exact Tangle.ext ht.1 ht.2

name: Support.supports_coe
statement:
theorem Support.supports_coe {α : Λ} {X : Type _} [PreModelData α] [MulAction (AllPerm α) X]
    (S : Support α) (x : X)
    (h : ∀ ρ : AllPerm α,
      (∀ A : α ↝ ⊥, ∀ a ∈ (S ⇘. A)ᴬ, ρᵁ A • a = a) →
      (∀ A : α ↝ ⊥, ∀ N ∈ (S ⇘. A)ᴺ, ρᵁ A • N = N) → ρ • x = x) :
    S.Supports x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ρ h'
    apply h
    · intro A a ha
      exact Enumeration.smul_eq_of_mem_of_smul_eq (smul_atoms_eq_of_smul_eq h') A a ha
    · intro A N hN
      exact Enumeration.smul_eq_of_mem_of_smul_eq (smul_nearLitters_eq_of_smul_eq h') A N hN
  · intro h
    cases h

name: Support.supports_bot
statement:
theorem Support.supports_bot {X : Type _} [PreModelData ⊥] [MulAction (AllPerm ⊥) X]
    (E : Enumeration (⊥ ↝ ⊥ × Atom)) (x : X)
    (h : ∀ ρ : AllPerm ⊥, (∀ A : ⊥ ↝ ⊥, ∀ x : Atom, (A, x) ∈ E → ρᵁ A • x = x) → ρ • x = x) :
    (⟨E, .empty⟩ : Support ⊥).Supports x
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ρ h'
    apply h
    intro A x hx
    exact Enumeration.smul_eq_of_mem_of_smul_eq (smul_atoms_eq_of_smul_eq h') A x hx
  · intro
    rfl

name: TypeIndex.type
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem TypeIndex.type :
    type ((· < ·) : TypeIndex → TypeIndex → Prop) = type ((· < ·) : Λ → Λ → Prop)
proof:
:= by
  rw [type_withBot]
  exact one_add_of_omega0_le <| omega0_le_of_isLimit Λ_type_isLimit

name: TypeIndex.card
statement:
@[simp]
protected theorem TypeIndex.card :
    #TypeIndex = #Λ
proof:
:= by
  have := congr_arg Ordinal.card TypeIndex.type
  rwa [card_type, card_type] at this

name: TypeIndex.card_Iio_lt
statement: theorem TypeIndex.card_Iio_lt (α : TypeIndex) : #{β | β < α} < (#μ).ord.cof
proof:
:= by
  have := ((type_Iio_lt α).trans_eq TypeIndex.type).trans_le Λ_type_le_μ_ord_cof
  rwa [lt_ord] at this

name: TypeIndex.card_Iic_lt
statement: theorem TypeIndex.card_Iic_lt (α : TypeIndex) : #{β | β ≤ α} < (#μ).ord.cof
proof:
:= by
  have := ((type_Iic_lt α).trans_eq TypeIndex.type).trans_le Λ_type_le_μ_ord_cof
  rwa [lt_ord] at this

name: card_litter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_litter : #Litter = #μ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply litterEquiv.cardinal_eq.trans_le
    apply (mk_subtype_le _).trans_eq
    simp only [mk_prod, Cardinal.lift_id, TypeIndex.card, mul_mk_eq_max, max_self,
      max_eq_left_iff, Λ_le_μ]
  · apply mk_le_of_injective (f := λ ν ↦ ⟨ν, ⊥, Classical.arbitrary Λ, bot_ne_coe⟩)
    intro ν₁ ν₂ h
    cases h
    rfl

name: mem_litter_atoms_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_litter_atoms_iff (a : Atom) (L : Litter) :
    a ∈ Lᴬ ↔ aᴸ = L
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Atom.ext
statement: theorem Atom.ext {a₁ a₂ : Atom} (h : a₁ᴸ = a₂ᴸ) (h' : a₁.index = a₂.index) : a₁ = a₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L₁, i₁⟩ := a₁
  obtain ⟨L₂, i₂⟩ := a₂
  subst h
  subst h'
  rfl

name: card_atom
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_atom : #Atom = #μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [atomEquiv.cardinal_eq, mk_prod, lift_id, lift_id, card_litter]
  exact mul_eq_left aleph0_lt_μ.le κ_le_μ (mk_ne_zero κ)

name: Litter.card_atoms
statement:
@[simp]
theorem Litter.card_atoms (L : Litter) : #Lᴬ = #κ
proof:
:=
  Cardinal.eq.mpr ⟨litterSetEquiv L⟩

name: Litter.atoms_not_small
statement: theorem Litter.atoms_not_small (L : Litter) : ¬Small Lᴬ
proof:
:=
  L.card_atoms.not_lt

name: litter_pairwise_disjoint
statement: theorem litter_pairwise_disjoint {L₁ L₂ : Litter} (h : L₁ ≠ L₂) : Disjoint L₁ᴬ L₂ᴬ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_iff]
  intro x hx
  exact h <| hx.1.symm.trans hx.2

name: litter_eq_of_near
statement: theorem litter_eq_of_near {L₁ L₂ : Litter} (h : L₁ᴬ ~ L₂ᴬ) : L₁ = L₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := inter_nonempty_of_near h L₁.atoms_not_small
  exact ha₁.symm.trans ha₂

name: Small.lt
statement: theorem Small.lt : Small s → #s < #κ
proof:
:=
  id

name: small_of_subsingleton
statement: theorem small_of_subsingleton (h : s.Subsingleton) : Small s
proof:
:=
  h.cardinalMk_le_one.trans_lt <| one_lt_aleph0.trans_le aleph0_lt_κ.le

name: small_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem small_empty : Small (∅ : Set α)
proof:
:=
  small_of_subsingleton subsingleton_empty

name: small_singleton
statement:
@[simp]
theorem small_singleton (x : α) : Small {x}
proof:
:=
  small_of_subsingleton subsingleton_singleton

name: Small.mono
statement: theorem Small.mono (h : s ⊆ t) : Small t → Small s
proof:
:=
  (mk_le_mk_of_subset h).trans_lt

name: Small.congr
statement: theorem Small.congr (h : s = t) : Small t → Small s
proof:
:=
  Small.mono (subset_of_eq h)

name: small_union
statement: theorem small_union (hs : Small s) (ht : Small t) : Small (s ∪ t)
proof:
:=
  (mk_union_le _ _).trans_lt <| add_lt_of_lt Params.κ_isRegular.aleph0_le hs ht

name: small_symmDiff
statement: theorem small_symmDiff (hs : Small s) (ht : Small t) : Small (s ∆ t)
proof:
:=
  (small_union hs ht).mono symmDiff_subset_union

name: small_iUnion
statement:
theorem small_iUnion (hι : #ι < #κ) {f : ι → Set α} (hf : ∀ i, Small (f i)) :
    Small (⋃ i, f i)
proof:
:=
  (mk_iUnion_le _).trans_lt <|
    mul_lt_of_lt Params.κ_isRegular.aleph0_le hι <| iSup_lt_of_isRegular Params.κ_isRegular hι hf

name: small_iUnion_Prop
statement: theorem small_iUnion_Prop {p : Prop} {f : p → Set α} (hf : ∀ i, Small (f i)) : Small (⋃ i, f i)
proof:
:=
  by by_cases p <;> simp_all

name: small_biUnion
statement:
theorem small_biUnion {s : Set ι} (hs : Small s) {f : ∀ i ∈ s, Set α}
    (hf : ∀ (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s), Small (f i hi)) : Small (⋃ (i : ι) (hi : i ∈ s), f i hi)
proof:
:=
  (small_iUnion hs (λ i ↦ hf i i.prop)).congr (Set.biUnion_eq_iUnion _ _)

name: Small.image
statement: theorem Small.image (f : α → β) : Small s → Small (f '' s)
proof:
:=
  mk_image_le.trans_lt

name: Small.preimage
statement: theorem Small.preimage (f : β → α) (h : f.Injective) : Small s → Small (f ⁻¹' s)
proof:
:=
  (mk_preimage_of_injective f s h).trans_lt

name: iio_small
statement: theorem iio_small (i : κ) : Small {j | j < i}
proof:
:= by
  have := Ordinal.type_Iio_lt i
  rwa [κ_type, lt_ord, Ordinal.card_type] at this

name: iic_small
statement: theorem iic_small (i : κ) : Small {j | j ≤ i}
proof:
:= by
  have := Ordinal.type_Iic_lt i
  rwa [κ_type, lt_ord, Ordinal.card_type] at this

name: card_le_card_small
statement: theorem card_le_card_small (α : Type _) : #α ≤ #{s : Set α | Small s}
proof:
:= by
  apply mk_le_of_injective (f := λ x ↦ ⟨{x}, small_singleton x⟩)
  intro x y h
  exact singleton_injective <| congr_arg Subtype.val h

name: card_small_le
statement: theorem card_small_le (h : #α ≤ #μ) : #{s : Set α | Small s} ≤ #μ
proof:
:= by
  rw [le_def] at h
  obtain ⟨⟨f, hf⟩⟩ := h
  rw [← mk_subset_mk_lt_cof μ_isStrongLimit.2]
  refine mk_le_of_injective (f := λ s ↦ ⟨f '' s, ?_⟩) ?_
  · exact mk_image_le.trans_lt <| s.prop.trans_le κ_le_μ_ord_cof
  · intro s t h
    exact Subtype.val_injective <| hf.image_injective <| congr_arg Subtype.val h

name: card_small_eq
statement: theorem card_small_eq (h : #α = #μ) : #{s : Set α | Small s} = #μ
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact card_small_le h.le
  · exact h.symm.trans_le <| card_le_card_small α

name: image_small_of_coinjective
statement:
theorem image_small_of_coinjective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Coinjective) {s : Set α} (hs : Small s) :
    Small (r.image s)
proof:
:= by
  have := small_biUnion hs (f := λ x _ ↦ {y | r x y}) ?_
  · apply this.mono
    rintro y ⟨x, hxy⟩
    simp only [mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨x, hxy.1, hxy.2⟩
  · intro x hx
    apply small_of_subsingleton
    intro y hy z hz
    exact h.coinjective hy hz

name: small_codom_of_small_dom
statement:
theorem small_codom_of_small_dom {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Coinjective) (h' : Small r.dom) :
    Small r.codom
proof:
:=
  Rel.image_dom ▸ image_small_of_coinjective h h'

name: small_graph'
statement:
theorem small_graph' {r : Rel α β} (h₁ : Small r.dom) (h₂ : Small r.codom) :
    Small r.graph'
proof:
:= by
  have := small_biUnion h₁ (f := λ x _ ↦ {z : α × β | z.1 = x ∧ r x z.2}) ?_
  · apply this.mono
    rintro z hz
    simp only [mem_iUnion]
    exact ⟨z.1, ⟨z.2, hz⟩, rfl, hz⟩
  · intro x hx
    apply (h₂.image (λ y ↦ (x, y))).mono
    rintro ⟨x', y⟩ hy
    rw [mem_setOf_eq] at hy
    cases hy.1
    rw [mem_image]
    exact ⟨y, ⟨x', hy.2⟩, rfl⟩

name: near_refl
statement:
@[refl]
theorem near_refl (s : Set α) : s ~ s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Near, symmDiff_self]
  exact small_empty

name: near_rfl
statement: theorem near_rfl : s ~ s
proof:
:=
  near_refl s

name: near_of_eq
statement: theorem near_of_eq (h : s = t) : s ~ t
proof:
:=
  h ▸ near_refl s

name: near_symm
statement:
@[symm]
theorem near_symm (h : s ~ t) : t ~ s
proof:
:= by
  rwa [Near, symmDiff_comm] at h

name: near_trans
statement:
@[trans]
theorem near_trans (h₁ : s ~ t) (h₂ : t ~ u) : s ~ u
proof:
:=
  (small_union h₁ h₂).mono (symmDiff_trans_subset s t u)

name: near_symmDiff_self_of_small
statement: theorem near_symmDiff_self_of_small (h : Small s) : s ∆ t ~ t
proof:
:= by
  rwa [Near, symmDiff_symmDiff_cancel_right]

name: near_union_of_small
statement: theorem near_union_of_small (h : Small s) : t ∪ s ~ t
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Near, Set.symmDiff_def, union_diff_left]
  apply small_union
  · exact h.mono diff_subset
  · rw [show t \ (t ∪ s) = ∅ by aesop]
    exact small_empty

name: near_image
statement: theorem near_image (h : s ~ t) (f : α → β) : f '' s ~ f '' t
proof:
:=
  (h.image f).mono subset_image_symmDiff

name: near_symmDiff_iff
statement: theorem near_symmDiff_iff (u : Set α) : u ∆ s ~ u ∆ t ↔ s ~ t
proof:
:= by
  rw [Near, Near, symmDiff_comm u s, symmDiff_assoc, symmDiff_symmDiff_cancel_left]

name: card_le_of_near
statement: theorem card_le_of_near (h₁ : s ~ t) (h₂ : ¬Small t) : #t ≤ #s
proof:
:= by
  rw [Near, Small, Set.symmDiff_def, mk_union_of_disjoint disjoint_sdiff_sdiff] at h₁
  rw [Small, not_lt] at h₂
  have h₃ := (le_add_self.trans_lt h₁).trans_le h₂
  by_contra! h₄
  have := add_lt_of_lt (aleph0_lt_κ.le.trans h₂) h₃ h₄
  exact (le_mk_diff_add_mk t s).not_gt this

name: card_eq_of_near
statement: theorem card_eq_of_near (h₁ : s ~ t) (h₂ : ¬Small t) : #s = #t
proof:
:= by
  have := card_le_of_near h₁ h₂
  have h₃ : ¬Small s := h₂ ∘ this.trans_lt
  exact le_antisymm (card_le_of_near (near_symm h₁) h₃) this

name: card_inter_of_near
statement: theorem card_inter_of_near (h₁ : s ~ t) (h₂ : ¬Small s) : #(s ∩ t : Set α) = #s
proof:
:= by
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply mk_le_of_injective (f := λ x ↦ ⟨x, x.prop.1⟩)
    intro x y h
    rwa [Subtype.mk.injEq, Subtype.coe_inj] at h
  · rw [← diff_symmDiff_self]
    apply le_of_le_add (le_mk_diff_add_mk s (s ∆ t))
    · exact aleph0_lt_κ.le.trans (κ_le_of_not_small h₂)
    · exact h₁.trans_le (κ_le_of_not_small h₂)

name: inter_nonempty_of_near
statement: theorem inter_nonempty_of_near (h₁ : s ~ t) (h₂ : ¬Small s) : (s ∩ t).Nonempty
proof:
:= by
  rw [← mk_ne_zero_iff_nonempty, card_inter_of_near h₁ h₂]
  exact ne_of_gt <| aleph0_pos.trans <| aleph0_lt_κ.trans_le <| κ_le_of_not_small h₂

name: card_near_le
statement: theorem card_near_le (s : Set α) (h : #α ≤ #μ) : #{t | t ~ s} ≤ #μ
proof:
:= by
  refine le_trans ?_ (card_small_le h)
  apply mk_le_of_injective (f := λ t ↦ ⟨t ∆ s, t.prop⟩)
  intro t₁ t₂ ht
  exact Subtype.val_injective <| symmDiff_left_injective s <| congr_arg Subtype.val ht

name: card_near_eq
statement: theorem card_near_eq (s : Set α) (h : #α = #μ) : #{t | t ~ s} = #μ
proof:
:= by
  refine trans ?_ (card_small_eq h)
  rw [Cardinal.eq]
  refine ⟨⟨λ t ↦ ⟨t ∆ s, t.prop⟩, λ t ↦ ⟨t ∆ s, near_symmDiff_self_of_small t.prop⟩, ?_, ?_⟩⟩ <;>
  · intro t
    simp only [coe_setOf, mem_setOf_eq, symmDiff_symmDiff_cancel_right, Subtype.coe_eta]

name: NearLitter.mk_litter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem NearLitter.mk_litter (L : Litter) (s : Set Atom) (h : s ~ Lᴬ) :

proof:
:=
  rfl

statement:
@[simp]
theorem NearLitter.mk_atoms (L : Litter) (s : Set Atom) (h : s ~ Lᴬ) :

proof:
:=
  rfl

name: NearLitter.atoms_near_litter
statement:
theorem NearLitter.atoms_near_litter (N : NearLitter) :
    Nᴬ ~ Nᴸᴬ
proof:
:=
  N.atoms_near_litter'

name: NearLitter.symmDiff_small
statement:
theorem NearLitter.symmDiff_small (N : NearLitter) :
    Small (Nᴬ ∆ Nᴸᴬ)
proof:
:=
  N.atoms_near_litter

name: NearLitter.diff_small
statement:
theorem NearLitter.diff_small (N : NearLitter) :
    Small (Nᴬ \ Nᴸᴬ)
proof:

  N.atoms_near_litter.mono (λ _ ↦ Or.inl)

name: NearLitter.diff_small'
statement:
theorem NearLitter.diff_small' (N : NearLitter) :

name: NearLitter.card_atoms
statement:
theorem NearLitter.card_atoms (N : NearLitter) :
    #Nᴬ = #κ
proof:
:=
  (card_eq_of_near N.atoms_near_litter Nᴸ.card_atoms.not_lt).trans Nᴸ.card_atoms

name: NearLitter.atoms_not_small
statement:
theorem NearLitter.atoms_not_small (N : NearLitter) :
    ¬Small Nᴬ
proof:
:=

name: nearLitter_litter_eq_of_near
statement:
theorem nearLitter_litter_eq_of_near (h : N₁ᴬ ~ N₂ᴬ) :
    N₁ᴸ = N₂ᴸ
proof:
:=
  litter_eq_of_near <|
    near_trans (near_trans (near_symm N₁.atoms_near_litter) h) N₂.atoms_near_litter

name: near_of_litter_eq
statement:
theorem near_of_litter_eq (h : N₁ᴸ = N₂ᴸ) :
    N₁ᴬ ~ N₂ᴬ
proof:
:=
  near_trans N₁.atoms_near_litter (h ▸ near_symm N₂.atoms_near_litter)

name: nearLitter_near_iff
statement:
@[simp]
theorem nearLitter_near_iff (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter) :
    N₁ᴬ ~ N₂ᴬ ↔ N₁ᴸ = N₂ᴸ
proof:
:=
  ⟨nearLitter_litter_eq_of_near, near_of_litter_eq⟩

name: NearLitter.ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem NearLitter.ext (h : N₁ᴬ = N₂ᴬ) :
    N₁ = N₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨L₁, s₁, h₁⟩ := N₁
  obtain ⟨L₂, s₂, h₂⟩ := N₂
  cases nearLitter_litter_eq_of_near (near_of_eq h)
  subst h
  rfl

name: card_near_litter
statement: theorem card_near_litter (L : Litter) : #{s | s ~ Lᴬ} = #μ
proof:
:=
  card_near_eq Lᴬ card_atom

name: card_nearLitter
statement:
@[simp]
theorem card_nearLitter : #NearLitter = #μ
proof:
:= by
  simp only [Cardinal.eq.mpr ⟨nearLitterEquiv⟩, mk_sigma, card_near_litter, sum_const, card_litter,
    lift_id, mul_mk_eq_max, max_self]

name: litter_eq_iff_symmDiff_small
statement: theorem litter_eq_iff_symmDiff_small (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter) : N₁ᴸ = N₂ᴸ ↔ Small (N₁ᴬ ∆ N₂ᴬ)
proof:
:=
  (nearLitter_near_iff N₁ N₂).symm

name: litter_ne_of_inter_small
statement: theorem litter_ne_of_inter_small (h : Small (N₁ᴬ ∩ N₂ᴬ)) : N₁ᴸ ≠ N₂ᴸ
proof:
:= by
  intro h'
  rw [litter_eq_iff_symmDiff_small] at h'
  have := small_union h h'
  rw [inter_union_symmDiff] at this
  exact N₁.atoms_not_small <| this.mono subset_union_left

name: inter_small_of_litter_ne
statement: theorem inter_small_of_litter_ne (h : N₁ᴸ ≠ N₂ᴸ) : Small (N₁ᴬ ∩ N₂ᴬ)
proof:
:= by
  apply (small_union N₁.atoms_near_litter N₂.atoms_near_litter).mono
  apply Set.inter_subset_symmDiff_union_symmDiff
  exact litter_pairwise_disjoint h

name: litter_ne_iff_inter_small
statement: theorem litter_ne_iff_inter_small (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter) : N₁ᴸ ≠ N₂ᴸ ↔ Small (N₁ᴬ ∩ N₂ᴬ)
proof:
:=
  ⟨inter_small_of_litter_ne, litter_ne_of_inter_small⟩

name: interference_eq_of_litter_eq
statement:
theorem interference_eq_of_litter_eq (h : N₁ᴸ = N₂ᴸ) :
    interference N₁ N₂ = N₁ᴬ ∆ N₂ᴬ
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [interference, h, true_iff, mem_inter_iff, mem_setOf_eq, mem_union, mem_symmDiff]
  tauto

name: interference_eq_of_litter_ne
statement:
theorem interference_eq_of_litter_ne (h : N₁ᴸ ≠ N₂ᴸ) :
    interference N₁ N₂ = N₁ᴬ ∩ N₂ᴬ
proof:
:= by
  ext a
  simp only [interference, h, false_iff, not_not, mem_inter_iff, mem_setOf_eq, mem_union]
  tauto

name: interference_small
statement:
theorem interference_small (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter) :
    Small (interference N₁ N₂)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : N₁ᴸ = N₂ᴸ
  · rwa [interference_eq_of_litter_eq h, ← litter_eq_iff_symmDiff_small]
  · rwa [interference_eq_of_litter_ne h, ← litter_ne_iff_inter_small]

name: smul_near_smul
statement:
theorem smul_near_smul (π : BasePerm) (s : Set Atom) (L : Litter) :
    s ~ Lᴬ → π • s ~ (π • L)ᴬ
proof:
:=
  π.apply_near_apply s L

name: smul_atom_def
statement:
theorem smul_atom_def (π : BasePerm) (a : Atom) :
    π • a = πᴬ a
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_litter_def
statement:
theorem smul_litter_def (π : BasePerm) (L : Litter) :
    π • L = πᴸ L
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: smul_nearLitter_atoms
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_nearLitter_atoms (π : BasePerm) (N : NearLitter) :

proof:

name: smul_nearLitter_litter
statement:

theorem smul_nearLitter_litter (π : BasePerm) (N : NearLitter) :

proof:

name: ext
statement:
@[ext]
theorem ext {π₁ π₂ : BasePerm} (h : ∀ a : Atom, π₁ • a = π₂ • a) :
    π₁ = π₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨πa₁, πl₁, h₁⟩ := π₁
  obtain ⟨πa₂, πl₂, h₂⟩ := π₂
  rw [mk.injEq]
  have : πa₁ = πa₂ := by ext a; exact h a
  refine ⟨this, ?_⟩
  ext L
  have h₁' := h₁ Lᴬ L near_rfl
  have h₂' := h₂ Lᴬ L near_rfl
  rw [this] at h₁'
  exact litter_eq_of_near <| near_trans (near_symm h₁') h₂'

name: inv_smul_near_inv_smul
statement:
theorem inv_smul_near_inv_smul (π : BasePerm) (s : Set Atom) (L : Litter) :
    s ~ Lᴬ → πᴬ⁻¹ • s ~ (πᴸ⁻¹ • L)ᴬ
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply near_trans (near_image h ↑πᴬ⁻¹)
  have := π.smul_near_smul (πᴸ⁻¹ L)ᴬ (πᴸ⁻¹ L) near_rfl
  have := near_image this ↑πᴬ⁻¹
  simp only [smul_litter_def, smul_atom_def, Perm.apply_inv_self, Set.smul_set_def,
    Perm.image_inv, preimage_image] at this
  rw [Perm.image_inv]
  exact near_symm this

@[simp]

name: smul_interference
statement:
@[simp]
theorem smul_interference (π : BasePerm) (N₁ N₂ : NearLitter) :
    π • interference N₁ N₂ = interference (π • N₁) (π • N₂)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : N₁ᴸ = N₂ᴸ
  · rw [interference_eq_of_litter_eq h, interference_eq_of_litter_eq,
      Set.smul_set_symmDiff, smul_nearLitter_atoms, smul_nearLitter_atoms]
    rwa [smul_nearLitter_litter, smul_nearLitter_litter, smul_left_cancel_iff]
  · rw [interference_eq_of_litter_ne h, interference_eq_of_litter_ne,
      Set.smul_set_inter, smul_nearLitter_atoms, smul_nearLitter_atoms]
    rwa [smul_nearLitter_litter, smul_nearLitter_litter, ne_eq, smul_left_cancel_iff]
